jp.description:
GeoGuessrで世界を探検しよう
GeoGuessrを思いきり楽しむには、サブスクリプション登録が必要です。マップやさまざまなゲームモード、Multiplayer、競技向けの機能など、すべてのコンテンツにアクセスできます。GeoGuessr自体は無料でダウンロードでき、一部のプレイは無料でお楽しみいただけます。

推測を重ねて世界を発見しよう
実在する場所にドロップして、周りの手がかりをたどり、自分がどこにいるのかを突き止めましょう。

Daily Challengeに挑戦しよう
地理の知識を試して、世界中のプレイヤーとスコアを比べてみましょう。

世界中のプレイヤーと対戦
GeoGuessrのサブスクリプションに登録すると、DuelやBattle Royaleで対戦したり、ランクを上げたり、世界中のプレイヤーに挑戦できます。

遊びながら学ぼう
有名なランドマークから、ひっそりとした田舎道、その間にあるあらゆる場所まで探検しながら、あなたの地理の知識を試してみましょう。

どこでもプレイ
GeoGuessrアカウントがあれば、モバイルとWebを自由に行き来してプレイできます。

自分らしさを表現しよう
アバターをカスタマイズして、自分好みのプロフィールを作りましょう。

アプリ内購入とサブスクリプション
一部のプレイは無料でお楽しみいただけます。GeoGuessrをフルアクセスで利用するにはサブスクリプション登録が必要です。ご利用可能なプランや価格は、お住まいの地域によって異なる場合があります。

us.description:
Play along in live zTrivia+ games.

Join a hosted game with a code, choose your player and take part from your phone or tablet. Questions, answers, scores and results stay in sync with the host session so everyone can play together.

How it works:
• Start or open a zTrivia+ game on the host screen
• Enter the join code shown by the host
• Play each round live from your device
• See answers, scores and results as the game progresses

Designed for parties, game nights and shared screens.

A host session and internet connection are required. This app joins hosted zTrivia+ games; it does not start a standalone game.

us.description:
One word. One imposter. Zero trust.

Think you can lie to your friends? Prove it.

Imposter is the ultimate party game of bluffing, suspicion, and chaotic accusations. Everyone sees the secret word, except the Imposter. Now talk your way out, read the room, and try not to get exposed.

How to play:
- Everyone gets the same secret word, except the Imposter
- Each player gives a clue by giving exactly one word. Too obvious? You're helping the Imposter. Too vague? You look suspicious.
- The Imposter has to fake it by blending in without knowing the word
- Vote on who you think is lying... then reveal!

Get ready for:
- "Wait... why did you say THAT?" moments
- The sweet satisfaction of catching someone in a lie
- Heated debates that get way too personal
- Or fooling everyone and getting away with it

What's inside:
- Over 16 categories
- 1,700+ words with hints to keep imposters on their to

de.description:
Ein Wort. Ein Imposter. Null Vertrauen.

Glaubst du, du kannst deine Freunde anlügen? Dann beweis es.

Imposter ist das ultimative Partyspiel voller Bluffs, Verdächtigungen und chaotischer Anschuldigungen. Alle sehen das geheime Wort, außer der Imposter. Jetzt red dich raus, lies den Raum und versuch nicht aufzufliegen.

So wird gespielt:
- Alle bekommen dasselbe geheime Wort, außer der Imposter
- Jeder Spieler gibt einen Hinweis mit genau einem Wort. Zu offensichtlich? Du hilfst dem Imposter. Zu vage? Du wirkst verdächtig.
- Der Imposter muss bluffen und sich anpassen, ohne das Wort zu kennen
- Stimmt ab, wer eurer Meinung nach lügt... und dann wird aufgedeckt!

Mach dich bereit für:
- „Warte mal... warum hast du DAS gesagt?" Momente
- Die süße Befriedigung, jemanden beim Lügen zu erwischen
- Hitzige Debatten, die viel zu persönlich werden
- Oder alle reinlegen und damit durchkommen

Wa

us.description:
Imposter Game: Who is the Spy? is a thrilling social party game of hidden roles, bluffing, and deduction. Perfect for game nights, casual hangouts, or video calls, it brings laughter, suspense, and surprises to any group of friends.

In each round, players are given a secret word, except one: the Impostor, who must fake their way through the conversation and figure out the word without getting exposed. The Civilians must subtly confirm each other’s knowledge of the word while watching closely for anyone acting suspicious.

But there’s another wildcard in the mix: Mr. White. This player doesn’t receive any word at all. No clue, no help, only improvisation and bluffing. If Mr. White survives the round or correctly guesses the word, they win.

The gameplay is simple to learn but full of strategy. Ask questions, answer carefully, and pay attention to tone, hesitation, and clever deception. A

fr.description:
Imposteur - Qui Est l’Espion ? est un jeu multijoueur captivant de bluff, de déduction et de trahison, parfait pour vos soirées entre amis ou vos réunions de famille.

Chaque partie est rapide, drôle et pleine de rebondissements. Le jeu est conçu pour 3 à 24 joueurs, en personne ou à distance.

Le principe est simple : Chaque joueur reçoit secrètement un mot... sauf l’Imposteur, qui ne connaît rien du tout. Les Civils doivent se reconnaître entre eux sans dévoiler le mot. L’Imposteur, lui, doit deviner le mot tout en se fondant dans la conversation. Et M. Blanc ? Il n’a même pas de mot, mais peut gagner s’il réussit à tromper tout le monde ou à deviner le mot secret.

Posez des questions, observez les réponses, repérez les incohérences, et votez à chaque tour pour éliminer un joueur. Serez-vous capable de détecter le menteur… ou serez-vous éliminé à tort ?

us.description:
Game is Hard is not your typical puzzle app. This is a pure brain puzzle experience designed for players who love being challenged. With its clever, minimalist style and unexpected interactions, it blends elements of brain games, logic, and device-based exploration into a collection of brutally tricky levels.

Every puzzle breaks the rules — no flashy animations, no rewards for guessing. Just you, your mind, and a seemingly simple task that might hide a brilliant, almost impossible solution. Whether you’re into strategy, trivia games, or iq test challenges, Game is Hard invites you to test your patience, perception, and persistence.

This is not about fast reflexes. It’s about slow, methodical progress. Some levels require silence. Others need movement. Many seem unsolvable — until they’re not. It’s a place for deep thinking and bold experimentation. Hints are available when needed, but

jp.description:
Game is Hard（ゲームは難しい） 」は、よくあるパズルアプリではありません。

本作は、挑戦そのものを愛するプレイヤーのために作られた、純粋な脳力パズル体験です。

洗練されたミニマルなデザインと予想外の操作によって、脳トレ、論理思考、そしてデバイスならではの仕掛けが、極めて手ごわいレベル群として融合しています。
すべてのパズルは常識を裏切ります。

派手な演出も、当てずっぽうへのご褒美もありません。

あるのは、あなた自身の思考と、一見シンプルに見える、しかしほぼ不可能とも思える課題だけです。

戦略ゲームやトリビア、IQテストが好きな方なら、「Game is Hard」は忍耐力、観察力、そして粘り強さを試す場となるでしょう。

これは反射神経のゲームではありません。

ゆっくりと、論理的に進むゲームです。
静けさを必要とするレベルもあれば、動きが求められるレベルもあります。
多くの問題は解けないように見えますが、ある瞬間に解けるようになります。
深く考え、大胆に試す人のための場所です。

ヒントは用意されていますが、進歩は常に自分の力で勝ち取るものです。

ブレインテスト系ゲーム、ロジックパズル、IQテスト、モロンテスト、脳トレ系ゲームが好きな方には、まさにぴったりの作品です。
特に、ひねりの効いたトリッキーな挑戦を分解して楽しむ人に向いています。

このゲームは、型にはまらない思考をする人、好奇心旺盛な人、賢く、そして静かに諦めない人を評価します。

完全オフライン対応なので、いつでもどこでもプレイできます。
Wi-Fiなしの環境や、インターネットに接続できない状況、長時間の移動中にも最適です。
機内モード中でも、地下深くでも、すべてのパズルはプレイ可能です。

そして、はい。

このゲームは難しいです。
難解だと言う人もいれば、不可能だと言う人もいます。
しかし、すべてのパズルは論理的に解けるよう設計されています。

脳トレや思考ゲーム、自分の限界に挑むことが好きな方なら、きっと居心地の良さを感じるはずです。

tw.description:
Game is Hard (遊戲好難） 並不是你典型的益智遊戲應用程式。這是一場純粹的腦力益智體驗，專為喜歡挑戰的玩家設計。
憑藉其巧妙且極簡的風格與意想不到的互動，它融合了腦力遊戲、邏輯與裝置探索元素，打造一系列極具挑戰性的關卡。

每個謎題都違反規則——沒有華麗動畫，猜謎也沒有獎勵。只有你、你的心靈，以及一個看似簡單的任務，卻可能隱藏著一個絕妙、
幾乎不可能的解決方案。無論你喜歡策略、問答遊戲，還是智商測試挑戰，《遊戲困難》都邀請你考驗你的耐心、洞察力與毅力。

這不是關於反應快的問題。這是關於緩慢且有條理的進步。有些關卡需要安靜。有些則需要移動。許多問題看似無解——直到不再如此。這裡是深度思考與大膽實驗的場所。需要時會提供提示，但進度總是靠努力獲得。

如果你喜歡腦力測試遊戲、邏輯謎題、智商測驗、白痴測試或腦筋急轉彎等遊戲，並且喜歡剖析一個精彩且棘手的任務，這款遊戲絕對適合你。 它獎勵那些持不同想法的人——好奇、聰明、默默固執的人。

全線支援離線遊戲，讓你隨時隨地都能遊玩——非常適合無需無線網路遊戲、無需網路遊戲或長時間旅行時段。無論你是在飛行模式還是深處地下，所有謎題都依然可玩。
沒錯——這真的很難。事實上，有人說這很困難，也有人說不可能。但每個謎題都是有目的的，可以用邏輯來解開。如果你喜歡腦力訓練、心理遊戲，或只是喜歡挑戰自己的極限，你會找到屬於自己的家。

每一關都像是一個黑色謎團，一個裝滿秘密的盒子等待被解開。你會嘗試聲音、光線、旋轉和壓力——甚至等待。這個盒子不容易打開。但當它出現時，滿足感無與倫比。
這款遊戲專為經典與現代益智遊戲愛好者設計，避開了典型手機趣味遊戲的喧囂，反而專注於清晰度、挑戰性與有意義的互動。沒有時間壓力。沒有廣告。沒有聲音。只是尊重你智慧的深層謎題。

無論你認為自己是天才、衝動解決問題者，還是單純喜歡腦力測試的人，這款遊戲都邀請你嘗試。再試一次。也許......最後，成功。
特色：
• 手工打造的腦力謎題關卡，解決巧妙且合乎邏輯
• 有提示—但從不明顯
• 完全離線運作—非常適合無無線遊戲與自由遊玩
• 極簡、平面設計，無干擾

kr.description:
Game is Hard는 전형적인 퍼즐 앱이 아닙니다.

도전을 사랑하는 플레이어를 위해 설계된 순수한 두뇌 퍼즐 경험입니다.

영리하고 미니멀한 스타일과 예상치 못한 상호작용으로, 두뇌 게임, 논리, 기기 기반 탐험의 요소를 결합하여 엄청나게 어려운 레벨 모음을 제공합니다.

모든 퍼즐은 규칙을 깨트립니다 —

화려한 애니메이션도, 추측에 대한 보상도 없습니다.

오직 당신과 당신의 마음, 그리고 천재적이고 거의 불가능한 해결책을 숨기고 있는 것처럼 보이는 간단한 작업이 있을 뿐입니다.

전략, 퀴즈 게임, IQ 테스트 도전에 관심이 있다면 이 게임은 당신의 인내, 지각, 지속력을 테스트하도록 초대합니다.

빠른 반사 신경이 아닌, 느리고 체계적인 진행이 중요합니다.

일부 레벨은 침묵을 요구하고, 다른 레벨은 움직임을 필요로 하며, 많은 퍼즐은 해결 불가능해 보입니다. — 하지만 결국은 해결할 수 있습니다.

깊은 사고와 대담한 실험을 위한 공간입니다.

필요 시 힌트가 제공되지만, 진행은 항상 스스로의 노력으로 얻어야 합니다.

두뇌 테스트 게임, 논리 퍼즐, IQ 테스트, 바보 테스트 또는 두뇌장치 게임을 즐긴 적이 있다면, 그리고 어려운 퀘스트를 해부하는 것을 좋아한다면 이 게임은 당신을 위한 것입니다.

이 게임은 다르게 생각하는 사람들에게 보상을 줍니다. — 호기심 많은 사람, 똑똑한 사람, 조용히 고집 센 사람들을 위한 게임입니다.

오프라인 게임을 완벽 지원하므로 언제 어디서나 플레이할 수 있습니다.

— 인터넷이 없는 게임이나 긴 여행 세션에 적합합니다.

비행기 모드나 깊은 지하에 있어도 모든 퍼즐은 해결 가능합니다.

네, 정말 어렵습니다.

어떤 이들은 어렵다고 하고, 어떤 이들은 불가능하다고 합니다.

그러나 모든 퍼즐은 목적을 가지고 있으며 논리로 해결할 수

kr.description:
레벨이 있는 성경 퀴즈와 성경 퀴즈 게임을 즐겨보세요! 성경 퀴즈는 성경에 대한 지식을 테스트하고 재미있는 방법으로 성경에 대해 더 많이 배울 수 있도록 만들어졌습니다.

성경 퀴즈는 기독교인과 신자들을 위한 흥미진진한 성경 퀴즈 게임입니다! 도전적인 신구약 성경 무료 퀴즈 게임을 즐겨보세요! 흥미롭고 지적인 질문과 답변은 기독교에 대한 모든 중요한 사실을 배우는 데 도움이 될 것입니다. 성경 게임을 좋아하신다면, 이 앱은 완벽한 과거 시간 앱입니다!

플레이 방법:
객관식 문제에서 정답 버튼을 탭하세요;
제한된 시간 안에 정답을 선택해야 합니다; 당신은 그것을 에이스 할 수 있습니까?
각 레벨마다 3개의 질문이 있으며, 전체 레벨이 완료되면 신비한 보상을 받게 됩니다;

특징:
6500개 이상의 성경 관련 질문.
쉽고 빠르게 플레이할 수 있습니다.
도전적이고 흥미롭습니다.
재미있게 성경을 즐기면서 성경을 즐기세요.
매일 매일 보상과 코인.
어른과 어린이 모두를 위한 성경 퀴즈.
언제 어디서나 오프라인 또는 온라인으로 무료 성경 퀴즈 게임을 플레이하세요.

us.description:
Puzzlit is a daily puzzle app with a social twist. Every night at midnight ET you get a fresh set of mini puzzles (crosswords, logic grids, word games and more), then compare your scores with friends on the feed. And when Puzzlit Live goes on air, you can go head-to-head with everyone at once.

PUZZLIT LIVE
Join scheduled live puzzle contests where everyone plays the same puzzles at the same time. Survive round after round as players are eliminated, watch the rankings update in real time, chat with the crowd, and compete for prizes.

WORD PUZZLES
Cross It: a quick daily mini crossword.
Chain It: guess each word in a word-association chain.
Spell It: spin the letter columns to spell the hidden word.
Find It: trace hidden words through a twisting letter grid.
Word It: find 3, 4 and 5+ letter words in a 4x4 grid.
Emote It: decode a word or phrase from a row of emojis.

LOGIC PUZZLES
Box It:

us.description:
Someone always gets exposed. Someone always loses. The only question is who will be holding the phone when the bomb goes off.

Boomit Party combines pass-the-phone gameplay, Most Likely questions, party challenges, and a ticking bomb mechanic to create a different experience every round —for any group, anywhere, any night. No cards. No setup. One phone. Let's go.

GAME MODES
Pass It On: The phone moves around the group. Read the prompt, answer fast, and keep passing. Whoever holds it when the bomb explodes loses the round. Simple. Tense. Impossible to put down.
Be Exposed: Everyone votes anonymously on a question. The person with the most votes gets revealed. Find out what your friends really think — whether you're ready for it or not.
Team Rush: Split into teams and race through challenges, categories, and rapid-fire rounds. The bomb is still ticking. Work fast or lose together.

MOST L

us.description:
Would you rather is a casual trivia game where you can get to know your friends better while making very hard choices the whole night.

It's similar to “Never Have I Ever”, “Truth or Dare” and other party games.

Make your way through the questions, make impossible choices, this or that? The choice is yours.

There are 6 different decks filled with questions in the game that will help you use this game as an ideal:

- This or that
- Conundrum game
- For slumber party
- Party game for 2

Questions range from innocent and lovely to very difficult.

FEATURES
-	6 decks
-	850+ questions
-	Dirty question
-	Questions for kids
-	Ability to make your own custom cards

If you are playing the game with kids make sure you don’t play with adult decks.

Would you Rather? Adult subscription:
- Gives user instant access to all existing and future cards and removes all ads.
- Subscriptions are from $2.99

jp.trackName: コネクト ボールズ - マッチング ライン パズル -
jp.description:
線が交差しないように、同じボールを線で繋いでください。

「コネクト ボールズ」は、頭が良くなるボールリンクパズルです！
単純だけど癖になるラインコネクトパズルゲームです。
通勤時間や寝る前の空き時間に脳トレをお楽しみください。

この楽しみながらリラックスできるパズルゲームは、同じボール同士を他の線と交差することなく、線でつなぐことができれば成功です。

ボールからボールへ、線を引くだけのとても簡単なゲームです。
しかし、油断は禁物です。
簡単に見えるステージなのに、なぜかクリアできないという奥深さを感じることでしょう。

今すぐ挑戦して、脳を活性化させましょう！

ルール：
* 同じボール同士を線でつなぐ
* すべてのボールを線で繋ぐことができればゲームクリア
* 線は交差してはいけません
* 困ったらヒントを使いましょう
* 一度慣れると、時間を忘れてしまうので、要注意です

時間を忘れて、コネクトラインパズルに没頭してみませんか？
きっとやみつきになるはずです！
あなたはいくつのレベルをクリアできますか？

us.description:
Would You Rather is a fun and addicting game where you have to choose between two difficult scenarios. 

Pick a side, then see how the rest of the world voted. Would You Rather is the party game of impossible choices, with over 1,000 hand-picked questions to argue about.

HOW IT WORKS
• Read two options and tap the one you'd choose
• See the live percentage of players who picked each side
• Tap to move on to the next dilemma

WHY PLAYERS LOVE IT
• 1,000+ questions, from silly to seriously difficult
• Real votes from players around the world
• Two modes: Normal for everyone, Adult for grown-up game nights
• Works offline, so it's ready for road trips and flights
• Simple, colourful design that's easy to pass around a room

PERFECT FOR
• Parties and game nights
• Family dinners and long car journeys
• Breaking the ice with new people
• Settling who your friends really are

Questions for couples and date-night card games — 15 packs of deep questions, couple prompts, and would-you-rather.

------------------------------

------------------------------

us.description:
Play heads up with family and friends in an amazing charades and guessing game!

How to play charades in Charades App - Party Game?
Choose a deck from over 100 decks available to play or create your own deck and play as you wish! Place device on forehead e ask your friends to help you guess what is on your device! They can dance, sing, mimes or give you clues... Play whatever you want! Just tilting your phone up (correct) or down (pass) to continue. Easy, right? You just need to guess the word or phrase and guess what your are!

Charades App - Party Game includes decks as
- Guess Movies, TV Series, Cartoons, Animes and TV Shows.
- Guess Songs of today, Cartoons opening themes and more!
- Guess Characters from movies, games, books and cartoons!
- Guess music of your favorite artist!
- DotA 2, League of Legends, The Walking Dead, Game of Thrones, Glee, Supernatural, RBD, High School Musica

有名なソーシャルゲーム（Heads Up / Charades）と単語推測、完全に日本語で、60を超える現代的および現在の模倣テーマがあります。そしてそれはインターネットなしで動作します
 
ゲーム「Heads Up」の日本語版。友達と遊んだり、家族と遊んだりするのに最適！ 
 
友達や家族を招待して、一緒に遊ぼう！
テーマを選択するか、独自のテーマを作成し、スマートフォンを額に置いて、友達に模倣したりヒントを与えたりして推測を手伝ってもらいます。は簡単だ！ 
 
CharadesApp - あなたの額にあなたの電話で言葉を推測します（友人や家族との占い）は、友達や家族と遊ぶ楽しい単語推測ゲームです！ 2人以上のゲーム、グループのゲーム、ダブルスのゲーム、クリスマスでのプレー、家族とのプレー、カップルでのプレー、友人とのプレー、インターネットなしでのオフライン作業にも最適！プレイする人が増えるほど、笑いも増えます！
 
友達と遊んだり、家族と遊んだりしよう！ 60種類以上のテーマから選択してプレイしたり、独自のテーマを作成したりして、CharadasApp-Heads Upをプレイしましょう！ 
 
使い方？
1. 60以上の利用可能なオプションから再生するテーマを選択するか、独自のテーマを作成して推測してください！ 
2. [再生]をクリックして、スマートフォンを額に置きます。 
3. 友達は、模倣したり、ヒントを与えたり、歌ったり、踊ったり、絵を描いたり、言葉を推測するまで何を書いたか尋ねたりできます。 
4. 単語を推測したら、話して電話を傾けてください！わからない場合は、スマートフォンを下に傾けます。 
  
いくつかのテーマから選択して模倣したり、独自のテーマを作成して推測したりできます。笑う準備をしてください！ 
 
遊び方を工夫しましょう！ 
あなたが合うと思うように言葉を推測してください！テーマを選択した後、スマートフォンを額に置き、友達に模倣、ヒント、歌、ダンス、ドローなど、言葉を推測するための何かを頼みます。

·個人化您的地圖：設定自訂旗幟、選擇獨特顏色，或使用您自己的照片作為任何區域的背景。

kr.description:
역사를 다시 쓰거나 판타지 제국을 처음부터 건설하고 싶었던 적이 있으신가요? A+ World Map Editor Sandbox에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 현실 세계를 새롭게 창조할 수 있는 힘을 가진 곳입니다!

A+ World Map Editor Sandbox는 지도 제작자, 세계관 제작자, 그리고 대체 역사 팬을 위한 최고의 창작 도구입니다. 강력한 샌드박스를 통해 상세하고 정확한 실제 세계 지도를 기반으로 자신만의 지구를 디자인하고, 맞춤 설정하고, 탐험할 수 있는 완벽한 제어 기능을 제공합니다. 인터넷 연결 없이도 만들고, 실험하고, 플레이할 수 있습니다.

A+ World Map Editor Sandbox로 무엇을 할 수 있을까요?

·현실에서 시작: 모든 프로젝트의 시작점으로 고품질의 실제 세계 지도를 사용하세요.

·완벽한 오프라인 액세스: 여행이나 브레인스토밍에 안성맞춤인 이 앱은 인터넷 연결 없이도 작동하도록 설계되었습니다.

·완벽한 제어: 국가, 지방, 도시, 바다의 이름을 바꾸세요. 나만의 세계, 나만의 이름.

·경계 다시 그리기: 국경을 쉽게 그리고 편집하세요. 국가를 합병하여 제국을 건설하거나 대륙을 분할하여 전쟁 중인 국가로 만들 수 있습니다.

·지도 개인 설정: 원하는 지역의 배경으로 사용자 지정 깃발을 설정하고, 고유한 색상을 선택하거나, 직접 찍은 사진을 사용할 수 있습니다.

·2D 및 3D 탐험: 정교한 평면 지도와 완벽하게 회전하는 멋진 지구본을 자유롭게 전환할 수 있습니다.

Name 3 things in 5 seconds. Sounds easy, until the clock starts!

5 Second Guess is the fast, loud party game for friends and family. Pass the phone, read the question, and blurt out three answers before the timer runs out. Everyone else decides if you nailed it or failed it.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Add your players and pick the number of rounds
2. Read the question, tap Start, and name 3 things in 5 seconds
3. The group votes: Nailed It or Failed It
4. Most points at the end wins

- Hundreds of quick-fire questions
- Up to 20 players on one phone
- Choose from 1 to 10 rounds

- Family friendly mode for all ages
- No setup, no cards, no internet needed to play

us.trackName: How Well Do You Know Me?
us.description:
How well do you really know your best friend or partner? Find out in minutes.

How Well Do You Know Me? is a two player quiz game played on one phone. Answer questions about yourself, then pass the phone and see if the other person can guess what you said.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Answer 10 questions about yourself.
2. Pass the phone. Your friend or partner tries to guess your answers.
3. See your score out of 10, then check which answers they got right and wrong.

Want a rematch? Swap roles on the same quiz and find out who knows who best.

- Normal: 18 quizzes that are fun for everyone
- Adult Mode: 12 quizzes with spicier questions for adults

- Couples: a Mr and Mrs style quiz for date night.
- Best friends: settle who really knows who.
- Parties, road trips and family get togethers.

Vous vous demandez si vous connaissez bien vos amis ou votre partenaire? Si c'est le cas, c'est l'application idéale pour vous. 

Apprenez-en plus sur la Personnalité de vos amis.

Ce jeu calcule à quel point vous connaissez vos amis ou votre partenaire en répondant à une série de questions. Vous devez d'abord répondre à 15 questions, puis vous devez laisser l'autre personne avec qui vous jouez répondre aux mêmes questions, en essayant d'obtenir les bonnes réponses. A la fin, vous obtiendrez un score total basé sur leurs réponses. 

Connaissez-vous vraiment votre meilleur ami? Connaissez-vous vraiment votre partenaire ? Faites le test aujourd'hui pour le découvrir! 

Ce quiz est idéal pour les couples.

us.description:
لعبة برا السالفة لعبة جماعية مليئة بالضحك اعرف مين من أصحابك أو عائلتك محترف في ترقيع السالفة وخبير في التصريف. اجمعهم والعبوا "برا السالفة" واستمتعوا بأجواء طقطقة وضحك في أفضل العاب جماعيه تناسب كل جلسه مع الأصدقاء أو العائلة.

مين فيكم بيقفط النصّاب؟ ومين يقدر يمثّل ويضلل مثل ألعاب امبوستر أو لعبة الجاسوس؟ هنا التحدي الحقيقي في العاب تحديات تعتمد على الذكاء والتصريف.

● طريقة اللعب:
— اجمع أصحابك أو عائلتك
— اختار نوع السالفة (الموضوع) مثل مسلسلات أو أكلات أو أنمي وغيرها
— إذا كنت داخل السالفة حاول تكتشف الشخص خارج السالفه بأسئلة ذكية
— اسأل أسئلة تحجيرية بدون ما تفضح السالفة
— ركّز على إجابات البقية واكشف التناقض
— إذا كنت برا السالفة حاول تفهم الموضوع من أسئلة واجوبة البقية

● أجواء تحدي وضحك
استمتعوا بجو من الطقطقة والتحدي في لعبة جماعية خفيفة وسريعة تناسب كل جلسه.

● العب بدون نت

us.description:
«مين الأطليسي؟» لعبة جماعية للسهرات والعيلة والأصحاب: لعبة أسئلة ومسابقات بين فريقين، بتنلعبوها بنفس القعدة بدون نت، أو أونلاين من أي مكان.

ينزل السؤال، والأجوبة مرتّبة حسب شو قالوا الناس. مش المهم شو بتعرف، المهم شو بيقولوا الناس! احزروا الجواب الأشهر قبل الفريق التاني.

كيف بتنلعب:
• جهاز واحد (موبايل أو تابلت) بيصير لوح اللعبة، متل برامج المسابقات عالتلفزيون.
• كل لاعب بيدخل من موبايله وبيصير عنده زر.
• فريقين، وبكل جولة لاعب من كل فريق بيتواجهوا: أول واحد بيكبس بيجاوب.
• الفريق اللي بيربح المواجهة بيقرّر: بيلعب ولا بيمرّر.
• تلات غلطات، وبتروح الفرصة للفريق التاني يسرق النقاط.

ليش رح تحبّوها:
• بنفس القعدة بدون إنترنت: كل الأجهزة على نفس الواي فاي أو الهوتسبوت وبس، والغرفة بتظهر لحالها. بتنفع بالبيت، بالرحلة، وبأي قعدة.
• أونلاين من أي مكان: افتح غرفة، ابعت الرابط على الواتساب، وادخلوا مكالمة جماعية حتى تسمعوا بعض.
• بدون تسجيل: افتح والعب. الحساب اختياري، بس لحفظ المشتريات.
• مضاع

• كل لاعب بيدخل من موبايله وبيصير عنده زر.
• فريقين، وبكل جولة لاعب من كل فريق بيتواجهوا: أول واحد بيكبس بيجاوب.
• الفريق اللي بيربح المواجهة بيقرّر: بيلعب ولا بيمرّر.
• تلات غلطات، وبتروح الفرصة للفريق التاني يسرق النقاط.

ليش رح تحبّوها:
• بنفس القعدة بدون إنترنت: كل الأجهزة على نفس الواي فاي أو الهوتسبوت وبس، والغرفة بتظهر لحالها. بتنفع بالبيت، بالرحلة، وبأي قعدة.
• أونلاين من أي مكان: افتح غرفة، ابعت الرابط على الواتساب، وادخلوا مكالمة جماعية حتى تسمعوا بعض.
• بدون تسجيل: افتح والعب. الحساب اختياري، بس لحفظ المشتريات.
• مضاع

Trivia Blocksと一緒に、木のぬくもりを感じる知識の世界へ踏み出しましょう。クラシックなボードゲームの雰囲気からインスピレーションを得たクイズゲームで、興味深い問題に答えながらレベルをクリアし、さまざまなジャンルの知識を試すことができます。

歴史や科学から地理、ポップカルチャー、スポーツまで、Trivia Blocksには何千もの問題と多彩なチャレンジが用意されており、どのレベルでも楽しみながら挑戦できます。さまざまなゲームモードをプレイし、特別な目標を達成しながら、ゲームを進めて知識を身につけましょう。

Trivia Blocksが最高のクイズゲームである理由は？

* クラシックな木製スタイル：クラシックな木製ボードゲームを思わせる、温かみのあるミニマルなインターフェースをお楽しみください。

* 挑戦しがいのあるクイズ：さまざまなカテゴリーの興味深い問題で、あなたの知識を試しましょう。

* 多彩なゲームモード：さまざまな遊び方を楽しみ、ゲームを進めながら新たなチャレンジに挑戦しましょう。

* 実績と目標：特別なタスクを達成し、さまざまな目標をクリアして、進行に応じた報酬を獲得しましょう。

* スマートヒントと追加ライフ：難しい問題で行き詰まりましたか？獲得したコインを使って便利なヒントや追加ライフを手に入れ、ゲームを続けましょう。

* デイリーチャレンジ：毎日ゲームに戻って特別なタスクをクリアし、連続記録を維持してボーナス報酬を獲得しましょう。

Trivia Blocksは、単なる手軽なクイズゲームではありません。知識を試し、さまざまな分野を極め、次々と登場する興味深いチャレンジに挑戦したいプレイヤーのための、本格的なクイズゲームです。

Trivora is a trivia app built to help you grow your knowledge, enjoy great quizzes and compete with players around the world.

Learn:

us.description:
Farflung is a daily geography game where the obvious answer won't get you far.

Every day brings five prompts, the same for every player. Each one has several right countries. Tap the unlabelled map, zoom in for small places, and drop your pin. There's no clock.

A right answer earns more the fewer people would think of it. Pin the postcard answer and you'll travel 40 km. Find the gem and you'll travel 100. Pin a wrong country and you stay where you are, so the safe answer is always tempting.

- Five new prompts every day
- A plain map with no labels to lean on
- Five tiers, from Postcard to Gem
- A perfect day is 500 km
- Keep a streak and fill your logbook
- Add friends and see their stamps on your route
- Colour in every country you visit on your own map
- Share your trip without spoiling the answers
- Play any past day from the archive

us.description:
Globle Game: Guess the Country is the ultimate geography guessing game for map lovers, travelers, students, and trivia fans!

Every day, a new Mystery Country awaits. Your mission is simple: find the hidden country using clues from your previous guesses. The closer your guess is to the target country, the hotter its color will appear on the globe.

Challenge your geography knowledge, improve your world map skills, and compete with friends to solve the daily puzzle in the fewest guesses possible!

- How to Play
 Enter Your First Guess

Start by typing the name of any country in the world. Your selected country will appear on the globe, and you'll receive clues to help guide your next guess.

- Follow the Hints

So you think you understand this thing you’re holding? Think again. Stop tapping. Stop swiping. In fact, stop touching the screen at all. To crack Blackbox’s puzzles you’ll need to find solitude and stillness, climb mountains, call on friends, get in tune with the cosmos, and think outside the box.

Minimalistic visual clues make for incredibly satisfying “Aha!” moments, while sonic interfaces provide an extra level of guidance and nuance that makes Blackbox accessible with or without vision. Thoughtful haptic feedback, Easter eggs on Easter eggs, and solutions that can’t be found beneath the glass of your screen redefine what a puzzle can be. jp.description:
今手に持ってるものを本当に理解しているって思うんだね？
もう一度考えてみて。タップをやめて、スワイプも止めて。画面にも全く触らないでさ。君は問題を解くために、静寂と孤独を知り、山を登って、友達に聞いて、宇宙の声に耳を傾けて、そして何よりも、既成の枠にとらわれないことが必要だろう。

とてもシンプルなビジュアルヒントは驚くほど気持ちがいい「なるほど！」を、
サウンドインターフェースはブラックボックスをもっと楽しいものに、そして君をもっとこのゲームに引き込むよ。

じっくりとデザインされたヒント、隠しメッセージの中のさらに隠されたメッセージ、そして画面の中だけでは見つからない解決法、それらは君のパズルの概念を変えること間違いなし。

君はもう2度とデバイスを同じようには見られないだろう。

自分は賢いと思う？それなら、証明してみせて。

（このゲームはライアン・マックロードのもと、常に進化し続けています。コーヒーを飲んだり、ブリトーを食べたりしていない時は、ライアンはブラックボックスの新しい問題をデザインし、より良くするのに忙しくやっています。)

tw.description:
你覺得已經對手上拎著嘅呢部嘢好熟悉？真係？

試下唔好再篤它碌它，索性完全唔好再掂個 Mon 啦。要破解《黑盒》嘅謎題，你需要靜下心神、翻山越嶺、呼朋喚友、並且同天地連線。想過關，你就要跳出思想嘅框框。

《黑盒》內極簡主義嘅視覺提示令你喺矛塞頓開，不由自主驚呼 ”哦~” 嘅一刻滿足感爆棚。細膩嘅聲音提示令你即使咪埋眼亦能體驗《黑盒》嘅樂趣。通過精心設計嘅震動回報、環環相扣嘅彩蛋，以及突破螢幕限制嘅過關方法，《黑盒》重新定義解謎遊戲。你將會以全新角度看待你手上嘅電話。

你覺得自己係個醒目仔？證明嚟睇下~

（《黑盒》係一個由Ryan McLeod設計，仍然持續開發緊嘅遊戲。 如果佢唔係食緊墨西哥捲餅，又唔係飲緊咖啡，咁佢一定係忙緊設計《黑盒》嘅新關卡。）

■

kr.description:
지금 손에 들고있는 이거, 이게 뭔지 잘 안다고 생각하세요? 다시 잘 생각해 보세요. 탭하지 마세요. 스와이프하지 마세요. 아니 그냥, 화면을 터치하는 것 조차 멈추세요. Blackbox의 퍼즐을 풀려면, 우선 고독과 고요함을 찾으셔야 합니다. 산도 타고, 친구들도 부르고, 우주의 기운과 주파수도 맞추고, 상자의 밖에서 생각해야만 합니다.

미니멀한 시각적 단서들에 더해, 미세한 소리를 들어가면서도 조작할 수 있는 인터페이스는 Blackbox의 화면이 보이든 안 보이든 상관 없이 플레이할 수 있게 해 줍니다. 퍼즐을 풀었을 때 비로소 느낄 수 있는 통쾌한 "아하!"의 순간들을 경험해보세요. 섬세한 햅틱 피드백, 이스터 에그 속의 이스터 에그, 유리 밑의 화면상으로는 절대 찾을 수 없는 해답들이 퍼즐의 정의를 새로 씁니다. 여러분의 스마트폰을 완전히 새로운 시각으로 보게 될 거예요.

두뇌 싸움에 자신이 있으세요? 증명해보세요.

(Blackbox는 Ryan McLeod에 의해 지금도 활발하게 개발되고 있는, 살아있는 게임입니다. Ryan은 부리또를 먹거나 커피를 마실 때를 제외하고는 항상 새로운 Blackbox 챌린지를 디자인하고 개발하느라 바쁘다고 합니다.)

■

答對每道問題都能獲得相應積分。回答錯誤，沒有積分。

問題提示道具：
“雙倍機會” - 激活這一提示道具後，選擇答案。如果回答錯誤，將獲得再答一次的機會。
“一半一半” - 消除一道題目中的兩個錯誤答案。
“多數投票” - 可以看到多數玩家選擇的答案是什麼。
“跳過問題” - 激活這一提示道具可以跳過當前題目，用另外一題代替。


如有任何問題或建議，請通過support@quizz.land聯繫我們。

kr.description:
QuizzLand는 40,000개 이상의 고급 일반상식 문제와 상세한 해설을 함께 제공하는 무료 학습용 게임으로, 타 게임앱보다 삽입 광고가 적다는 장점이 있습니다.

QuizzLnad는 1인 플레이가 가능하기 때문에 다른 플레이어의 응답을 기다릴 필요가 없습니다.

자신의 일반상식도 확인하고 친구와 함께 최고의 두뇌를 가리는 즐거운 경쟁도 할 수 있는 쉽고 간편한 게임을 지금 즐겨보세요!

장점

• 흥미진진한 학습 과정
• 빠른 하트 자동 생성 속도
• 자세한 정답 해설 제공
• 초급, 중급, 고급으로 구분된 문제 난이도
• 가족 모두가 즐길 수 있는 재미있는 퀴즈 게임

QuizzLand를 통해 쉽고 간편하게 공부하세요!

*******************************
게임 플레이 방법

나의 지식을 확인해보세요: 정답도 맞추고, 해설도 읽고, 다른 플레이어와 유익한 경쟁까지!
정답을 맞출 때마다 포인트가 지급됩니다. 오답일 경우에는 포인트가 지급되지 않습니다.

정답:

- 모든 문제에는 문제별 난이도가 설정되어 있습니다.
- 난이도가 높은 문제를 맞추면 더 많은 포인트가 지급됩니다.

코인과 하트:

코인은 QuizzLand 게임에서 사용되는 화폐입니다. 코인으로 하트와 힌트, 그 밖의 다른 옵션을 구매할 수 있습니다.
- 오답일 때마다 하트가 하나씩 사라집니다. 하트는 스크린 왼쪽 상단에 표시됩니다.
- 게임 플레이에 필요한 하트는 시간이 지나면 자동 생성되지만, 코인으로 바로 구매할 수도 있습니다.

힌트:

"더블 찬스" - 해당 힌트를 누르면 두 번의 응답 기회가 주어집니다. 첫 번째 답이 오답일 경우 한번 더 정답을 선택할 수 있습니다.
"50:50" - 문제에 제시된 오답 두 개를 제거하여 정답 확률이 50:50으로 높아집니다.
"다수표" - 다른 플레이

jp.trackName: ブレインテスト(Brain Test) 4：ひっかけ友達
jp.description:
Brain Test 4 では、新キャラクター、新しいカスタマイズメカニクス、そして最も重要な点に、すべて刷新された難問の数々が登場します。基本に戻るオリジナル「Brain Test 1」方式に、大量の難問を加え、更新しています。トリッキークラブに参加して、全メンバーをアンロックし、困難な状況にいる彼らの手助けをしましょう。

おしゃまなリリーや宇宙飛行犬など、多彩なメンバーが揃った「Brain Test 4's Tricky Club」では、あなたが史上最難解パズルを解く時を待っています。さあ、知恵を絞り、知性を広げましょう。

特徴：
● 難解＆おどろきの脳試し
● 意表をつくなぞなぞ
● パズルの予想外な解決策
● トリッキークラブシステムとアンロック可能なキャラクター
● キャラクターと環境のカスタマイズオプション
● ファンにはたまらないBrain Testのアートスタイルとアニメーションキャラクター

● 片手でプレイ可能
● オフラインでプレイ可能
● 完全無料ダウンロード＆無料プレイ

fr.description:
Dans Brain Test 4, découvrez de tout nouveaux personnages, de nouvelles options de personnalisation et surtout, de nouvelles énigmes. Retour aux sources avec la formule originale de Brain Test 1, avec une bonne dose de complexité en plus. Rejoignez le Club Facétie, débloquez tous ses membres et aidez-les à surmonter toutes les situations.

Brain Test 4 est adapté pour les vétérans de Brain Test qui cherchent des niveaux difficiles. Ne faites pas confiance à ce que vous voyez et réfléchissez bien ! Utilisez le système d’indices graduels en cas de problème. Profitez d’une expérience complexe, mais agréable et accessible.

Avec ses membres originaux comme Lily Facétie et Thomouaf, le Club Facétie de Brain Test 4 vous ouvre grand ses portes. Faites travailler vos méninges !

● Des casse-têtes difficiles et palpitants.
● Des énigmes surprenantes.
● Des solutions inattendues

kr.description:
Brain Test 4는 새로운 캐릭터, 새로운 사용자 지정 메커니즘, 그리고 가장 중요한 완전히 새로운 두뇌 티저를 제공합니다. 우리는 Brain Test 1 엄청난 양의 교묘한 원래 공식을 '기본으로 돌아가기'로 새로 거듭나고 있습니다. 교묘한 클럽에 가입해 모든 맴버를 잠금 해제하고 까다로운 상황을 극복하도록 도와주세요.

Brain Test 4는 풀기 어려운 교묘한 퍼즐을 찾고 있는 두뇌 테스트 고수들을 위한 게임입니다. 겉보기와 다른 것은 없고 모든 것이 당신의 두뇌를 속일 것입니다. 하지만 이 게임은 게임을 진행하는 데 도움이 되는 유용한 힌트 시스템이 준비되어 있습니다. 난이도가 높지만 즐겁고 접근 가능한 경험을 해보세요.

Brain Test 4의 교묘한 클럽은 교묘한 릴리와 우주 개와 같은 다채로운 멤버로 구성된 역대 가장 까다로운 퍼즐이 여러분이 해결해 주기만을 기다리고 있습니다. 지혜를 짜내고 마음을 넓힐 시간입니다!

특징:
● 까다롭고 놀라운 두뇌 티저입니다.
● 놀라운 수수께끼.
● 예상치 못한 퍼즐 해결.
● 잠금 해제 가능한 캐릭터가 포함된 까다로운 클럽 시스템.
● 캐릭터 및 사용자 환경 지정 설정.
● 팬이 좋아하는 Brain Test 아트 스타일과 애니메이션 캐릭터.
● 수십 개의 레벨과 지속적인 새 레벨 업데이트.
● 유머러스한 대화와 흥미진진한 이야기.
● 가족 친화적인 게임 플레이. 모든 연령대를 위한 안전한 콘텐츠.
● 한 손으로 플레이할 수 있습니다.
● 오프라인 플레이가 가능합니다.
● 모두 무료로 다운로드하고 무료로 플레이할 수 있습니다.

us.description:

HOW A DIVE WORKS
• 7 prompts each day, a fresh set for everyone at the same time
• Name any answer that fits. Rare answers score big, common ones score small
• Your score turns into depth, so every dive ends with how far down you got
• Share your dive grid and compare with friends, without spoiling the answers

MORE WAYS TO DIVE
• Free dive: keep playing extra prompts after today's dive is done

Keep your streak going to unlock new dive buddies along the way, from a tiny krill all the way to the Mantis shrimp at a 100-day streak.

us.description:
Whoposted is a party game about how well you actually know your friends.

Everyone joins with their public username. Each round plays a video one of you reposted - and the rest have to guess who. Answer fast to score more. After a few rounds, the podium decides who really pays attention.

HOW IT WORKS
- One player creates a room and shares the 4-letter code
- 3 to 10 players join from their phones
- Each round plays a real repost from someone in the room
- Guess who reposted it; faster correct guesses are worth more
- A shareable scorecard at the end settles the argument

PARTY MODE
Put the game on a TV or laptop and use phones as controllers. The video plays on the big screen while everyone votes on their own device.

AUDIENCE ROOMS
Turn on an audience room and up to 100 spectators can watch through a public link and pick who they think will win. Good for streams.

NO ACCOUNTS, NO PURCH

tw.description:
開始一場屬於你的口袋冒險，體驗生活、愛情與自己專屬的可愛家居。

與心中最特別的人同住，是人生中最令人期待的經歷之一。新的篇章、新的家、新的寵物……這是什麼？一個空房間？太小了……可是好可愛！

不過你要睡在哪裡呢？不用擔心！有你的夥伴在！兩雙手一起會讓一切變得更容易！再加上可愛的腳掌也很不錯。愛貓人還是愛狗人？！由你來選擇！

以各種家具、電器與裝飾打造你的新家！依你的需要量身打造每個房間，或是從我們精選的眾多家具組合中挑選一款。選擇無窮！

體驗愛情，讓你的相冊中充滿可愛的時刻！與有趣的鄰居互動，以最舒適的床與各種玩具疼惜寵物，像一對可愛的情侶一樣一起體驗每日生活！

fr.description:
Commence ton aventure remplie de vie et d'amour dans ta maison de poche.

Emménager avec cette personne si spéciale pour toi est l'une des plus excitantes expériences de vie. Nouveau chapitre, nouvelle maison, nouvel animal de compagnie... Qu'est-ce que c'est ? Une pièce vide ? C'est si petit... et si ADORABLE !

Mais il n'y a rien pour dormir ? Pas d'inquiétude ! Ton partenaire a pensé à tout ! Tout est plus simple à quatre mains. Et encore plus avec quatre pattes. Alors, plutôt chien ou chat ? À toi de choisir !

Aménage ton nouveau foyer avec un large choix de mobilier, d'électroménager et de décorations. Personnalise chaque pièce selon tes goûts ou opte pour l'un de nos nombreux ensembles de mobilier. Les options sont sans limites !

Vis ton histoire d'amour et remplis les pages de ton album avec de doux souvenirs. Va à la rencontre de tes voisins, chouchoute ton animal de compagnie

kr.description:
생기와 사랑이 넘치고, 나만의 앙증맞은 집을 꾸밀 수 있는 포켓 사이즈 모험을 시작하세요.

소중한 사람과 같이 산다는 건 인생에서 가장 신나는 경험 중 하나예요. 새로운 챕터, 새로운 집, 새로운 반려동물, 그리고... 이건 뭐죠? 텅 빈 방? 너무 작은데... 하지만 사랑스러워요!

어디서 잠을 자죠? 걱정 마세요! 당신의 애인이 해결할 거예요! 손이 네 개라 일이 더 수월해져요! 두 개의 발바닥도 도움이 될 거예요. 고양이를 좋아하세요, 강아지를 좋아하세요? 원하는 반려동물을 선택하세요!

다양한 가구, 가전 용품과 장식으로 새로운 집을 꾸미세요! 마음대로 방을 꾸미거나 준비된 다양한 가구 세트 중 하나를 선택할 수도 있답니다. 선택에 제한은 없어요!

사랑을 시작하고 사랑스러운 순간들로 사진 앨범을 채우세요! 흥미로운 이웃을 만나고, 편안한 이부자리와 모든 종류의 장난감들로 반려동물을 보살피고, 귀여운 커플의 일상을 즐기세요!

어린이용 게임이 아니며 만 13세 이하 어린이들에게 부적절한 내용이 포함되어 있을 수 있습니다.

Would you rather is a party game where you decide between two horrible options, it's up to you to decide what would you rather do.

Would you Rather is created for party animals, teens, college students, college dropouts, bachelorettes and all the other party people that want to hang out and have some fun at a house party. 

Grab your friends and spend the night making hard choices.

Game can be played offline, without WIFI, and it consists of a bunch of cards you read to your friends.


-----! FEATURES !----- 

-	850+ Cards 
-	8 Packs 
-	Hours of getting to know your friends
-	For 2 players minimum
-	Hours of fun
-	Trillions of hours of fun


-----! HOW TO PLAY !-----


1. Grab some friends and sit in a circle (or stand, or don't be in a circle, who cares).
2. Read the sentences out loud.
3. Everybody picks one option. The option with less votes is the losing option.
4. The losing voter

us.description:
Who's the Imposter? One secret word. One faker. Total chaos.

Forget boring party games. Picoboom is the vibe check your group needs: chaotic, hilarious, and completely unhinged. And now it's home to the game your group won't stop playing: hunt down the Imposter before they fool the whole room.

Color Hunt: the mode everyone's filming
Picoboom shows a color, the countdown starts, and everyone scatters to find something that matches. Snap your find in the app, Picoboom scores how close the color is, and the closest match takes the win. Fast, chaotic, and made for a crowd.

Imposter, two ways to play
- Imposter Online: create a room, share the code, and play with friends from anywhere, each on their own phone (3 to 20 players)
- Pass and play: one phone, passed around the room (3+ players)
Everyone gets the same secret word, except the Imposter. Drop one-word clues, spot the faker, and vot

us.description:
Welcome to Mindblow: Guess the Word! Experience a word-guessing game like no other, where every image cleverly hides a word. Unlike other games, this game isn’t just a mix of stock images, but we've carefully created each level’s image to challenge your brain! Discover the word through a concept creatively depicted in each picture.

A New Kind of Puzzle: Forget what you know about word quiz games. In Mindblow: Guess the Word, each image has a special word for you to guess. It’s not just about looking at the picture, but understanding the clever idea behind it.

Can you guess the word implied in the picture?
- See a worm in a book? The word is "bookworm."
- A brick dressed as a superhero, running fast? Say hello to "breakfast."

Unique and Eye-Catching: Our images are unlike anything you’ve seen before. They’re not just pretty; they make you think and smile when you guess the word right.

kr.description:
엄청난 다운로드를 기록한 Brain Test: 교묘한 이야기는 모바일 게임을 재정립합니다. Brain Test 2와 함께 더 짜릿한 수수께끼와 더 재미있는 테스트를 지금 경험하세요! 두뇌게임 아이큐테스트. 성인을 위한 두뇌 게임과 수수께끼를 즐겨보세요.

Brain Test는 편안한 두뇌 활동을 위한 일련의 까다로운 두뇌 자극제가 포함된 중독성 무료 까다로운 두뇌 퍼즐 게임입니다. 이러한 오프라인 마인드 게임, 두뇌 게임, IQ 테스트, 사고 게임 및 퍼즐 게임은 두뇌 운동을 좋아하는 사람들에게 적합합니다!

당신의 생각을 뒤집을 새 퍼즐 게임에 매혹될 준비를 하세요. 새로운 버전에는 다양한 캐릭터의 이야기들이 가득합니다. 고양이 나비과 함께 아프리카의 왕을 물리치고, 수지와 농장을 경작하고, 시후와 괴물을 사냥하고 최종적으로 맞서 싸워 이기세요. 브레인아웃, 브레인 테스트! 이 게임은 새로운 게임이자 오프라인 게임입니다. 또한 세계 최고의 게임 중 하나입니다.

Brain Test는 교묘한 난제가 있는 중독성 강한 무료 퍼즐 게임입니다. 다양한 수수께끼가 당신에게 도전장을 내밀고 있습니다. 새 퍼즐 게임은 당신의 상식을 깨뜨리고 발상의 전환으로 두뇌운동을 하게 될 것입니다. 이 재미있고 중독성 강한 무료 IQ 게임으로 친구들과 함께 즐기세요. 퀴즈를 풀 준비되셨나요? 브레인아웃. 아이큐테스트. 두뇌 게임과 iq 게임은 두뇌 향상을 위한 것입니다. 오프라인에서 최고의 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.

낱말 놀이, 단어 검색 게임, 퍼즐, 스도쿠 또는 기타 퀴즈 게임의 팬이라면 Brain Test가 최선의 선택입니다! 넌센스퀴즈. 머리쓰는게임.

특징:

• 교묘하고도 놀라운 브레인 티저 : 속임수에 분명 넘어갈 걸요! iq테스트.
• 수많은 퀴즈와 고정관념을 깨부수는 정답들. 넌센스퀴즈.

us.description:
Your friends bet. Who knows you?

Gotcha is the party game where your friends bet on what you’ll answer. Then you answer for real. And the truth drops.

HOW IT WORKS
• One question, one face. “What does Kai do when they’re jealous?”
• Everyone bets on the answer. Kai answers for real.
• The fastest right bet takes 3 points, the next 2, then 1. Kai scores when someone reads them.
• Free-text rounds: you write your bet, the subject picks who nailed it.
• 2 to 10 players. A six-digit code, your phones. Or one on one.

YOU PLAY ON A FACE
No username. Your photo, your first name, and the others bet on you. At the end you know who reads you, and how well.

FOUR DECKS
• Discover — Start here. Learn each other. Free.
• BFF — Memories, habits, small betrayals.
• Couple — Plans, intimacy, what you never say.
• No filter — The forbidden ones. No way back.
Over 1,400 questions in English and French,

With the right learning methods, you can remember words faster. Spelling Quiz is a free, offline-friendly trivia game filled with enjoyable spelling challenges and useful word knowledge. Practice anytime, anywhere in a relaxed atmosphere, and strengthen your memory through continuous play.

- Daily rewards of generous chests and gems！
- Play for free, offline or online anytime, anywhere.
- Improve your vocabulary and test your knowledge!
- Various tools assist you in completing the puzzle.
- Global leaderboard, challenge the top！
- Well-crafted gameplay that helps you learn effectively.
- A must-have game for all word g

us.description:
Spell&Speak is a tribute to the 80's game that has thrilled generations and teach them to read and write and have fun playing with his unmistakable "voice". In this new digital version retains it's flavor and simplicity typical of the game.

It offers different game modes: Spell, Say It, Letter, Code and Mystery Word, during which each letter typed and spoken word is the corresponding display on the display.

For 3 years children and up, you can learn while having fun, is also suitable for all adults with a hint of nostalgia, remember the good times we had to play and learn.

Spell&Speak is an Universal App, therefore compatible with all devices and already optimized to work well even on the New iPad with retinal display


• Spell Game
To start the game press the letter corresponding to the level you want (there are four levels of increasing difficulty, from A to D), and finally press GO

us.description:
В игре вас ждут занимательные задачи на любой вкус: математические, логические, на «соображалку». 
Изначально игрок имеет 9 открытых задач. Для того, чтобы открыть следующий блок более сложных головоломок, необходимо решить 7 любых из 9 открытых. Чем дальше пользователь продвигается по цепочке задач, тем увлекательнее и сложней они становятся. 

Все задачки имеют комментарий и объяснение решения, однако игрок не может их видеть, пока не догадается до правильного ответа.


На протяжении пути к успеху игрока ждут достижения и награды, которые помогут соревноваться и лидировать среди всех игроков, вырываясь в топ! 

Эврика! – Эволюционируй!
«Эврика!» ©AllyTeam 2014.

Изначально игрок имеет 9 открытых задач. Для того, чтобы открыть следующий блок более сложных головоломок, необходимо решить 7 любых из 9 открытых. Чем дальше пользователь продвигается по цепочке задач, тем увлекательнее и сложней они становятся. 

Все задачки имеют комментарий и объяснение решения, однако игрок не может их видеть, пока не догадается до правильного ответа.


На протяжении пути к успеху игрока ждут достижения и награды, которые помогут соревноваться и лидировать среди всех игроков, вырываясь в топ! 

Эврика! – Эволюционируй!
«Эврика!» ©AllyTeam 2014.

us.description:
Two teams, one phone, and a pile of phrases you would never say in front of your mother. Shout clues, guess fast, and pass the phone before the buzzer catches you holding it.

HOW IT WORKS
Get your team to say the phrase on the screen. Talk, gesture, do whatever it takes. Guess it right and pass the phone along. When the buzzer goes off, whoever is holding it loses the round and the other team scores. First team to the target wins.

WHAT YOU GET
- 900+ phrases in the free core deck
- Four expansion packs, each with hundreds more
- Pick your buzzer, set the target score, choose which packs are in play
- Four or more players, one phone, no setup

THE PACKS
Even Dirtier - for groups that have already heard it all
Bachelorette Bash - built for the last night of freedom
Night Out - the bar, the group chat, and Monday's regrets
All Packs - unlocks every pack above, plus any pack we add in futu

us.description:
A relaxing 3D environment where you experience life as a rubber duck, Placid Plastic Duck Simulator is an experiment to induce calm and bliss. You're up for a reinvigorating stay at your favorite seaside pool.

You are not alone. Different ducks will slowly and happily fall into the pool with you, each with their own style and demeanor (you can name them and have names appear over their heads).

Float on the water, sunbathe, dip your beak, go down the slide. The radio is playing a nostalgic tune.
Here comes the night. Look at the stars. Turn off the radio, listen to the waves in the dark. Dream.
The sun is rising. The sky is blue. Slide down into the second pool.
An airplane is rushing somewhere, there's stuff to do.
Not for you.

Live in the present moment, enjoy life.

Everything is going to be alright.

Du bist nicht allein. Über 100 verschiedene Enten werden langsam und freudig in den Pool fallen und dir Gesellschaft leisten. Jede von ihnen hat ihr individuelles Aussehen und eigene Persönlichkeit. Zudem kannst du sie benennen, woraufhin ihre Namen über ihren Köpfen erscheinen.

Schwimm auf dem Wasser, bade in der Sonne, tauche deinen Schnabel ein, rutsch die Rutsche hinunter. Das Radio spielt nostalgische Melodien.
Die Nacht bricht herein. Schau dir die Sterne an. Schalte das Radio aus, verweile im Dunkeln während du den Wellen lauscht. Träume.
Die Sonne geht auf. Der Himmel ist blau. Rutsch runter in den zweiten Pool.
Ein Flugzeug fliegt vorbei, es gibt Dinge zu tun.
Jedoch nicht für dich.

jp.description:
3D空間でアヒルのおもちゃとしてリラックスした時間を過ごすゲーム。
[b]Placid Plastic Duck Simulator[/b]はお気に入りの海辺のプールで落ち着きと至福の時を誘う実験です。

一人ではありません。見た目や動きの異なるアヒルたちが楽しげにあなたの居るプールへと飛び込んで来ます。

水に浮かんだり、日光浴をしたり、くちばしを水につけたり、滑り台を滑ったりしましょう。
ラジオからは絶え間なく懐かしい曲が流れています。
夜が来ました。ラジオを消して星を眺めましょう。暗闇の中で波の音に耳を傾けながら夢を見ましょう。
太陽が昇って空が明るんで来ました。第2プールへと滑り台で滑りましょう。
どこか遠くで飛行機が飛んでいます。やる事がまだ残っています。
あなたには無いですが。

この瞬間を存分に生きて人生を楽しみましょう。

全ては上手く行きます。

tw.description:
療癒橡皮鴨模擬器 是一款放鬆的 3D 遊戲，您可以體驗成為一隻橡皮鴨的生活，是個讓人感到平靜與幸福的實驗。您可以在自己喜愛的海邊泳池中，度過一個恢復活力的假期。

您並不孤單。各式各樣的橡皮鴨會和您一起慢慢並快樂地落入池中，每隻鴨子都有自己的風格和神韻。

漂浮於水面上，享受日光浴，喙輕輕地點水，然後滑下滑梯。收音機正播放著懷舊的曲調。
夜幕降臨。看那星星。關掉收音機，在黑暗中聆聽海浪。夢。
太陽升起。天是藍的。滑進第二個泳池。
一架飛機正趕往某處，它有事要忙。
但這些事情與您無關。

活在當下，享受生活。

一切都會好起來的。

fr.description:
Un environnement 3D relaxant où vous expérimentez une vie en tant que canard en caoutchouc, Placid Plastic Duck Simulator est une expérimentation visant à induire le calme et la félicité. Vous êtes paré pour une séance de relaxation des plus revigorantes dans votre piscine en bord de mer préférée.

Vous n’êtes pas seul. Différents canards vont joyeusement et progressivement tomber dans la piscine avec vous, chacun avec leurs propres styles et attitudes.

Flotter sur l’eau, profiter du bain de soleil, tremper son bec, descendre le toboggan. La radio joue une musique nostalgique.
Voilà la nuit qui arrive. Regardez les étoiles. Éteignez la radio et écoutez dans la pénombre le bruit des vagues. Rêvez.
Le soleil se lève. Le ciel est bleu. Glissez dans la seconde piscine.
Un avion se précipite quelque part. Il y a quelque chose à faire.
Pas pour vous.

Vivez dans le moment présent, appréciez l

kr.description:
고무 오리로서의 삶을 경험할 수 있는 편안한 3D 환경에서, 편안한 플라스틱 오리 시뮬레이터는 평온함과 진정을 유도하는 실험입니다. 활력을 주는 해변가의 수영장에서 시간을 보내보세요.


당신은 혼자가 아닙니다. 다른 개성과 특징을 가진 오리들이 천천히, 그리고 행복하게 당신과 함께 수영장으로 빠져들 것입니다.


물 위에 떠다니고, 일광욕을 하면서, 심호흡도 하고, 슬라이드도 타 보세요. 라디오에서는 레트로 풍의 음악이 흘러나올겁니다.

슬슬 해가 지기 시작했네요. 저기 저 별들을 보면서, 라디오를 끄고, 어둠 속에서 파도를 느껴보세요. 꿈도 꾸시고요.

해가 다시 뜨기 시작합니다. 하늘도 파랗네요. 슬라이드로 두 번째 수영장으로 내려가보세요.

저 위에서는 비행기가 빠르게 움직입니다. 아마도 할 일이 있나 봅니다.

당신은 아니지만요.


현재에 살면서, 삶을 즐겨보세요.


모든 게 다 괜찮아질 겁니다.

--------------------------------------------

* Colorful graphics and exciting gameplay!
* Easy and entertaining to play…challenging to master.
* Your worm is back with new tricks up his sl

***Voici la suite officielle du jeu "Mots Ver” original classé 5 étoiles ! 

Mots Ver Saisons transportera votre sympathique petit ver dans de nouveaux univers palpitants...en commençant par une chasse aux œufs de Pâques gigantesque ! Creusez votre trajet jusqu’au bas du niveau en formant des mots…Prenez de vitesse la mèche allumée qui se consume ou vous aurez perdu ! Plus les mots formés sont longs, plus vous marquez de points. Essayez de marquer suffisamment de points à chaque niveau pour obtenir les trois étoiles.   Mots Ver Saisons fera travailler vos neurones et développera vos réflexes. 

Aidez un sympathiq

us.description:
The game is presented as a game of questions and answers. The player is presented with a question or task, followed by four clickable options, one of which is the correct one. Many of the questions rely on double meanings, tricks and puns, requiring the player to always "think outside the box." The player also finds many different minigames along the way, like mazes, where players will need to have some good skills and reflexes. Some questions require the player to resort to insane logic, intentionally made to make the player fail.

In the game, you are given three lives, and you'll lose one with every mistake you make. Losing all lives will cause a Game Over. You must beat all 110 questions of the game in a single take, no checkpoints in-between. Along the way, you will receive Skips, which are green arrow-shaped Power-ups that let the player skip particular questions of the game. Howev

us.description:
How the time flies!

 It goes by even faster with "Clever 4ever". With this new member of the success series you will meet old acquaintances and new friends. The rewarding system of the Clever series is again filled with interesting challenges and tricky decisions. 
Are you willing to accept negative points for certain bonuses? Which numbers do you use to trigger the most useful effects?
Of course, there are five new dice categories this time as well, including the arrangement of the bonuses, which again make it quite tricky to find the best moves.

The grey area in particular stands out with new possibilities and challenges, as topological aspects come into play here for the first time in the Clever series.
In addition, the new feature "Polishing Silver" allows you to rotate the cube to a different numerical value before placing it, as long as it is taken from the silver tray.
As always

us.description: The Family Edition of the Lets Get Lit - Party Edition game! Taking over game night with the family!

How well do you know the Scriptures? Test yourself with over 1,000 multiple-choice questions from Genesis to Revelation, every one answered by a verse in the King James Bible.

After each question, see the verse the answer comes from, then read the whole chapter in the built-in KJV Bible. It's trivia that sends you back to the Word.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Old Testament, New Testament, or both
• Games of 5, 10, 20 or 50 questions
• Relaxed play, or a timer of 5 to 30 seconds per question
• Missed it? Keep trying until you find the right answer

SCORING
• 10 points for a first-try answer, 5 for the second, 2 for the third
• In timed games, quick answers earn up to 5 bonus points
• Finish with a biblical rank, from Newborn Babe to Bible Scholar
• Share your score and challenge friends and family

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
• Every question links to its source verse
• The complete King James Bible is built

us.description:
How well do your friends really know you?

Who Knows You? brings 2–10 people together around one iPhone or iPad. Choose your answer in secret, pass the device, and let your friends predict what you picked. Reveal the answer together, compare guesses, and let the stories begin.

HOW TO PLAY
• Enter player names and choose Quick Game or Standard Game.
• The featured player answers privately, then everyone else guesses.
• Each correct guess earns one point.
• The spotlight moves to the next player after every question.
• Quick Game plays one round; Standard Game plays three. Ties share the win.

INCLUDED WITH YOUR APP PURCHASE
• 160 everyday questions.
• 2–10 players sharing one device.
• Private handoff screens, automatic game saving and built-in instructions.
• Local question history prioritizes questions you have not seen.
• Offline gameplay with no player account required.

OPTIONAL SEA

This is a full version of the game which contains more interesting levels, solutions to puzzles and disabled ads!
The brain-teaser is based on an extraordinary idea that connects the solution of the problems with the way you use your smartphone every day.

The goal of the game – to click "Finish." However, for this you have to use your imagination.

The game is a combination of different types of puzzles: hardware capabilities of the device, rebus the answer to which is not some word, but some action you have to realize, levels where you need to act beyond the game itself.

You will not just exercise your mind, but also learn some new features and scenarios of using the device - voice control, working with the hardware settings, the search engines, texts, translators.

us.description:
As any good fisherman will tell you, you should always carry a fish in your pocket, just in case. And now you can. The classic push-your-luck trivia game, Sounds Fishy, is now an app! The game is simple: your friends each make up a fake answer to a ridiculous question, then all you have to do is pick the fake answers without hooking the real one. If you do, you lose all your points. Why trawl through the App Store looking for the perfect trivia game, when you’ve already landed on it?  

One player buys the Sounds Fishy app, everyone else joins for free using the Big Potato Companion App. Then the game takes care of everything - scorekeeping, turns, and all the fishy fun.

It’s the party game where one answer’s real, and the rest are red herrings.

- 750 strange but true trivia questions to play
- Two minutes to learn, 20 minutes to play

Subwords is an exciting mix between a trivia and a word game. Words are split into syllables and you have to put them back together as fast as possible. The words in every level are bound to a certain topic, so you have to know about the topic to solve it. But it's no problem if you aren't that familiar with a specific topic: Simply click the bulb to learn something new!

Features:
- 45 levels, ranging from animals and fruits to European countries, our solar system or greek mythology etc.
- 20 bonus levels built specifically for kids up to an age of 8 years.
- Two modes: Classic and Timed! 
- Fully accessible via VoiceOver and Voice Control
- Learn spelling and syllabification of words, plus new vocabulary!
- Head control: Play the game by just moving your head! (Requires a device with a TrueDepth camera)
- Play in different languages (English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Ita

Les mots dans chaque niveau sont groupés par thème. Mais si vous ne connaissez pas un mot ou un thème, pas de problème: appuyez sur l’ampoule pour en apprendre plus !

Fonctions:
- Plus de 40 niveaux, sur des thèmes comme les animaux, les fruits ou les pays d’Europe ; en passant par notre système solaire, la mythologie grecque, etc
- 20 niveaux bonus, conçus spécialement pour les enfants jusqu’à 8 ans
- 2 modes: classique et chronométré
- Complètement utilisable avec VoiceOver
- Apprenez l’orthographe et la syllabification de nouveaux mots!
- Face-Control: jouez en bougeant votre tête ! (requiert un appareil avec un appareil photo TrueDepth)
- Jouez dans différentes langues (allemand, anglais, italien espagnol et portugais)

Liens:
Tw

kr.description:
Subwords is an exciting mix between a trivia and a word game. Words are split into syllables and you have to put them back together as fast as possible. The words in every level are bound to a certain topic, so you have to know about the topic to solve it. But it's no problem if you aren't that familiar with a specific topic: Simply click the bulb to learn something new!

Features:
- 45 levels, ranging from animals and fruits to European countries, our solar system or greek mythology etc.
- 20 bonus levels built specifically for kids up to an age of 8 years.
- Two modes: Classic and Timed! 
- Fully accessible via VoiceOver and Voice Control
- Learn spelling and syllabification of words, plus new vocabulary!
- Head control: Play the game by just moving your head! (Requires a device with a TrueDepth camera)
- Play in different languages (English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Ita

us.description:
Dazed & Amuzed is the party game that reads the room.

Gather your friends, pass the phone, and let the chaos begin. Whether you want
to keep it light or go deep, Dazed & Amuzed serves up the perfect prompt for the
moment. No setup, no rules to memorize, no account required. Just pick a vibe and
play.

HOW IT WORKS
• 3–12 players on one phone
• Each round, one player is the Judge and picks a card type
• Everyone else answers, debates, or votes
• The Judge crowns a favorite — most points wins

PICK YOUR VIBE
• Party Mode — fast, funny, say-no-more energy
• Go Deep — the conversations you'll actually remember
• Best of Both — a little of everything

THE DECKS
• Debate — settle the arguments that divide the group
• Would You Rather — impossible choices, instant chaos
• Spill — the stories you've been dying to tell
• Unfiltered — honest, no-holds-barred prompts

Welcome to The Dressmaker Shop, a creative fashion workshop where every outfit begins with fabric, a pattern, and your imagination.
Step into your atelier and experience the process of creating clothing from start to finish. Choose fabrics, prepare pattern pieces, cut materials, sew them together, and assemble complete outfits on your mannequin.

Each project challenges you to select the right materials and create clothing that matches different style and quality requirements.

CREATE YOUR OUTFITS
Choose individual garment pieces and combine them to build your design. From tops and skirts to sleeves, collars, and decorative details, every choice helps shape the final look.

CHOOSE YOUR FABRICS
Explore different materials, colors, textures, and patterns. Select the fabric that best fits your project and use the amount you need for each piece.

CUT THE PATTERNS
Arrange your pattern pieces

us.description:
Escape Games: “Both Sides Now”

This game is a combination of two games that were previously released as a single game application.

“a day…"
This is a story of the main character who lives with a cat in a small room. It is a heartwarming short escape game with 18 episodes.

“AYAKASHI”
In order to escape from a cursed room, you have to get a talisman hidden somewhere and defeat the evils that lurk in the room. This is a horror-flavored escape game with 18 episodes. (It may be difficult for those with low tolerance for horror, but it is not too scary among horror games.)
If you fulfill certain conditions, you can enjoy an extra game.

“day after day"
A new game that can be played after completing both “a day…” and “AYAKASHI”.

jp.trackName: 脱出ゲーム ボスサイズ
jp.description:
脱出ゲーム：「ある日」と「あやかし」

このゲームはかつてリリースしていましたふたつのゲームをひとつのゲームアプリにまとめたものです。

難易度：簡単

「ある日」
小さな部屋でネコと暮らす主人公の物語。全18話で構成されたほのぼのした短編脱出ゲームです。

「あやかし」
呪われた部屋から脱出するためにはどこかに隠されている護符を手に入れて、部屋に巣くう悪霊を倒さなければなりません。全18話で構成されたホラー風味の脱出ゲームです。
（ホラー耐性の低い方には難しいかもしれませんが、ホラーゲームの中ではあまり怖くないと思います。）
ある条件を充たすとエクストラゲームが楽しめます。

「今日も一日」
「ある日」「あやかし」両方をクリアするとプレイできる新作ゲーム。

us.description:
Era Swap is a trivia game for two generations. Each of you gets questions about the other person's childhood. A grandma who grew up in the '60s gets questions about the 2010s, and her grandkid gets questions about the '60s. After each round, Story Time shows what each of you missed, so you can tell each other what it was really like.

WAYS TO PLAY
• Family duel: pass one phone or iPad back and forth, five questions each. Works without the internet.
• Family online: challenge family anywhere and take your turn whenever you have a minute.
• Ghost race: race a round your family or friends already played, at the speed they played it. Or race one of nine practice ghosts, one from each decade.
• Open match: play someone new from another generation when someone else is looking for a game too. Names are made up and there's no chat.

649 QUESTIONS FROM THE '40S TO THE 2020S
Prices, TV shows, toys

Nuggetz is a fast-paced and addictive reaction game for Apple Watch and iOS. Originally crafted for the Apple Watch, it was even featured by Apple for watchOS 2.0!

Your challenge: Identify the color of the word, not the word itself.
Sounds easy? Think again! One mistake ends the game, so stay sharp and see how high you can score!

Whether you're looking for a quick casual game on your Apple Watch or a fun challenge on your iPhone, Nuggetz is perfect for testing your reflexes anytime, anywhere.

Note: This game may not be fully accessible to color-blind users, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.

us.description:
Do you love to travel? GeoGuesser is a game that shows you panoramic street views of places around the world and challenges your ability to guess where they are!

GeoGuesser 2 is completely new and redesigned! If you're looking for the original with the classic game mode and unlockable levels, you can still download GeoGuesser Classic on the App Store too!

Choose from multiple game modes:

Standard Game - You'll be shown random locations and get get once chance to guess each location, then the actual location will be revealed

Accuracy Game - Keep guessing until you get it right! Each guess will give you a hint but also cost you extra time!

Endurance Game - Every correct guess unlocks another new location, but a wrong guess will end the game! See how many you can get in a row!

Download GeoGuessr now and see how many places you can recognize!




Attributions:
Maps from Google Maps SDK

** 9 Games play, tap, trace, match and print with A-Z, a-z and 0-10.
** Each letter and number displayed and gamed with Cute Animal Circus.
** Print and  customize with cute and unique Letters, Numbers and Papers.

Walk up! Walk up! ABC CIRCUS! The greatest circus show on earth is about to begin!

“A” is for Playing Ant, “B” is for Unicycle Bear, “C” is for Acrobatics Camel…Playing with 26 amazing circus, kids practice essential skills in exciting games per letter.

1.SHOW: Each of the letters and numbers show its unique circus firstly and attracts kids learning interest;
2.TAP & TRACE: Learn where to start, change direction and finish by 63 animations(26 uppercase letters, 26 lowercase letters and 11 numbers);
3.WRITE: Write the letter by tracing the dots. (each letter has its unique circus dot)
4.PLAY: Play 63 wonderful circuses after write it and you can choose “TRACE”, “WRITE” or “SH

us.description:
Cahoots  is a clever card game that works wonderfully alone.
With cards in four colors and with values from 1-7, you have to complete 12, 14 or even 18 targets. 

However, this is not as easy as you might think at first sight. You only have 4 cards in your hand at any one time, and there are only 4 of the targets open at any one time. So it can be quite tricky to choose the right card, because the targets have to be fulfilled before the pile of cards with the numbercards is used up.

In the proven single-user manner it is necessary to convert the constantly changing conditions into the best possible result by using random elements.

2 exciting modes: Classic and Race!
Tutorial for an easy start!
Collect Achievements!
Place yourself on top of the list!
Chase the highscore and compete against the worldwide community every week!

us.description:
Know the stories. Own the room.

Black Trivia is a team trivia game celebrating Black history and culture. Pick a lane, answer sourced questions, then step into the room, build a team of one to five players and challenge another team in a best-of-three match.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Practice solo in eight lanes: STEM, Business, Communities, Culture, Military, Politics, Music and Investing
• Every question comes with an explanation and a source link
• Tap Fresh set for a new batch of questions

THE ROOM
• Drop in as a guest with just a handle, or save a player card
• Create a team or join one that is waiting
• First team to five correct answers takes the round; win two rounds to win the match
• Earn crowns and climb the leaderboard

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free to download. Solo practice is free. Live multiplayer (random match, nearby players, friends and team play) needs the Black Trivia Multiplayer sub

us.description:
Exercise helps keep the body healthy and fit.
And the brain? Will no one think of the brain?

Brainess is a brain training game that, in a simple and fun way, helps you stimulate your brain.

Brainess includes 7 brain training games to improve and exercise your memory, vision and compute skills.

In just a few minutes you can have a daily brain exercise and monitor your brain age (lower is better).

List of included exercises:
• Dice - Memorize and then Tap dice from Low to High
• Signs - Choose the correct mathematical Sign to solve the equation
• Equations - Choose the correct Number to solve the equation
• Memory - Match pairs of identical cards
• Numbers - Tap the highest Number
• Colors - Match the color of the upper box's letters with the right word below.
• Fruits - Pay attention at dropping fruits and answer the questions

Und das Gehirn? Wird niemand ans Gehirn denken?

Brainess, das Denkspiel, das Ihnen auf einfache und unterhaltsame Weise, hilft, Ihr Gehirn zu stimulieren.

Brainess inkl. 7 Gehirn-Training-Spiele, um dein Gedächtnis, Vision und Rechnen zu verbessern und zu trainieren.

Liste der Übungen:

• Gleichungen - Die richtige Nummer wählen, um Gleichung zu lösen.

• Zahlen - Die höchste Zahl tippen.
• Farben - Tippe die Name der Farbe der Buchstaben oben.
• Früchte - Achte auf Fallobst und beantworte die Fragen.

jp.description:
エクササイズは体や心を健康に育てます。
脳はどうですか？どうして誰も脳について考えないのでしょうか？

Brainess は脳を興奮させる面白く、簡単なゲームです。

Brainess には７つの脳トレーニングゲームが含まれており、記憶や視覚、計算能力を磨くことが出来ます。

たった数分で、一日分の脳トレーニングが出来、脳年齢を管理することが出来ます（値が小さいほど良いです）。

トレーニングの種類：
• サイコロ - 下から上にサイコロの値を記憶しタップ
• サイン - 正しい記号を選び問題を解きます
• 方程式 - 正しい数字を選んで問題を解きます
• Memory - ペアを合わせます
• 数字 - 色の名前をタップ
• フルーツ - 落ちているフルーツに気を付けながら問題に答えます

• Fruits - Pay attention at dropping fruits and answer the questions

us.description:
Trivia: Knowledge Trainer is the quiz app for smart people. It’s designed to stimulate your brain with over 6,000 high-quality, challenging, and informative questions.

2020 marks the 10th anniversary of this sophisticated trivia app. Since 2010, the game has helped more than 7 million players to improve their general knowledge. Our worldwide team has been and is continuously improving and updating the app.
 
Each lesson tests your wits with 10 questions from 10 different categories. The difficulty level depends on you: get an answer right, you'll move up a level. A wrong answer leads to an easier question. But you'll want to move up to improve your Knowledge Quotient, recalculated after every round.

More app features:
• 6000+ questions = fewer repeats
• 5 difficulty levels, 10 general knowledge training categories
• American, British, Australian & international gameplay modes 
• Review

----------------- 
The game consists of 10 beautiful shops each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.

us.description:
Eight games for two people and one phone. Put it on the table between you and play face to face, or side by side.

Each player gets their own half of the screen, turned to face them. No accounts, no ads, no internet needed. Every game also has a solo mode.

TWO-TOP TRIVIA
Race to the right answer. The first correct tap scores; a wrong tap locks you out while your opponent gets a free shot.
• Over 3,000 hand-picked questions in 16 categories
• Pick categories, length, timer, and difficulty
• A quick fun fact after every question
• Ties go to sudden death
• Solo practice saves your misses so you can retry them

WORD GAMES
• Alphabet Soup: you both get the same letters. Be the first to use them all in one connected crossword.
• Sugar Cubes: trace words through the same tray of letter cubes before the bell. Longer words score more.

BOARD GAMES
• Four Up: drop discs and line up four in a row

- Review your answers and lern from them!

>28 Szenen--8Tier+4Lebensmittel+7Leben+3Festival+2Karte+4Andere!
>Zwei Spiel Versionen: A-Z Version und Themen Version
>Original englische, spanische, deutsche und französische Schreibweise und Aussprache

Suchen Sie nach einem unterhaltsamen und gleichzeitig lehrreichen Spiel für Ihre Kinder?
Dann brauchen Sie „Erste Wörter“ unbedingt. Stundenlanges, spielerisches Lernen mit
garantiertem Spaß. 

Erste Wörter hilft Ihrem Kind:
1.Die Feinmotorik zu verbessern
2.Buchstaben zu erkennen und abzugleichen
3.Buchstaben richtig auszusprechen
4.Die Namen der Buchstaben zu erlernen
5.Wörter zu buchstabieren

Das Spiel bietet zwei Versionen. A-Z Version und Themen Version.
Erste Wörter wurde kindgerecht gestaltet.  Die Anwendung ist kinderleicht und wurd

jp.description:

> 28 Scenes--8Animal+4Food+7Life+3Festival +2Map+4Others!  
> 2 game modes: A-Z mode and Scenes mode! 
> Native English, Spanish, German and French spelling and pronunciation! 

Looking for something entertain but also educational for your kids? Amazing First Words is a must-have! It provides hours of fun, laughter and learning.

Amazing First Words will help your child:
1 develop fine motor skills
2 learn to recognize and match letters
3 learn the sounds letters make
4 learn the names of letters
5 learn how to spell words

Kids can play Amazing First Words by 2 modes: A-Z mode and Scenes mode. Words have been sorted by alphabetical order in A-Z mode and different environment in Scenes mode. 
Amazing First Words is designed to be kid-friendly! T

fr.description:
Le premier jeu de mots qui offre des GRILLES INFINIES!
"What's Hot" en USA, France, UK, Canada, Australie, Nouvelle-Zélande, Espagne, Italie, Suisse!

Les mots croisés sont trop difficiles? Qu'en penses-tu d'un truc plus relaxant? Imagine que tu connaisses tous les mots et qu'il faille seulement les croiser correctement. C'est Word Fill, l'unique jeu de mots qui offre grilles INFINIES!

Sélectionne une entrée, vois les mots disponibles, choisis-en un. Maintenant sélectionne une autre entrée, contrôle les croisements et introduis un nouveau mot qui aille bien jusqu'à remplir la grille. Word Fill est une alternative amusante aux mots croisés pour ceux qui n'aiment pas laisser les cases blanches. Il ne faut pas s'empresser de terminer dans un temps, Word Fill est un passe-temps tranquille!

CARACTÉRISTIQUES

- App universelle pour iPhone, iPod touch et iPad.
- Grilles dynamiques qui jamais

us.description:
Read a verse. Name where it's written.

Every question is a verse from the King James Bible with four references to choose from. Do you know whether it's Proverbs or Psalms? Romans or Hebrews? Which chapter of John? It's a fun way to learn where things are in the Bible, and to remember them.

THREE LEVELS
• Easy: the four references come from anywhere in the Bible
• Medium: four different books from the same testament
• Hard: four verses from the same book, so you need to know your chapters

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Old Testament, New Testament, or both
• Games of 5, 10, 20 or 50 questions
• Relaxed play, or a timer of 5 to 30 seconds per question
• Missed it? Keep trying until you find the right reference

SCORING
• 10 points for a first-try answer, 5 for the second, 2 for the third
• In timed games, quick answers earn up to 5 bonus points
• Finish with a biblical rank, from Young Timothy to Scr

us.description:
If you like "Quite clever", you'll love "Twice as clever".

Whether you're a highscore hunter with hundreds of played games or just have played a few occasional games, "Twice as clever" offers you new and exciting challenges to master.

Of course, there are five new dice categories and bonuses, which make it tricky to find the best moves.

Plus, there's the new Return-Action, which gives you all-new options to score even better! Finally, you can use dice that land on a silver platter again!

And that's not all: If you choose the silver dice, you not only use it, but also all the smaller dice that would normally land on the silver platter.

You see: Countless new possibilities and 18 exciting new achievements are waiting to be discovered by you.

Don't just be "Quite clever", be "Twice as clever".

World exclusive you can also try your hand at the "Challenge 2" in the app. A new challenge

Choose from TWO game modes:
- Single player mode provides a timed game that allows you to enter your name and score to the Manna Leaderboard.  If you are having trouble, just wait and wrong answers will be removed.

- Practice mode is similar to Single player mode, but without the stress of a timer. This is great for doing research or playing in a group setting.


Other options:
- Choose from Old Testament questions, New Testament questions, or questions from the entire Bible.

- In single player and practice games, choose from a 10 question game up to a 50 question game.

- View the Manna Leaderboard.

States & Plates Update

The paid and free versions of States & Plates are now combined into one app.This update can migrate your found plates from the previous paid version.

To transfer your progress, the old paid app must still be installed on this device and you must have found at least one plate in it.

If you previously purchased the app, installing this version automatically grants you lifetime access to the premium features—even if the old version is no longer installed. (Plate progress can only be transferred while the previous version is still on your device.)

Start from the basic groups (such as ketones and hydrocarbons) and proceed to the advanced topics (for example, azo compounds and boronic acids).

* Flashcards for memorizing these groups.
* Tables of functional groups.

de.description:
Die wichtigste Anwendung für Studenten der organischen Chemie enthält 80 funktionelle Gruppen, Stoffgruppen von organischer Verbindungen (Aldehyd, Ether, Ester, etc) und Naturstoffe (Nukleinsäuren, Kohlenhydrate, Lipide, etc). 
Starten Sie von der basischen Gruppen (wie Ketone und Kohlenwasserstoffe) und fahren Sie mit den fortgeschrittenen Themen (z. B. Terpenoid und Flavonoid).

Wählen Sie den Spielmodus und haben Sie ein Quiz: 
1) Quiz (leicht und schwer).
2) Multiple-Choice-Quiz (Einfachauswahl).
3) Zeit-Spiel (geben Sie die meisten Antworten in 1 Minute) - Sie müssen mehr als 25 Fragen beantworten, um einen Stern zu bekommen.
Zwei Lernmodi:
* Verwenden Sie Karteikarten (Flashcards) für das Auswendiglernen.
* Tabellen der funktionellen Gruppen.

Die App ist in 13 Sprachen übersetzt, darunter Deutsch und Englisch. So können Sie die Namen der funktionellen Gruppen in jeder dieser Sprac

jp.trackName: 官能基 : 有機化学と有機化合物のクラスについてのクイズ
jp.description:
このアプリケーションは、有機化学の学生のために非常に重要です。80官能基、有機化合物 (アルデヒド、カルボン酸、エステル等) および天然産物 (核酸、炭水化物、脂質等) のクラスを含む。
基本的なグループ (ケトンや炭化水素など) から開始し、高度なトピック (例えば、アルカロイドとホルモン) に進みます。

ゲームモードを選択します :
1) スペルクイズ（簡単かつハード）。
2) 複数の選択肢の質問。
3) 時間ゲーム（1分間にできるだけ多くの回答することができますように与えます）: あなたは星を得るために25以上の質問に答える必要があります。
2つの学習モード：
* フラッシュカード。
* 官能基の表。

アプリは英語と日本語を含む13つの言語に翻訳されています。 だから、あなたはそれらのいずれかで、官能基の名称を学ぶことができます。

有機化学の試験のための準備!

Commencez des groupes de base (tels que les cétones et les hydrocarbures) et de procédez à des sujets avancés (par exemple, les lactones et les alcaloïdes).

Choisissez le mode de jeu et faites un quiz : 
1) Quiz (facile et difficile).
2) Questions à choix multiples.
3) Jeu du temps (donnez les réponses les plus en 1 minute) - Vous devez répondre à plus de 25 questions pour obtenir une étoile.
Deux modes d'apprentissage :
* Utilisez des cartes (flashcards) pour la mémorisation
* Les tableaux des groupes fonctionnels.

L'app est traduite dans les 13 langues dont le français et l'anglais. Vous pouvez ainsi apprendre les noms des groupes fonctionnels da

kr.description:
The most important app for organic chemistry students includes 80 functional groups, the classes of organic compounds (aldehyde, ethers, esters, etc.) and natural products (nucleic acids, carbohydrates, lipids, etc.). 
Start from the basic groups (such as ketones and hydrocarbons) and proceed to the advanced topics (for example, azo compounds and boronic acids).

Choose the game mode and take a quiz: 
1) Spelling quizzes (easy and hard) - answer all questions correctly to win a star.
2) Multiple-choice questions (with 4 or 6 answer options).
3) Time game (give as many answers as you can in 1 minute) - you should give more than 25 correct answers to get a star.
Two learning tools:
* Flashcards for memorizing these groups.
* Tables of functional groups.

us.description: "Magic Eye Stereogram Quiz" is a  quiz which invites you to test your ability “look into” 3D stereograms. Stereograms are 3D images hidden within another picture. In order to view the 3D images, simply stare at the picture until the image starts to take shape. You need to answer what is hidden within current picture. Game consists of 20 stereograms. Each stereogram question has 4 possible answers. When you tap one of the answers, the default color of the pressed button is changed to green (when it was the right answer) or to red (wrong answer). You have 3 attempts to give the right answer.  If you give it at the first attempt you will receive 3 points, at the second attempt - 2 points, at the third - 1 point. Please take into account – some people cannot see hidden stereogram images!

de.description: "Magisches Auge Quiz" ist ein Quiz um Ihre Fähigkeit geheim Bild in 3D Stereogramme zu sehen zu prüfen. Stereograms sind 3D-Bilder in ein anderes Bild versteckt. Um die 3D-Bilder zu sehen, schauen Sie einfach auf das Bild, bis das geheim Bild beginnt klar sein. Sie beantworten müssen, was im aktuellen Bild versteckt. Spiel besteht aus 20 Stereogramme. Jede Frage hat 4 mögliche Antworten. Wenn Sie tippen auf ein Antwort, die Farbe der Antworttaste wird auf grün (richtige Antwort) oder rot (falsche Antwort) verändert. Sie haben 3 Versuche um die richtige Antwort zu geben. Wenn Sie es beim ersten Versuch schaffen, bekommen Sie 3 Punkte. Beim zweiten Versuch bekommen Sie 2 Punkte, beim dritten bekommen Sie 1 Punkt. Bitte berücksichtigen - nicht alle Leute können Stereogramm Bilder sehen!

us.description:
Finally, a buzzer for the iPhone! This app turns you and your friends' iPhones and iPod touches into game buzzers!  Start up one device as the game Host, and add as many iPhones and iPod touches to the mix to have your own trivia party!  

Each device becomes a buzzer and everyone will see who buzzed in first!  Forget spending $20-$220 on expensive buzzer systems, just download the app from the App Store and start your own ad-hoc trivia games wherever you have a wireless network!

Version 2.0 allows for multiple choice questions and free response answers to be submitted!

Expandable to any number of buzzers.  Requires one iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, Apple Silicon Mac, or Apple Vision Pro per buzzer and one for the host.

Compatible with all iOS devices, even the original iPhone!  Put those old phones to use!
    
NOTE: This application requires at least 2 devices on the same wireless netwo

us.description:
If you already like "Pretty clever" and "Twice as clever", "Clever cubed" is the ultimate challenge for you!
Whether you're a high-score hunter with hundreds of games or just an occasional game, "Clever cubed" offers you new and exciting challenges to master.

Of course, there are five new dice categories, including the arrangement of bonuses, which make it quite tricky again to find the best moves.
In addition, the new number joker offers completely new strategic options by allowing you to rotate a dice to a different number value before placing.
And that's not all: If you choose the turquoise dice, you don't just bet this one, but up to 2 additional dice if they are of the right value.

As you can see: Countless new possibilities and 18 exciting new achievements are waiting to be discovered by you.
As always in the "clever" series you can compete against the worldwide community in week

Wenn du schon "Ganz schön clever" und "Doppelt so clever" magst, ist "Clever hoch drei" die ultimative Herausforderung für dich!
Egal ob du ein ein Highscorejäger mit hunderten Spielen bist oder nur gelegentlich ein Spielchen machts, "Clever hoch drei" bietet dir neue spannende Herrausforderungen, die es zu meistern gilt.

Natürlich gibt es fünf neue Würfelkategorien samt Anordnung der Boni, die es wieder ganz schön kniffilig machen die besten Züge zu finden.
Außerdem ermöglicht der neue Zahlen-Joker völlig neue strategische Optionen, indem er erlaubt einen Würfel vor dem Einsetzen auf einen anderen Zahlenwert zu drehen.
Und das ist noch nicht alles: Wählst du den türkisen Würfel, setzt du nicht nur diesen ein, sondern bis zu 2 weitere Würfel, falls diese im passenden Wert bereit liegen.

Du siehst: Unzählige neue Möglichkeiten und 18 spannende neue Achievements warten darauf von dir ent

us.description: "Name This Country" is a geographical quiz which invites you to test your knowledge of countries around the world. It may be used for testing and educational purposes for people well-informed about the map of the world. Game contains all the 193 countries of the world. Each question has 4 possible answers. When you tap one of the answers, the default color of the pressed button is changed to green (when it was the right answer) or to red (wrong answer). You have 3 attempts to give the right answer.  If you give it at the first attempt you will receive 3 points, at the second attempt - 2 points, at the third - 1 point. After the second wrong answer the hint with the capital of the country will be shown. Play the "Name This Country" quiz now and find out how well you know your world!

Spielen Sie das "Erraten das Land" Quiz und finden Sie heraus, wie gut Sie der Welt wissen!

fr.description: Fort probablement que les amateurs de géographie apprécieront ce jeu-questionnaire qui offre la possibilité de s'entraîner à reconnaître l'emplacement de 193 pays du monde sur une carte géographique. L'application Devinez ce pays présente à l'écran une portion d'une carte géographique sur laquelle apparaît un pays dans une couleur différente ou marquée par une flèche. Il s'agit alors de choisir la bonne réponse parmi quatre possibilités. Les points sont comptabilisés et une bonne réponse donne droit à trois points. Après deux essais, le logiciel fournit un indice, comme la capitale du pays, afin d'aider le joueur. On peut paramétrer le jeu de façon à ce qu'il n'affiche au départ que les pays d'un continent, par exemple ceux d'Amérique, pour en arriver à la fin à sélectionner l'ensemble des continents.
