- Des effets de sable satisfaisants : Admirez les grains colorés qui s'écoulent et se déposen

kr.description:
Sandy Bus: Masterpiece에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 버스 정체를 풀어내는 전략과 같은 색 모래를 모으는 쾌감이 어우러진 알록달록한 버스 퍼즐 게임입니다. 알맞은 버스를 골라 같은 색의 모래를 모으고, 층층이 쌓인 모래를 없애 보드를 깔끔하게 정리해 보세요.

게임 방법
- 화살표를 확인하세요: 버스를 터치하면 표시된 방향으로 이동합니다. 움직이기 전에 길이 막혀 있지 않은지 확인하세요.
- 같은 색 모래를 모으세요: 각 버스로 현재 수집할 수 있는 같은 색의 모래를 모으세요.
- 새로운 색을 발견하세요: 모래를 없애면 남은 모래층이 아래로 내려와 새로운 색을 맞출 기회가 생깁니다.
- 순서를 계획하세요: 이동 경로가 막히지 않도록 버스를 움직일 순서를 신중하게 정하고, 모든 모래를 모으세요.

게임 특징
- 기분 좋은 모래 효과: 모래를 모을 때마다 알록달록한 모래알이 흘러내리고 쌓이는 모습을 감상하세요. 계획대로 보드가 조금씩 비워지는 만족감을 느껴보세요.
- 간편한 터치 조작: 첫 움직임부터 마지막 색 맞추기까지, 쉬운 조작으로 퍼즐 풀이에 집중할 수 있습니다.
- 점점 어려워지는 퍼즐: 게임을 진행할수록 버스 위치, 이동 경로, 모래 색의 조합이 더욱 복잡해집니다.
- 알록달록한 퍼즐과 함께하는 휴식: 선명한 그래픽과 보드를 비우는 쾌감이 매 스테이지를 매력적인 도전으로 만들어 줍니다. 잠깐의 쉬는 시간에도, 여유롭게 오래 즐기고 싶을 때도 함께하세요.

눈앞의 한 수를 넘어 다음 수까지 생각해 보세요. 색을 비교하고 이동 방향을 살피며, 보드 전체를 비울 수 있는 순서를 찾아보세요. 버스가 차례로 출발하고 마지막 모래알까지 사라지는 순간, 계획이 맞아떨어지는 뿌듯함을 느낄 수 있습니다.

버스 게임, 주차장 정체 퍼즐, 색 맞추기 게임을 좋아한다면 Sandy Bu

gb.description:
Simply Spider is classic Spider Solitaire with nothing in the way. No ads between games, no tracking, no account, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases. Just you, a calm felt table and 104 big, easy-to-read cards.

It was made by a husband for his wife, who was tired of Spider games full of ads. If you are too, this one is for you.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• 1, 2 or 4 suits, from relaxing to truly challenging
• Deal onto empty columns, or play by the classic rule that fills them first
• Undo whenever you change your mind
• Stuck? Tap Hint and the next good move glows
• Your game saves itself, so you can stop any time and pick up where you left off
• Soft card sounds that follow every deal and move, or switch them off for silence

EASY ON THE EYES
• Big, clear cards you can read at a glance
• Make the card numbers bigger still: small, medium or large
• Five card backs and five table colors
• Portra

One leased block in Texas. A rented rig. A bank that wants its money back.

Oil Director is a real-time strategy game about building an oil company from a single wildcat well into a supermajor. The oil price never stops moving, your wells start declining the day they come on, and every barrel you pump has to get somewhere before your tanks fill up.

FIND THE OIL
Bid for licences, shoot seismic and watch the reserve estimate narrow from a wide guess to something you'd bet on. Then drill. The exploration well is the big gamble: months of rig time, millions of dollars, and at the end of it either a discovery or a dry hole.

PUMP IT
Turn a discovery into a field. Drill development wells, fight the decline curve with stimulation, artificial lift and enhanced recovery, and keep the maintenance budget high enough that wells stay up. Stand still and production shrinks, so exploration never stops

gb.description:
Race goofy bulls down wild canyon rivers and steer with fart power! Dodge traps, beat the clock, open skin chests and unlock hilarious new bulls. No paddles. Just farts!

Race a raft full of goofy bulls down wild canyon rivers, powered by nothing but farts! Dodge crazy obstacles, beat the clock, collect rewards, and unlock hilarious new looks in this ridiculous 3D adventure.

NEW: PLAY ONLINE
Race players from around the world! Press READY and the race starts after a short countdown. Bots fill any empty seats.

NEW: PRIVATE ROOM
Create a room, share the code and race with your friends on the same raft. Your friends join with the code, and you can add bots to the free seats.

FART TO STEER
Who needs paddles when you've got fart power? Blast your raft left, right, and straight down the river. Master your moves, stay on course, and enjoy every ridiculous moment!

DODGE THE TRAPS
Watch out!

1000万人が遊んでる！
アクションパズルゲームの決定版「ズーキーパー」が
ついにiPhone/iPad/iPod touchに登場！
めざせ！ベスト・オップ・ズーキーパー！
 
[ゲーム説明]
隣りあった2つのパネルを入れ替えて同じパネルを3つ以上並べて消していく、シンプルなルールのパズルゲームです。
 
動かしたい動物をタッチし、入れ替えたい動物の方向にスライドすると、動物が入れ替わります。
縦か横に同じ動物を3匹以上並べると、その動物をつかまえることができます。
動物をノルマ数捕まえればレベルクリアします。

動物たちをノルマ以上捕まえて、全レベルクリアを目指そう！

動物100匹でレベルアップ！時間無制限のやり込みモードです。

最大3分間のチャレンジでスコアを稼ぎまくるフィーバーモード！
1万点と10万点を超えたタイミングで時間が延長されます。

オンラインで対戦できるズーキーパーを無料でプレイ！

Game CenterにログインしてLeaderboardを使用すればランキングに参加することができます。
世界中のプレイヤーとハイスコアを競おう!

【動作環境】
iOS11以降が必要です。iPhone5s以降、iPad Air以降、iPod touch第6世代以降

옆에 있는 두 개의 패널을 바꿔서 같은 패널을 3개 이상 정렬하여 없애는 간단한 룰의 퍼즐 게임입니다.

On other iPhones, the lower level scrolls from side to side instead.

GAMEPLAY
• Play 24 levels across two worlds, Wood and Glass
• Dodge traps, saw teeth, ride chutes and ramps, and whirring cogs 
• Real ball physics: every roll, slip and drop follows your tilt

PROGRESS TO UNLOCK
• Earn up to three stars per level: one for finishing, one for beating your first time and a third for hard mode
• Hit Bronze, Silver or Gold times to colour your second star. Times get tuned in updates as Game Center times come in, and a medal you’ve won is yours to keep
• Finish Wood to open Glass, then finish Glass to unlock Classic, a 1-bit retro desktop look. Gettin

FOUR WAYS TO TEST YOUR NERVE
• Classic — bank a score or risk it for one more point.
• Timed — bank as much as you can in 30 seconds.
• Daily — everyone faces the same hidden sequence each day.
• Double — every successful risk doubles the pressure and the reward.

Take an order, head to the kitchen, and prepare a growing variety of food through clear, hands-on interactions. Make sure you choose the right ingredients, pay attention to the cooking time, serve each item when it is ready, and try not to let it burn.

Begin with a selection of simple recipes, then earn coins by serving customers and use them to unlock more recipes, ingredients, toppings, and sauces. As your menu grows, you will gradually take on more involved orders—including combos with multiple items to manage.

As you progress, unlock Creative Mode and choose what to make with the recipes and ingredients you’ve unlocked. Put together your own trays and display your creations on the patio.

In the beginning of the game you will see four-digit number.
Add one to each digit of that number and enter result.

For example: if the number 0296 appeared, so you need to enter 1307.

0 -> 1
2 -> 3
9 -> 0
6 -> 7

If the number is correct – you get 1 point. If not – lose 1 point.
After the answer was entered, the next number will appear and so on, till 1-minute countdown finish.

Your task to get as many points as possible.

Your records will be displayed at the Leaderboard as well as your opponent’s records. Inviting friends will be possible in particular.

Donkey Derby is a proper seaside roll-a-ball race, made in Redcar.
  
Drag a ball out of the well and flick it up the lane. Aim and speed come from your finger. Sink it in a yellow hole and your donkey hops once along the race board, blue is two hops and red is three. First past the post 
wins.

PICK YOUR DONKEY
Five donkeys in the stable: Daisy Chain, Millie's Magic, Idrees Lightning, Zayn the Rocket and Meadow Lark. Pick the one you'll ride. Three of the others line up against you, and yours carries your ball colour on its 
number.

A SIX-RACE MEETING
From a three-furlong dash to a full mile: the Coatham Stakes, the Saltburn Sprint, the Beacon Plate, the Scarborough Cup, the Marske Mile and, to finish, the Clifford Cup. Every finish wins a rosette and points for the 
meeting table, and the Clifford Cup counts double.

Every so often a light falls on one of your holes. Sin

Simply Cryptic is a cryptic crossword-inspired word game built for quick, satisfying solves on iPhone.

If cryptic clues have ever felt intimidating, this is your on-ramp. Each puzzle is designed to be clever but fair, and you can always view an optional explanation to learn the logic behind the clue.

How it works:
	•	Solve one cryptic-style clue at a time
	•	Answers fit the exact letter count shown in parentheses
	•	Use hints when you get stuck
	•	Reveal an explanation to learn the wordplay and improve

What’s inside:
	•	Multiple difficulty packs: Easy, Classic, and Hard
	•	Clean, distraction-free design built for mobile
	•	Offline play (no account required)
	•	New content can be added in future updates

Simply Cryptic is the perfect word game for commuters, couch time, or anyone who likes puzzles that make you feel smart.

"Sunday Lawn Seasons" is the highly anticipated sequel to fan favorite "Sunday Lawn", but with THREE new seasons!
After a flourishing summer with his lawn mower, Charlie expands his summer job into a YEAR ROUND BUSINESS.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

GAME MODES:

- AUTUMN: With the ridiculously powerful, plutonium driven LEAF DEVOURER 5000, prepare to take on a neighborhood full of fallen leaves.

Faithful to the game play of the original Sunday Lawn, this all-new sequel packs on new gardens, graphics, features and animals.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

- Game Center support
- MFi controller support

jp.description:
森の空気がおいしいキャンプ場の経営シミュレーションゲーム
ショップ経営や動物もやってくるよ

森林を整備して立派なキャンプ場をつくりましょう。グッズ販売のショップ経営もあります。

まずはテントサイトを建築して、お客さんを迎え入れよう。
テントを組み立てて、たき火をしたり、写真を撮ったりして、それぞれ楽しんでくれるよ。

キャンプ場ではアクティビティも大人気。「野鳥観察」や「渓流釣り」「乗馬体験」など日常では味わえない体験でお客さんもファンになってくれるかもしれない。

初心者も招待してキャンプ体験をしてもらおう。気に入ってくれたら、リピーターになっちゃうかも。うさぎやリスなどの可愛い動物も招待できるらしいぞ。居心地が良いと棲みついちゃう、なんてことも!?

キャンプでは道具も重要だよ。
近隣の町に直営店を建設すれば、お買い物したお客さんがキャンプ場にもやってきます。
街のキャンプ熱がファイヤーすれば、フィーバーが巻き起こっちゃうかも。

色々な街に店を移転していけば、新規客が開拓できます。
お店で道具を買ってもらい、キャンプ場のファンを増やしていくのが手腕の見せどころだ。

さあ、大自然と融合した人気キャンプ場を君の手で経営しよう。

kr.description:
숲속을 정비해 멋진 캠핑장을 만들어 봅시다. 상품을 판매하는 가게도 운영할 수 있습니다.

우선 텐트 사이트를 건설하여 손님을 맞이하세요.
손님들은 텐트를 치거나, 모닥불을 피우거나, 사진을 찍는 등, 다양한 활동을 즐길 거예요.

캠핑장에서는 야외 액티비티도 아주 인기랍니다. 「새 관찰」과 「계곡 낚시」, 「승마 체험」 등 일상에서 쉽게 접할 수 없는 체험을 통해 팬이 되는 손님이 생길지도 몰라요.

초보자도 캠핑 체험에 초대해 봐요. 만족하면 단골이 되기도 한답니다. 토끼나 다람쥐 같은 귀여운 동물들도 초대할 수 있대요. 캠핑장이 편하면 쭉 눌러살지도?!

캠핑할 때는 도구도 중요하죠.
인근 마을에 직영점을 차리면 물건을 산 손님이 캠핑장으로 찾아온답니다.
거리가 캠핑 열기로 달아오르면 피버 효과가 발생할지도 몰라요.

여러 마을로 가게를 이전시키면 새로운 손님을 받을 수 있어요.
가게에서 도구를 산 손님을 얼마나 캠핑장으로 끌어들일 수 있을지 솜씨를 보일 때예요.

대자연과 하나가 된 인기 캠핑장을 여러분의 손으로 직접 경영해 보세요.

tw.description:

Block Blast:watch puzzle game!：極致腕上拼圖冒險​
專為手錶設計的《Block Blast Pro For Watch》，是你腕間的必備拼圖遊戲 —— 在享受快速沉浸的遊戲體驗同時，還能活化思緒。踏入色彩繽紛的挑戰世界，這裡兼具策略與簡易操作，無論是休閒放鬆，還是體驗燒腦樂趣，都能完美契合你的需求。​
核心玩法與目標​
遊戲目標簡單卻充滿可玩性：策略性地將彩色方塊放置到方格中，拼出並消除完整橫列或縱列。每一步都需要邏輯與遠見 —— 填滿行列以触发連擊、清空棋盤，逐步晉升為拼圖高手。這不只是打發時間的遊戲，更是鍛鍊大腦的訓練，讓放鬆與認知鍛鍊兼顧。​
兩大刺激遊戲模式​
1. 經典方塊拼圖​
將幾何方塊拖放至 8×8 方格中，目標是拼出完整橫列或縱列，享受連續消除的暢快感。本模式不支援方塊旋轉，每個方塊都為策略增添難度 —— 必須細心規劃，避免方格卡住！這款經典模式讓人上癮，是磨練空間推理能力的最佳選擇。​

『ナイト・アンド・ドラゴン外伝』は、魔物との一対一の戦いに挑むハクスラアクションRPGです。

シリーズ従来のパーティ編成と仲間への指示を軸にした戦闘から、今作は一人のキャラクターを操作し、敵と直接攻防を繰り広げるスタイルへ。装備収集や育成の楽しさを受け継ぎながら、戦闘の仕組みと操作感が大きく生まれ変わりました。

攻撃を溜めるか、守りを固めるか、回避から反撃を狙うか。装備を選ぶ戦略と、敵の動きに応じる腕前で、強敵との勝負を切り開いてください。

■ 見切り、狙い、攻め切る。

目の前の敵と向き合い、攻防のタイミングを判断するリアルタイムバトル。シンプルな画面と直感的な操作でありながら、戦い方は一つではありません。

弱点を狙って一撃を放ち、傷口を攻めて追い詰める。敵が怒りをあらわにすれば、その勢いを見極めて立ち回りを変える。攻め続ければスタミナを失い、守りに徹するだけでは好機を逃す。敵の状態と自分の余力を読み、次の行動を選ぶ駆け引きが待っています。

■ その瞬間、指先に応える手応え。

迫る攻撃に合わせたジャストガード。間一髪で身をかわすジャスト回避。そして、好機を逃さず決めるジャストカウンター。

鋭く響く弾き音、回避とともに走る画面演出、溜めた一撃が命中する衝撃。操作に応えるUIとサウンドが、狙いどおりに攻防を決めた瞬間を彩ります。敵を知るほどに、挑むほどに、自分の上達を感じられる戦闘をお楽しみください。

■ 拾った一品が、次の戦いを変えていく。

戦利品を確かめ、装備を組み直し、再び魔物のもとへ。レアアイテムを求める冒険に、武具の制作・強化・カスタマイズ、クラスチェンジによる育成が重なり、戦い方の選択肢が広がります。

新たな装備種「ソウル」は、発動条件と効果の組み合わせが鍵。自分の立ち回りに合う構成を考え、「ソウルバースト」で一気に攻勢へ転じましょう。敵に合わせて装備を整えるか、得意な戦い方を磨くか。試行錯誤の先に、あなただけの攻略があります。

■

tw.description:
看穿敵人的一擊，趁隙打出反擊。
一對一獨有的攻防博弈，瞬間判斷得當的暢快。

《Knight & Dragon Side Story》是一款挑戰與魔物一對一戰鬥的刷寶動作RPG。

系列以往的戰鬥以隊伍編成與指揮同伴為核心，本作則轉為操控單個角色、直接與敵人展開攻防的戰鬥方式。在繼承裝備收集與養成樂趣的同時，戰鬥機制與操作手感也煥然一新。

要蓄力進攻，還是穩固防守，又或從閃避中尋找反擊機會？憑裝備選擇的策略，以及應對敵人動作的身手，在與強敵的較量中打開局面吧。

■ 看穿敵招，瞄準弱點，進攻制勝。

在即時戰鬥中與眼前的敵人正面對決，把握攻防時機。畫面簡潔，操作直觀，戰法卻不只一種。

瞄準弱點出擊，追擊傷口，將敵人逼入困境。敵人顯露怒意時，便要看準其勢頭，改變應對方式。持續進攻會消耗耐力，一味防守又會錯失良機。觀察敵人的狀態與自己的餘力，選擇下一步行動的攻防博弈，正等待你來體驗。

■ 那一瞬，回饋直達指尖。

迎著來襲的攻擊施展精準格擋。在千鈞一髮之際，以精準閃避躲過攻擊。再抓住良機，打出精準反擊。

彈開攻擊時清脆的聲響、隨閃避展開的畫面演出、蓄力一擊命中時的衝擊感。靈敏回應操作的UI與音效，為攻防如願奏效的瞬間添彩。盡情享受戰鬥，在一次次了解敵人、迎接挑戰的過程中，感受自己的進步。

■ 拾獲的一件裝備，改變下一場戰鬥。

查看戰利品，重新搭配裝備，再度迎戰魔物。追尋稀有道具的冒險，加上裝備製作、強化、自訂以及職階晉升的養成，讓戰鬥方式有了更多選擇。

全新裝備類型「靈魂」，關鍵在於發動條件與效果的組合。構思適合自己戰鬥方式的搭配，以「靈魂爆發」一舉轉入攻勢。是針對敵人調整裝備，還是打磨自己擅長的戰法？反覆嘗試，找出屬於自己的攻略之道。

■ 如同翻開一本小說。

古老書頁般的背景與細膩裝飾，包裹著一個中世紀奇幻世界。身為新進公會成員的你，將前往某個村莊執行警備任務，冒險也由此開始。

隨著你與同行的分析官追查魔物的威脅，事件背後的脈絡逐漸顯現。一段從另一視角解讀《Knight & Dragon III》劇情的全新騎士與龍的故事，將如翻閱書頁般徐徐展開。

This update is intended to make the app functional again for all those players and to provide them with some significant enhancements.

Guide your astronaut through seven distinct lunar districts, from a busy spaceport and greenhouse gardens to solar fields, excavation yards, research stations, a foundry, and a relay complex. Clean the ground to uncover service roads, landing markings, and the details of a working lunar world.

CLEAN AT YOUR OWN PACE

Chase high scores, improve with every round, and compete against yourself in a game that’s all about pure, personal progress.
Whether you're on a train, in line, in an elevator, or anywhere you can’t (or don’t want to) use your iPhone, Block Blast is always ready.
No ads, no internet required—just smooth, uninterrupted gameplay.
Also available on Mac, so you can keep the challenge going on the big screen.

gb.description:
Become a demigod and keep the horde of heathens away from your temple! 

Take on the role of one of the mighty Greek heroes and defend your temple against hordes of mythological creatures using a vast array of powerful weapons and godly powers!

Clash of the Olympians highlights:
* Action packed defend the temple game that will test your wits and precision!

* 3 Heroes to choose from: Play as the mighty Heracles, the quick Perseus or the legendary Achilles!

* Face mythological creatures with different abilities! Minotaurs, Gorgons, Harpies and more!

* Train your hero! Upgrade his weapons and grant him special powers! Each hero has his own arsenal so choose wisely!

* Arcade style rewards! Show off your skill by performing head shots, multi-kills, quick kills and more!

So what are you waiting for! The hordes of Hades are approaching and only you can stop them!

Bring'em ON!

gb.description:
Mine rocks!
Keep on Mining! is a simple incremental game. Hover your cursor over rocks to automatically mine them. Any rock inside the mining area will spawn pickaxes that mine for you!


Gather materials!
Mined rocks drop ores, which are crafted into bars. There is a variety of different material rocks to be mined!

The skill tree!
Spend your material bars to unlock upgrades inside the skill tree. These upgrades permanently boost your stats, letting you mine rocks with more power!

Craft pickaxes! 
Use different materials to craft new pickaxes. Each new pickaxe has better stats, helping you mine faster and hit harder!

Talent cards!
Every time you level up, you earn a talent point. Spend talent points to reveal 3 random talent cards — pick one to keep! Choosing a card increases the talent level, but also increases rock HP.

The Mine!
Once you unlock the mine, it will automatically mine

gb.description:
Voidloop is a mining adventure with roguelite and incremental elements.

You play as a lonely Void Spirit who has wandered too far from home. 
Use your camp as a hub to prepare for each descent into ever-changing caves filled with rare loot and dangerous foes. 
Each dive brings you closer to your home at bottom of the cave...

Features:
- Descend through 5 unique cave biomes, each filled with procedurally generated floors, unique hazards, and valuable resources.
- Race against time as you push toward floor 20 of each cave to collect powerful gems and find your way back to the void.
- Return to camp between runs to trade, craft, and upgrade your spirit with the help of the Blacksmith, Shopkeeper, and Witch.
- Mine, fight, and loot over 60+ unique items, then progress your journey with 100+ upgrades and 34 powerful skills that make you stronger each run.
- Cloud saving support with iCloud

de.description:
Voidloop ist ein Mining-Abenteuer mit Roguelite- und inkrementellen Elementen.

Du spielst als ein einsamer Void-Geist, der sich zu weit von seinem Zuhause entfernt hat. 
Nutze dein Lager als Ausgangspunkt, um dich auf jeden Abstieg in sich ständig verändernde Höhlen voller seltener Beute und gefährlicher Feinde vorzubereiten. 
Jeder Abstieg bringt dich deinem Zuhause am Grund der Höhle näher...

Inhalte:
- Steige durch 5 einzigartige Höhlen-Biome hinab, die jeweils voller prozedural generierter Ebenen, besonderer Gefahren und wertvoller Ressourcen stecken.
- Renne gegen die Zeit, während du dich bis Ebene 20 jeder Höhle durchkämpfst, mächtige Edelsteine sammelst und deinen Weg zurück in das Void findest.
- Kehre zwischen den Läufen ins Lager zurück, um mithilfe des Schmieds, des Ladenbesitzers und der Hexe zu handeln, Ausrüstung herzustellen und deinen Geist zu verbessern.
- Grabe, kämp

Curious about how aliens view our world? Looking for Aliens takes you on an unforgettable journey where you uncover the strange, funny, and sometimes absurd truth about life on Earth—all through extraterrestrial eyes. Explore colorful scenes packed with surprises, humor, and easy puzzles in this hidden-object game.
From secret alien outposts to bustling human cities, each level invites you to explore a world where nothing is quite as it seems. With over 25 hand-drawn locations and hundreds of quirky objects to find, the game’s colorful art style and creative settings will keep you hooked for hours.

Explore each scene at your own pace, hunting for objects and uncovering hidden surprises. Need help? Use the built-in hints system to keep moving without losing the thrill of discovery.

Key Features:

• Interactive Gameplay: Dive into richly animated scenes where every tap unveils a surprise

gb.description:
Sixfold is a thoughtful puzzle game about colour, space and planning ahead.

Each game gives you 72 pieces — play them one at a time onto the grid. The next three pieces are always visible so you can plan your moves.

Place two pieces with colours in common next to each other and their segments move across, consolidating matching colours. Bring six segments of the same colour together and the completed piece disappears from the board.

Six colours. Six segments. Sixfold.

Your goal is to complete as many single-colour pieces as you can. Every placement matters: sometimes the obvious move is best, and sometimes it’s worth leaving space for what you know is coming next.

You have 72 pieces. How well can you use them? Can you beat your high score?

與好友策略防禦戰術，透過各種配置來阻擋敵人進攻！ 
一個人的力量很小，但團結力量大！

相揪好友來合作，提升團隊防禦力！ 
只要同心協力，什麼都難不倒！

每個玩家分工合作，建立完美防禦體系，

大批敵人來襲，

jp.description:
Fallen Beauty: マージ&ストーリー
マージでスタイルを。ひとときを、人生を変える。
『Fallen Beauty』は、マージゲームプレイ、ドレスアップファッション、心に響く物語が一体となったユニークなゲームです。
あなたが追うのは名声ではなく、変化の時を迎えた“本物の人々”を手助けすることです。
マージ。スタイル。ストーリー。
直感的なマージ操作で、メイク道具、洋服、アクセサリーを集めましょう。
アイテムを組み合わせてアップグレードすると、新しいルックが解放されます。その一つひとつが、誰かの次の一歩を後押しします。
癒しのパズル、ファッションスタイリング、ストーリー重視のゲーム――好きなものが何であれ、『Fallen Beauty』はそのすべてを、本物の人間ドラマに包んでお届けします。
あなただけのファッションを解き放つ
ランウェイだけではない、リアルな瞬間にふさわしいルックを創造しましょう。内から湧く自信を高めるものから大胆な転機まで、あなたのスタイリングが物語の行方を形作ります。
自然なトーンから印象的な主張まで、表現豊かなメイクを自由にコーディネート
 
専用サロンで、ヘアスタイル・カラー・雰囲気を思いのままに変更
 
人生の節目――最初のチャンス、再挑戦、新たなスタートに合わせてスタイリング
 
彼らが“なりたい自分”を映し出すルックを見つけ出す
 
あなたの選択は、ただ服を変えるだけではありません。彼らが自分自身に抱く思いまで変えていくのです。
ゲームの特徴
創造力と戦略が報われる、中毒性のあるマージパズル
 
リアルなメイク要素を備えた、本格メイクオーバーゲームプレイ
 
ドレスアップ・メイクオーバー・ファッションゲームファンに愛される、深みのある着せ替えシステム
 
選択がキャラクターの旅路を形作る、エピソード形式のストーリー
 
期間限定チャレンジと、やりがいのある報酬
 
アップデートごとに新アイテムが増えるクローゼット――お気に入りのファッションアプリのように
 
こんな方におすすめ
女性向け無料ゲーム、着せ替えゲーム、ストーリー重視の

tw.description:
步入《Fallen Beauty》，體驗合成玩法、時尚穿搭與情感故事的獨特結合。你來到這裡並非為了追求名利，而是為了幫助真實的人們渡過改變人生的關鍵時刻。
合成。穿搭。故事。
利用直覺的合成機制來收集化妝工具、服裝和配件。透過組合與升級道具來解鎖全新造型——每一個造型都將幫助某個人跨出走向未來的下一步。無論你熱愛輕鬆的益智遊戲、時尚造型，還是劇情驅動的遊戲，《Fallen Beauty》都能一次滿足你這三個願望，並將其融入真實而動人的溫暖故事中。
釋放你內心的時尚新星 (Fashion Nova)
打造適合真實生活場景的造型，而不僅僅是伸展台。從內斂的自信提升到大膽的人生轉折點，你的造型設計將深深影響每個故事的發展。
-精心搭配具表現力的妝容，從自然裸妝到吸睛的強烈風格應有盡有
-在你的私人沙龍中改變髮型、髮色與心情
-為人生的關鍵時刻量身打造穿搭——初次的機遇、重生的機會，以及全新的開始
-尋找能夠反映他們「正在成為什麼樣的人」的專屬造型
-每一次的選擇不僅漸是改變一套衣服——更改變了他們對自己的信念。
遊戲特色：
-令人欲罷不能的合成益智遊戲，獎勵你的創意與策略
-包含擬真化妝遊戲元素的完整改造玩法
-深受穿搭、改造和時尚遊戲愛好者喜愛的深度換裝機制
-章節式故事劇情，你的每個決定都將塑造各個角色的命運旅程
-限時挑戰與深具意義的豐富獎勵
-每次更新皆會加入全新道具的衣櫃——就像你最愛的服飾 App 一樣
完美推薦給以下玩家：
女孩遊戲、換裝遊戲以及劇情驅動遊戲的愛好者。如果你熱愛合成益智遊戲、時尚改造，以及充滿真實感的故事，這就是屬於你的時刻。不只是為某人打造造型——更是幫助他們重新開始。

※ 本遊戲軟體分級管理辦法分類為普遍級。
※ 本遊戲為免費遊戲，但遊戲內另提供購買虛擬遊戲幣、物品等付費服務，請依個人興趣及能力進行適度消費。
※ 本遊戲由香港商阿爾發遊戲有限公司臺灣分公司代理。
※ 請注意遊戲時間，避免沉迷，長時間進行遊戲，容易影響作息，宜適度休息及運動。
如有疑問，請以本遊戲客服管道聯繫。

kr.description:
Fallen Beauty: 머지&스토리
머지로 스타일을. 순간을, 인생을 바꾸다.
『Fallen Beauty』는 머지 게임플레이, 드레스업 패션, 감성적인 스토리텔링이 독특하게 결합된 게임입니다.
당신이 좇는 것은 명성이 아니라, 변화의 순간을 맞은 ‘진짜 사람들’을 돕는 일입니다.
머지. 스타일. 스토리.
직관적인 머지 방식을 통해 메이크업 도구, 의상, 액세서리를 수집하세요.
아이템을 조합하고 업그레이드하면 새로운 룩이 해금됩니다. 각각의 룩은 누군가의 다음 걸음을 도울 것입니다.
휴식적인 퍼즐, 패션 스타일링, 스토리 중심의 게임을 좋아하든, 『Fallen Beauty』는 그 모든 것을 진짜 인간 드라마 속에 담아 선사합니다.
당신만의 패션 감각을 드러내세요
러너웨이만을 위한 것이 아닌, 진짜 순간에 어울리는 룩을 창조하세요. 조용한 자신감 충전부터 대담한 전환점까지, 당신의 스타일링이 각 스토리의 전개를 결정합니다.
내추럴 톤부터 강렬한 포인트까지, 표현력豊かな 메이크업을 자유롭게 연출
 
나만의 살롱에서 헤어스타일, 색상, 분위기를 자유자재로 변경
 
인생의 중요한 순간——첫 기회, 두 번째 기회, 새로운 시작을 위한 스타일링
 
그들이 ‘되어 가는 자신’을 비추는 룩을 찾아내기
 
당신의 선택은 단순한 옷차림을 바꾸는 것이 아닙니다. 그들이 자신에 대해 품는 믿음까지 변화시킵니다.
게임 특징
창의력과 전략을 보상하는 중독성 강한 머지 퍼즐
 
리얼한 메이크업 게임 요소를 갖춘 본격 메이크오버 게임플레이
 
드레스업, 메이크오버, 패션 게임 팬이 사랑하는 깊이 있는 옷입히기 시스템
 
선택이 각 캐릭터의 여정을 형성하는 에피소드형 스토리
 
기간 한정 도전과 의미 있는 보상
 
업데이트 때마다 새 아이템이 채워지는 옷장——당신이 좋아하는 패션 앱처럼
 
이런 분께 추천합니다

gb.description:
"You don't see them... but they see you.

You’re an orphan, raised by a wandering feng shui master who found you near a graveyard. Before he died, he handed you a locked box—the only clue to your past. After burying him, you begin your journey to uncover the truth.
Your first lead brings you to a run-down apartment building. You move in as a tenant—but something is deeply wrong.
- The elevator opens by itself—on floors no one pressed.
- An empty unit echoes with whispers that don’t exist.
- A cursed construction site keeps taking lives...
What starts as a ghost story becomes something far more disturbing.
Because sometimes, the real horror isn’t the ghost—it’s the people.

Game Features:
Face your fears and uncover long-buried secrets
Merge clues to reveal hidden truths
Look closely - every detail could crack the case
Solve puzzles and relax through a hauntingly original experience

Dare

de.description:
Du siehst sie nicht ... aber sie sehen dich.

Du bist ein Waisenkind, das von einem wandernden Feng-Shui-Meister aufgezogen wurde, der dich in der Nähe eines Friedhofs gefunden hat. Bevor er starb, gab er dir eine verschlossene Schatulle – den einzigen Hinweis auf deine Vergangenheit. Nachdem du ihn beerdigt hast, beginnst du deine Reise, um die Wahrheit aufzudecken.
Dein erster Hinweis führt dich zu einem heruntergekommenen Wohnhaus. Du ziehst als Mieterin ein – aber irgendetwas stimmt hier ganz und gar nicht.
– Der Aufzug öffnet sich von selbst – in Stockwerken, die niemand gedrückt hat.
– In einer leeren Wohnung erklingt ein Flüstern, das gar nicht real ist.
– Eine verfluchte Baustelle fordert immer wieder Menschenleben ...
Was als Geistergeschichte beginnt, entwickelt sich zu etwas weitaus Beunruhigenderem.
Denn manchmal ist der wahre Horror nicht ein Geist – es sind die Menschen.

S

jp.description:
「人間の悪意は、気づかぬうちに芽生える」「見えない場所で、常に誰かの視線が注がれている」

あなたは風水師に墓地で拾われた棄児。先生が最期に託したのは、一つの箱。そこには、あなたの身元を解き明かす手がかりが隠されていた。

葬儀を終えたあなたは、箱を頼りに肉親を探す旅へ出た。
最初の手がかりは、不可解な噂が絶えない雑居ビル。
あなたは居住者を装い、一室を借りて調査を開始する。

- 真夜中、誰も乗っていないはずなのに、エレベーターのボタンが勝手に光る…
- 空き部屋から、毎晩人の声が聞こえる…
- 工事現場では、不可解な事故が相次ぐ…

やがて浮かび上がるのは、超常現象ではなく、
人間の欲望と野心が仕組んだ数々の「嘘」だった。

遊び方：
恐怖に惑わされず、肉親の真実を探せ
手がかりをマージし、事件の全貌をつかめ
怪しい痕跡を見抜き、隠された真相にたどり着け
推理の爽快感を味わえる、新感覚パズルミステリーゲーム！

解くべき謎：
親は本当にあなたを捨てたのか？ それとも言えないわけがあるのか？
「幽霊」は実在するのか？ それとも誰かが作り上げた虚構か？
誰が怪談を利用し、罪を覆い隠そうとしている？あなたを欺こうとしているのは一体誰なのか？
怪異の連続は天罰なのか、人為的な陰謀なのか？

あなたにおすすめ：
都市伝説や怪談を「謎」として解き明かしたい人
マージ×パズルで手がかりを集め、推理を楽しみたい人
超常現象よりも、人間の悪意や策略にこそ恐ろしさを感じる人

ぜひ「誰か助けて」をプレイしてみてください！
散らばる証拠をつなぎ合わせ、仕組まれた嘘を暴け！奇怪な噂と謎が渦巻く都市伝説の闇の中であなたは肉親と真実にたどり着けるだろうか？

Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/HauntedMergeGames

tw.description:
「最深的惡意，往往藏在難以察覺的角落。」[在你看不見的地方，總有一雙眼睛，正在悄悄盯著你]


你是個孤兒，在墓地裡被老風水師撿回撫養。師父臨終前，交給你一個神祕盒子，說裡面的東西，能幫你找回身世真相。為師父辦完後事後，你踏上尋親之路，第一條線索，指向這棟詭異的大樓。你決定先租房搬進去，再另做打算。
- 午夜的電梯，在無人按下的樓層悄然開啟……
- 空蕩的公寓，夜夜傳出不該存在的低語聲……
- 被詛咒的工地，事故接連不斷，吞噬著一條條無辜的生命……
你很快發現，這些離奇事件的背後，糾纏著比厲鬼還要可怕的凶物——人的貪婪與野心。

遊戲功能：
直視恐懼，追查失蹤雙親
合併線索，層層推進劇情
洞察環境，挖掘驚人真相
舒壓享受，體驗前所未有的益智遊戲！

直闖陰影深處，那些未解之謎仍在等你：
父母是真的拋下孩子，還是另有隱情？或是觸犯了什麼禁忌？
你能分得清哪些是真正的凶靈，哪些又是人為編造的惡意？
是誰藉著「怪談」掩蓋罪行？又是誰，一直在暗處注視著你？
那些離奇的慘劇，是天罰？是人禍？還是……真的——有鬼？！

如果你：
痴迷都市怪談的毛骨悚然，渴望拆穿真相偽裝！
熱愛燒腦解謎與合併玩法，享受抽絲剝繭的快感！
著迷於人性陰暗面在極端壓力下的扭曲與爆發！

那麼——《誰來救救我》將是你唯一的選擇！
合併關鍵證據，破解人為詭局，從光怪陸離的詭談傳聞中，追尋至親與真相的終極答案！

Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/HauntedMergeGames

kr.description:
당신은 그들을 보지 못하지만... 그들은 당신을 봅니다.

고아인 당신을 키운 것은 묘지 근처에서 당신을 발견한 방랑하는 풍수 전문가였죠. 죽기 전에, 그는 잠겨 있는 상자 하나를 남겼습니다. 당신의 과거에 관한 유일한 단서였죠. 그를 묻은 후, 당신은 진실을 밝히기 위한 여정에 오르게 됩니다.
최초의 단서를 따라 당신은 황폐해진 아파트 건물에 도착하게 됩니다. 세입자가 되어 그 집으로 이사를 들어가지만... 무언가 심각하기 잘못되어 있습니다.
- 엘리베이터 문이 저 혼자 열립니다... 아무도 누르지 않은 층에 말이죠.
- 빈 세대에서 존재하지 않는 속삭임이 울려 퍼집니다.
- 저주받은 건설 현장이 계속해서 목숨을 빼앗습니다...
유령 이야기로 시작해서 훨씬 더 충격적인 무언가로 진화해 나가죠.
왜냐하면 가끔은, 정말로 공포스러운 건 유령이 아니라... 사람이기 때문입니다.

게임의 특징:
두려움에 맞서고 오래전에 파묻은 비밀을 파내 보세요
단서를 합쳐서 숨겨진 진실을 밝히세요
자세히 살펴 보세요... 디테일 하나 하나가 사건을 해결해 낼 수 있습니다
퍼즐을 풀고 뇌리에 남는 특이한 경험을 즐기며 휴식을 취하세요

용감하게 더 깊게 파 보시겠습니까?
부모님이 사라졌습니다. 그런데 왜일까요?
저주일까요... 아니면 은폐하려는 수작일까요?
무엇이 진짜고, 무엇이 계략인지 구분할 수 있을까요?
사람이 계속해서 죽어 나갑니다. 사고일까요? 혹은 더 끔찍한 일일까요?

이런 분들께 딱 알맞습니다.
오싹한 설화와 소름 끼치는 미스터리를 사랑하신다면
반전이 있는 합치기 메커니즘을 좋아하신다면
인간 본성의 어두운 면에 관한 이야기에 끌리는 분이라면
유일한 출구는 이곳입니다.

Haunted Merge: Horror Story를 다운로드하세요
증거를 합치세요. 진실을 밝히세요.
그들이 지우려 했던 모

gb.description:
Fish Jam Fever is a relaxing triple-match puzzle where logic meets playful physics. Turn a cluttered aquarium into your calmest few minutes of the day.

Tap and match three fish of the same color to clear their bubbles. Watch how bubbles float, fish shift, and the board changes after every move.

Every level is a small logic puzzle. Read the layout, plan your matches, and use the movement of the fish and bubbles to your advantage.

Hundreds of handcrafted puzzle levels
Logic-based challenges with playful bubble physics
No timers, no pressure, think as long as you like
Dozens of colorful fish and reef creatures to discover
Easy to play, increasingly tricky to solve

Your first tank is waiting! Take your time, find the right moves.

Fish Jam Fever is a relaxing triple-match puzzle where logic meets playful physics. Turn a cluttered aquarium into your calmest few minutes of the day.

Tap and match three fish of the same color to clear their bubbles. Watch how bubbles float, fish shift, and the board changes after every move.

Every level is a small logic puzzle. Read the layout, plan your matches, and use the movement of the fish and bubbles to your advantage.

Hundreds of handcrafted puzzle levels
Logic-based challenges with playful bubble physics
No timers, no pressure, think as long as you like
Dozens of colorful fish and reef creatures to discover
Easy to play, increasingly tricky to solve

Your first tank is waiting! Take your time, find the right moves.

Escape from the routine and relax! For any age and gender! A klondike of adventures! A real treasure island in the world of travel! The main characters are Alex and Emma. Let's get to know them better! 

After her husband's betrayal, Alex returns to her mother's old family farm with her daughter, Emma. But instead of a quiet life, she's faced with debts and visits from her ex-husband Graham and his lawyer, who are trying to take the land away. kr.description:
저희가 준비한 새로운 캐주얼 결합 게임을 플레이하세요! 온 가족이 함께 즐길 수 있는 새로운 모바일 캐주얼 게임, Pines Peak입니다! 이 캐주얼 결합 게임은 온 가족이 즐길 수 있도록 디자인되었습니다!

일상에서 벗어나 휴식을 취하세요! 모든 연령대와 성별이 즐길 수 있습니다! 진정한 모험이 펼쳐집니다! 여행의 세상 속 진정한 보물섬과 같은 곳이죠! 주인공은 알렉스와 엠마입니다. 주인공에 대해 더 자세히 알아볼까요? 

남편의 배신을 겪은 알렉스는 딸 엠마와 함께 어머니의 오래된 가족 농장으로 돌아갑니다. 하지만 알렉스를 기다리는 것은 조용한 삶이 아니라, 빚이었습니다. 게다가 전남편인 그레이엄과 그의 변호사는 알렉스의 땅을 빼앗으려고 하죠. 가족에게 남은 유일한 것은 농장뿐인 상황에서, 알렉스는 그 어떤 방법을 써서라도 농장을 지키겠다고 결심합니다.

엠마는 어려운 상황에서도 재미를 찾는 방법을 배웁니다. 이웃을 만나고, 귀여운 강아지를 입양하고, 어머니가 새로운 삶을 시작할 수 있도록 돕고, 농장에 숨겨진 모든 비밀을 열심히 탐구하죠. 알렉스가 포기하지 않게 해주는 가장 큰 동기는 바로 엠마입니다. 알렉스는 딸의 미래가 자신에게 달려 있다는 것을 알고 있으니까요.

농장이 점차 활기를 되찾으면서, 곁을 지켜줄 친구와 동맹이 나타납니다. 바로 배려심 많은 이웃 마지, 충성스러운 강아지 픽시, 옛 연인 세바스찬, 어린 시절 친구 카산드라죠. 이들은 함께 건물을 복원하고, 불의에 맞서 싸웁니다. 하지만 승리할 때마다, 알렉스는 집 밖에 세워진 검은색 차, ""V.V""라는 이니셜이 새겨진 이상한 열쇠, 비비엔 시장의 그림자 등 새로운 미스터리에 직면합니다. 비비엔 시장의 방문은 지역 주민의 삶을 돌보기 위해서라기보다는, 숨겨진 위협처럼 느껴지기 시작하죠.

tw.description:
歡迎踏入這個融合了美食魔法、溫馨故事與趣味解謎的治癒世界！
為了從貪婪的餐飲巨頭手中保住祖母的餐廳，設計師貝拉回到了故鄉小鎮，而她急需你的幫助。快來和貪吃可愛的橘貓小番茄結伴，一起重振家族老店，踏上一場探尋美食真諦的環球之旅吧！
在這裡，每一次合併都傳遞著指尖的溫度，每一道佳肴都承載著珍貴的回憶。你準備好用充滿靈魂的純粹美味，去擊潰冰冷的預製菜帝國了嗎？
合併與烹飪
 • 輕鬆合併：拖曳並合併基礎食材，解鎖500多種令人垂涎的美食與廚具。
 • 研發配方：從祖母的秘製番茄醬到世界各地的特色料理，在合併中提升你的廚藝！
 • 解壓體驗：享受簡單、解壓且極具沉浸感的合併謎題，掃除一天的疲憊。
裝修與設計
 • 築夢餐廳：發揮你的設計天賦，親手打造屬於你的夢想美食天堂。
 • 爽快解鎖：按照你的節奏點亮餐廳的每一個角落。隨著旅行的深入，還能解鎖並建成充滿異國風情的主題餐廳！
環遊世界
 • 全球之旅：從小鎮出發，前往美國、墨西哥、法國、義大利等地，開啟美食探索！
 • 解鎖新區域：每個國家都有獨特的地域食材、全新的NPC顧客和各國獨特的建築。
治癒故事與羈絆
 • 溫暖劇情：體驗一段關於愛、成長與尋找自我的故事。「在這裡，你只需要照顧好自己，你值得一切軟軟暖暖的東西。」
 • 結識夥伴：邂逅性格迥異的朋友，與青梅竹馬重逢，共同揭開祖母配方背後的神秘往事。
 • 萌寵陪伴：投喂你的專屬橘貓小番茄，牠是你治癒之旅中最忠誠的守護神！
現在就下載「Yumtopia」！在合併與烹飪中，開啟一段悄悄治癒心底的小美好。

요리의 마법, 따뜻한 이야기, 그리고 재미있는 퍼즐이 어우러진 힐링의 세계로 들어오세요! 탐욕스러운 거대 식품 기업으로부터 할머니의 레스토랑을 지키기 위해 고향으로 돌아온 디자이너 벨라에게는 당신의 도움이 필요합니다. 식탐 많고 귀여운 치즈 냥이 '모모'와 함께 가족의 오래된 가게를 재건하고, 진정한 레시피를 찾기 위한 세계 여행을 떠나보세요!
이곳에서는 합칠 때마다 따뜻함이 전해지고, 모든 요리에는 소중한 추억이 담겨 있습니다. 영혼이 담긴 순수한 맛으로 차가운 가공식품 제국에 맞설 준비가 되셨나요?
합성 & 요리
• 쉬운 합치기: 기본 식재료를 드래그하여 합치면 500가지 이상의 먹음직스러운 요리와 주방 장비를 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다.
• 레시피 개발: 할머니의 비법 토마토 소스부터 전 세계의 특색 있는 요리까지, 합쳐서 요리 실력을 키워보세요!
• 스트레스 해소: 간단하고 몰입감 넘치는 퍼즐을 즐기며 하루의 피로를 날려버리세요.
 인테리어 & 디자인
• 꿈의 레스토랑: 당신의 디자인 재능을 발휘하여 나만의 꿈꾸던 미식 천국을 직접 꾸며보세요.
• 통쾌한 잠금 해제: 나만의 속도로 레스토랑의 모든 구석구석을 완성하세요. 여행이 깊어질수록 이국적인 테마의 레스토랑을 잠금 해제하고 건설할 수 있습니다!
전 세계 여행
• 글로벌 어드벤처: 작은 마을을 출발해 미국, 멕시코, 프랑스, 이탈리아 등으로 미식 탐험을 떠나세요!
• 새로운 지역 잠금 해제: 각 국가마다 독특한 지역 식재료, 새로운 NPC 고객, 그리고 이국적인 건축물이 있습니다.
힐링 스토리 & 비밀

gb.description:
Sand Loop is a relaxing sand sort puzzle: a finished sand artwork is sitting in front of you, and your job is to collect every grain of it.

Guide the buckets along the conveyor, pour each colour into the one that matches, and let real sand physics do the rest. Take the whole picture apart, colour by colour, until the board is clear. Unwind after a long day, or take one level at a time on the bus.

How to play:
- Tap to release a bucket and send it down the conveyor
- Pour each colour of sand into the bucket that matches
- Work through the artwork until every grain is collected
- Read the loop and time your release as the boards get busier
- Clear the board and enjoy the payoff

Easy to pick up, genuinely tricky by level 100.

Why you'll love it:
The sweet spot between a brain teaser and a stress-relief game. Simple taps, beautiful results, steady progress, plus sand physics and ASMR-sty

Kläre dir zunächst die Levelziele. Achte auf die Farbe der Box oben und klicke auf die Schrauben der entsprechenden Farbe, bis alle Schrauben gelöst und in der Box gesammelt sind.
Zweitens erfordert das Spiel Strategie und schnelle Reaktion. Beim Lösen der Schrauben am Glas werden diese manchmal durch das Glas blockiert. Das Glas fällt dann automatisch durch die Schwerkraft nach unten. Du musst die Fallbahn des Glases vorhersehen und schnell auf die blockierten Schrauben klicken, um zu vermeiden, dass das Glas nicht vollständig herunterfällt und die Schrauben erneut blockiert.

tw.description:
Screw Project 是一款富有挑戰的益智解謎遊戲，在Screw Project中享受玩螺絲遊戲的樂趣並挑戰令人驚奇的關卡。

如何玩遊戲？
首先，明確關卡目標。觀察上方的盒子顏色，點擊對應顏色的螺絲釘，直到將全部螺絲釘擰下收集至盒子裡；
其次，遊戲需要一定的策略和快速的反應。擰掉玻璃上的螺絲釘，有時會有螺絲釘被玻璃遮擋，玻璃在重力的作用下會自動掉落，需要提前預測玻璃的掉落軌跡，迅速點擊被遮擋的螺絲釘，以免玻璃未完全掉落再次遮擋螺絲釘；
另外，遊戲中的釘子多種多樣，有星星形狀的螺絲釘，有被繩子連接在一起的螺絲釘，點擊其中任何一個都會被放置在釘子孔上，如果釘子掛滿釘子孔，關卡失敗！有些關卡還有風扇釘哦，請仔細觀察！
別擔心，關卡沒有時間限制，支持使用道具輔助通關，大膽參與吧！

在這款令人上癮的螺絲釘遊戲中，您會發現這些有趣的功能：
- 驚人的助推器可幫助您一路前行
- 設計精美的關卡
- 豐富有趣的活動
- 簡單輕鬆的螺絲釘遊戲

Screw Project有獨特的遊戲玩法，每個關卡都設計精美，充滿緊張刺激的遊戲體驗，快開啟遊戲之旅吧！

- Smooth & simple controls
- Easy to learn hard to master
- Automatic save game
- Global Leader Boards
- No time limits.
- No wifi connection required
- Haptic feedback
- Exercise your brain and relieve stress
- Enjoy with your firnds

jp.description:
Blockudokuは数独とブロックパズルが融合したオリジナルゲーム。シンプルだけどチャレンジ性のあるパズルだからハマること間違いなし。

ブロックを一致させてラインと四角いマスを埋めて消していきます。ボードをきれいに保って自分の最高得点を超えてみよう。

遊び方：

- 9x9のマス目にブロックを落とす
- 線と四角を埋めて、ボードからブロックを消そう
- ディリーチャレンジを達成して特別なトロフィーを獲得しましょう。
- シーズンイベントに参加して、ユニークな動くポストカードを手に入れましょう。
- トーナメントで他のプレイヤーと対戦したり、自己ハイスコアを更新したり、リーダーボードの順位を上げましょう。
- 一気に複数を破壊できたらコンボ
- 連続した動きが成功すればストリーク

『Blockudoku』マスターになる方法

• 時間制限がないので、急ぐ必要はありません。困難な動きに直面した場合は、その一歩先を考えてみましょう。それが決定的な一手になるかもしれません。
• ボードがいっぱいにならないよう、ブロックを配置して一手ごとにラインや3x3のマスを破壊しましょう。
• ブロックをできるだけ早く壊すことと、できるだけ多くのコンボと連続成功の両方をバランスよくこなして、より高いスコアを獲得しましょう。
• 連続成功でより多くポイントを獲得しましょう。ボードが空なほど、良い状況です!
• いいブロックが来るのを待つのはリスクが高いものです。行動回数はすぐになくなりがちです。壊せるチャンスを見つけたら、壊してしまいましょう。

ストレス緩和や脳トレに。気軽に楽しめて、手ごわいゲーム、Blockudokuをいつでもどこでもお楽しみください。

- 일일 도전을 완료하고 특별한 트로피를 획득하세요.
- 시즌 이벤트에 참가하여 움직이는 특별한 엽서를 받으세요.
- 토너먼트에서 다른 플레이어와 경쟁하며 자신의 기록을 경신하고 순위표에서 위로 올라가세요.
- 한 번에 여러 요소를 파괴해서 콤보를 만드세요.
- 연속으로 여러 움직임을 만들어 연속 성공을 달성하세요.

Blockudoku 마스터가 되는 방법은?

• 시간 제한은 없으니 서두를 필요는 없어요. 하다가 막히면 한 단계 앞서 생각하세요. 마지막 기회일 수 있으니 말이죠.
• 보드에 블록을 배치하며 수를 둘 때마다 선이나 3x3 크기의 사각형을 제거해 보드가 가득 차지 않게 하세요.
• 가능한 한 빨리 모양을 파괴하는 것과 가능한 한 많이 콤보와 연속 성공을 하는 것 사이에 균형을 유지하여 더 높은 점수를 받으세요.
• 연속 성공하여 점수를 더 받으세요. 보드를 비울수록 더 많은 점수를 받게 됩니다!
• 좋은 블록을 기다리기만 하는 건 언제나 위험할 수 있어요. 수를 두는 횟수가 빠르게 줄어들 수 있거든요. 모양을 파괴할 기회가 있으면 바로 파괴하세요.

언제 어디서든 편안하면서도 도전적인 Blockudoku 게임으로 스트레스를 해소하거나 두뇌를 단련하세요!

jp.description:
「スパイダーソリティア」は大人気のクラシックソリティアのオリジナルルールと、最新の機能を組み合わせたカードゲームです。みんな大好きなソリティアで、まったく新しいゲーム体験を楽しみましょう。スパイダーソリティアをプレイして知能指数の限界に挑戦し、連続勝利で高レベルのステージに到達してベストスコア更新を目指すのです！

スパイダーソリティアの注目要素：

- クラシックなゲームプレイ
同じマークのカードを降順に重ねて（キングからエースまで）ゲームに勝利しましょう。難易度レベルに応じてプレイするマークを1、2，4つに調節することが可能です。

- 脳トレで頭の体操を継続
高レベルのステージ到達を目指して脳トレに励み、ポイント稼ぎに勤しみましょう。

- 羽を伸ばしてのんびりプレイ
退屈な日々の仕事を忘れてリラックスモードに突入しましょう。休憩中や一日の仕事終わりなど、いつでもどこでもスマホでプレイ可能です。

スパイダーソリティアの機能：

- 様々な難易度レベル
プレイするマークの数を1、2、4つの中から選んでゲーム体験を調節しましょう。好きなだけ遊ぶための条件を整えるのは、あなたの手に委ねられています。

- ステージ
戦略をマスターし、スパイダーソリティアのゲームに勝利しましょう。高ステージに上り詰め、ベストスコア更新を狙うのです！高ステージでは獲得ポイントも増加します！

- シーズンイベント
様々な難易度レベルのソリティアをプレイしながらユニーク画像を発見しましょう。シーズンイベントをクリアし、特製ポストカードのコレクションを完成させるのです！

- デイリーチャレンジ
スパイダーソリティアチャレンジに毎日挑戦し、トロフィーを毎月獲得しましょう。

- カードと背景をカスタマイズ
多彩なテーマから選択し、集中力を維持してゲームをさらに満喫しましょう。

- ヒントとやり直し機能
操作を間違えましたか？それとも次の一手に悩んでいますか？スマートヒントとやり直し機能をご活用ください！

- シンプルなタップ＆ドラッグ操作
シンプルにカードをタップ＆ドラッグし、スムーズな

tw.trackName: Spider Solitaire - 經典接龍紙牌遊戲
tw.description:
Spider Solitaire 結合了最受歡迎的經典紙牌遊戲之一的原始規則與一系列激動人心的功能。盡情在你最愛的紙牌遊戲中享受全新體驗。遊玩Spider Solitaire 來挑戰你的思維，透過每一次連續的勝利達到更高的階段，並刷新你的最高得分！

Spider Solitaire 的亮點：

- 經典玩法
按照降序（從K到A）堆疊一種花色的紙牌以贏得遊戲。可以選擇1、2或4種花色來調整難度等級。

- 保持你的思維活躍
訓練你的頭腦並進行練習以達到更高的階段，贏得盡可能多的分數。

- 放鬆心情
從日常工作轉向輕鬆消遣。在片刻小休或是工作之餘，你可以隨時隨地透過行動裝置遊玩這款紙牌接龍遊戲。

Spider Solitaire 的特色：

- 各種難度級別
選擇1、2或4種花色數量，根據你的經驗調整遊戲，盡情享受樂趣。

- 階段
掌握你的策略，贏得 Spider Solitaire 遊戲，進入更高的階段，刷新你的最高得分！你達到的階段越高，得到的分數就越多！

- 賽季活動
在玩多種難度級別的紙牌遊戲時，揭示獨特的圖片。完成賽季活動，打造你自己特別製作的明信片收藏！

- 每日挑戰
透過每天遊玩 Spider Solitaire 挑戰，贏得每月獎杯。

- 可定制的卡片和背景
從各種主題中選擇，幫助你保持專注，更能享受遊戲。

- 提示和撤銷
在遊戲中走錯了一步或不確定該怎麼做？智慧提示和撤銷將為你提供幫助！

- 簡單的點選或拖動控制
簡單地點選或拖動紙牌，享受流暢的體驗。

- 自動儲存
從你離開的地方繼續遊戲。

- 左手模式
為左撇子提供的特殊介面

訓練你的頭腦，在刷新 Spider Solitaire 高分的道路上獲得無限的樂趣！

fr.description:
Spider Solitaire combine les règles originales de l'un des jeux de cartes classiques les plus populaires avec un ensemble de fonctionnalités passionnantes. Profitez d'une expérience inédite tout en jouant à votre jeu de cartes de solitaire préféré. Mettez votre esprit au défi en jouant à Spider Solitaire, atteignez des étapes supérieures lors de chacune des victoires consécutives et battez votre meilleur score !

Points forts de Spider Solitaire :

- Jeu classique
Empilez les cartes d'une même couleur dans l'ordre décroissant (du roi à l'as) pour gagner la partie. Ajustez le niveau de difficulté en jouant avec 1, 2 ou 4 couleurs.

- Gardez votre esprit actif
Faites travailler vos méninges et entraînez-vous pour atteindre les étapes supérieures et gagner le max de points possible.

- Détendez-vous et relaxez-vous
Mettez un peu de couleurs à la grisaille du quotidien grâce à un passe-temps

kr.description:
가장 인기 있는 클래식 카드 게임 중 하나의 규칙을 흥미진진한 기능과 결합하여 스파이더 솔리테어를 제작했습니다. 좋아하는 스파이더 카드 게임에서 완전히 새로운 경험을 즐겨보세요. 스파이더 솔리테어를 플레이하며 정신력에 도전하고 연속으로 승리할 때마다 더 높은 단계에 도달하고 최고 점수를 경신하세요!

스파이더 솔리테어의 하이라이트:

- 클래식 게임 방식
게임을 플레이하려면 카드 더미를 내림차순(킹에서 에이스까지)으로 쌓으세요. 1장, 2장 또는 4장씩으로 플레이하며 난이도를 조정하세요.

- 정신은 활동적으로
두뇌를 단련하고 더 높은 단계까지 올라가, 할 수 있는 한 최고의 점수를 얻으세요.

- 긴장을 풀고 느긋하게
카드를 뒤집으며 틀에 박힌 매일의 일상을 느긋한 휴식으로 뒤집어보세요. 휴식 시간에나 하루의 업무를 마친 후에 어디에 계시더라도 모바일 장치로 카드 게임을 즐기세요.

스파이더 솔리테어 특징:

- 다양한 난이도
자신의 경험에 맞춰 1장, 2장 또는 4장의 카드 더미를 선택해 원하는 만큼 즐기세요.

* 背景に広がる美しい風景

- タイマーなし、プレッシャーなし
- 麻雀コンボポイント
- 星 ＆ 時間
- スコアなし
* ハイスコア ＆ 個人成績

► ゲームの目的は、ペアを探して、牌をそろえること。

無料で遊んで、息抜きしよう！

Play the free word guessing game based on the hit ITV gameshow - and guess as many words as you like, every single day.

The Word Game You Know From TV

유일무이한 픽처 빌더를 만나보세요. 픽처 빌더는 퍼즐 세계에서 새로운 단계를 열어주는 게임입니다. 어떤 플레이어도 무관심하지 않을 것입니다. 우리의 무료 게임을 빨리 다운로드하고 나만의 도시를 만들어보세요.

픽처 빌더는 픽셀 아트, 숫자에 따른 색칠, 퍼즐, 물건 찾기, 숨겨진 물건 등 논리적인 게임과 퍼즐을 좋아하는 모두에게 마음에 들 것입니다.

픽처 빌더에서는 다양한 도시 풍경을 찾을 수 있습니다. 처음에는 완전히 빈 상태입니다. 그리고 모든 이미지 요소를 직접 모아야 합니다. 각 물체나 캐릭터는 별개의 퍼즐입니다. 모든 퍼즐은 완전히 독특하기 때문에 픽처 빌더에서 게임하는 것은 항상 재미있고 흥미로운 경험입니다.

각 위치는 단계별로 여러분 앞에 열릴 것입니다. 모든 물건을 수집하면 도시가 흥미로운 상황과 캐릭터로 가득 찰 것입니다. 각 이미지의 올바른 조각을 찾는 것이 여러분의 임무입니다. 물체를 확대하고 힌트를 사용하세요.

픽처 빌더에서는 여러분이 조각조각으로 도시와 그 주민을 직접 만듭니다. 퍼즐을 수집하는 것이 이렇게 즐거웠던 적이 없습니다. 게임을 설치하고 무료로 무한한 퍼즐을 제공하는 여러 도시 위치를 얻으세요.

픽처 빌더에는 자동차, 교통 수단, 건물, 식물, 동물, 사람, 자연, 해변, 배, 도시 거리 등의 퍼즐이 있습니다.

픽처 빌더의 특징: 독특한 게임 메커니즘, 화려한 게임 디자인, 무료 게임, 다양한 퍼즐, 다양한 게임 위치, 주제: 식물, 사람, 동물, 교통 수단, 건물 등, 힌트.

픽처 빌더를 왜 플레이해야 하나요? 즐거운 시간을 보내기 위해서, 퍼즐을 수집하기 위해서, 물건을 찾기 위해서, 나만의 도시를 건설하기 위해서, 아름다운 픽셀 이미지를 즐기기 위해서입니다.

gb.description:
Welcome to Star Returns 
Five years ago, a sudden crash cost Hollywood star Aurora everything. Now, as she reopens her mother's bakery, a photo suggests her lost daughter may still be ALIVE. WHO LIED, AND WHY?
An obsessive ex. A scheming rival. Can you help Aurora to find the truth?
MERGE & SERVE 
Merge treats, serve customers, and make the bakery a local favorite—bringing her closer to the red carpet.
RENOVATE & DECORATE 
Transform the bakery and home. Choose your decor and make every corner your own!
FIND ROMANCE 
Old friends. New sparks. Could a fresh start bring true love?
DRESS TO SHINE 
Choose stunning outfits for Aurora's big moments, from opening day to her comeback!
UNCOVER THE TRUTH 
Merge and renovate to uncover clues. Everyone has secrets... so who's helping—and who's lying?
She lost everything. This time, she's TAKING IT BACK.

• Easy to learn, satisfying to master 
• Hundreds of handcrafted levels

• Unique solution for every puzzle 
• Smooth and intuitive controls 
• Play anytime, anywhere 
• No time limits, solve at your own pace

· 異なるモードのドロー1またはドロー3でプレイしよう。
・分からなくなったらヒントとやり直し機能（どちらも上限あり）を使いましょう。
・シンプルなタップまたはドラッグ操作で楽しみましょう。
・たくさんある背景とカードの柄から1つ選び、集中力を高めたり、リラックス効果を得ましょう。

休憩がてら、ソリティア・クロンダイクで頭を鍛えましょう！

手強いAI相手に挑むか、オンラインで世界中のClue/Cluedoファンに挑戦しよう。プライベートマルチプレイヤーモードで、友達や家族と懐かしいゲームナイトを開催することもできる。

犯人は誰？どの武器で？どこで？6人の容疑者、6つの武器、9つの部屋、そして唯一の答え…

CLUE/CLUEDO: CLASSIC EDITION の遊び方：
ゲーム開始時に3枚のカードが隠される — これらが事件の答え。
各プレイヤーは3枚の手掛かりカードを持つ。これらは答えには含まれないため、自動的に手掛かりシートから消す。
サイコロを振ってコマを盤上で動かす。
部屋に入ったら推理をする。誰がどの武器でどこで犯行を行ったと思うかを選ぶ。
順番に他のプレイヤーが持つカードと照合。推理に該当するカードを持っていれば教えてくれる。
見せられたカードを手掛かりシートから消し、容疑者を絞り込む。
準備ができたら告発しよう！間違っていればゲームから脱落。

特徴
クロスプラットフォームマルチプレイヤー — PC、モバイル、Nintendo Switchで友達や家族と遊べる。
オンラインリーダーボード — 週ごとのランキングで世界中のファンを出し抜こう。
複数モード — オンラインで最大6人のプレイヤーと対戦、またはシングルプレイヤーモードでカスタマイズ可能なAIと対戦。
プライベートロビー — フレンドと遊ぶモードで簡単にファミリーゲームナイトを設定可能。

犯人を捕まえろ！今すぐClue/Cluedo: Classic Editionをプレイしよう！

At the dawn of history, Bronze Age kings built the first empires. Strategize their rise to power in a uniquely streamlined 4X. - Each empire's trait and start location bring a unique set of challenges.

gb.description:
A charming tile-laying puzzle game. Make the best valley you can out of the tiles and placements you're given.

Puzzles with no randomness can become a bit boring over time. And when it is too random, it can feel unfair. Square Valley sits nicely in the middle where you are challenged for each level, but it still feels fair in the end. Satisfying. Every level is comprised of a fixed set of tiles that come together to form a challenge each step of the way. You're continually cycling through your deck of tiles – always a fresh look. You're also limited to only certain spots on the board where you can place the tiles all in order to reach the highest score you can.

A windmill wants the surrounding wheat fields, forests have winding rivers through them, and churches stand firm within the city walls packed with houses.

Not to worry, you won't get stuck. There's generous room to succeed at e

gb.description:
Card-Driven Game of the Most Notorious of Political Scandals. Will Nixon triumph in his tug of war with the Press or will the truth be exposed?

Nominated for Best Board Game App in the BoardGameGeek Golden Geek Awards!

In Watergate, one player assumes the role of a Washington Post Journalist, while the other embodies the Nixon Administration—each with a unique set of cards. To win, the Nixon Administration must build up enough momentum to make it to the end of the presidential term, whereas the Journalist must gather enough evidence to connect two informants directly to the President. Of course, the administration will do all in its power to smother any evidence.

Watergate: The Board Game is a faithful adaptation of the original board game.

Languages: English, German, Dutch
Play modes: Pass & Play, Cross-platform asynchronous multiplayer, Solo
Includes detailed background story

gb.description:
Tsar Ivan the Terrible has ordered the construction of a cathedral in honor of his military victories. Many teams of builders will take part in the construction, but only one of them will stand out and gain the favor of the Tsar!

The Red Cathedral: Digital Edition is a faithful adaptation of the acclaimed board game. It is a game of strategy and resource management, where you take on the role of a team of architects charged with building the cathedral. You will compete to build different parts of the monument that you will previously claim. You will search for and manage materials that you will later use to build and decorate. You must take into account the influence of the clergy and the different guilds of the city to stand out from the rest and win the favor of the Tsar. Upon completion of the cathedral, the player who has gained the most prestige will be the winner!

- Build alone,

gb.description:
Biblios Dice is a digital adaptation of the dice game by Dr. Finn. In it you are working as medieval monks to produce illustrations and improve the prestige of your abbey.

In Biblios Dice players compete by rolling dice and making tactical decisions on which of several resource tracks to pursue. Each of the five different resource tracks change value based on player decisions, altering the total value they are worth. This means players will want to both improve on the different tracks while simultaneously increasing the value of the tracks they're pursuing and devaluing those of others. When the time comes for the mule to make it to market, which happens every few rounds, dice are auctioned off to the highest bidders providing a rich set of resources so long as money isn't over-spent. Favor with the Bishop, its own track, will also significantly affect total prestige based on how much m

Choose the most lucrative parcels of land and buildings. You then have to place these parcels and buildings wisely so as to make your city as prosperous as possible. You can also win the support and gain the help of the most influential people in the city. However, you should not ignore your opponents, as they will try to make the best moves in your stead!

Play against three virtual players that will take the best parcels and recruit the most influential people in order to prevent from you achieving your goal. The virtual players have three levels of difficulty.

Chess on Apple Watch you cannot mis-tap.

ScrollChess is a chess app for Apple Watch and iPhone. Play an engine at four levels, solve a daily puzzle in about twenty seconds, or play a friend on one iPhone. Everything works offline, with no account, for a single purchase with no subscription.

A chess square on a watch is about half the size Apple's own guidelines set as the minimum for anything you tap. So ScrollChess does not ask you to tap one. The Digital Crown moves a crosshair from one legal option to the next, and a tap — anywhere on the screen — confirms it. Nothing on the board is a touch target, so there is nothing to miss.

tw.description:
世界征服者1945 是以二戰為背景的新型策略遊戲(Super Risk)。在遊戲中依靠軍事單位爭奪陸地,城市,海洋等地區,爭奪資源,發展經濟和軍事,攻占對方的首都並且消滅對手。
在遊戲中必須合理的操作和分配士兵,坦克,大砲這三個最基本軍事單位進行遊戲。 (士兵產量高攻擊力一般,坦克攻擊力高且完胜對手後可以繼續行動,大砲攻擊士兵和坦克時候對方不能還擊), 請隨時對當前形式作出正確的判斷,因為AI很出色。每個國家的兵種的屬性都是有差異的。比如德國的坦克最強但是價格也比較高,蘇聯的火砲最優秀,英國的海軍最好...
部隊單位會在每一次戰鬥後增加戰鬥經驗,在獲得更多的戰鬥經驗後該部隊就會獲得勳章,獲得勳章的部隊的戰鬥力將高於一般的部隊,成為王牌部隊。
您將經歷從一個普通列兵到五星上將的過程。

在遊戲中需要配合軍事卡來輔助進行遊戲指令。
- 士兵卡(生產士兵單位)
- 坦克卡(生產坦克單位)
- 大砲卡(生產生大砲單位)
- 軍艦卡(配備軍艦可以在海面行動)
- 堡壘卡(3回合不能移動和攻擊,但是增加防禦)
- 建設卡(建設地塊,增加稅收,建設到最高級的時候該地塊可以徵兵)
- 空襲卡(空襲相鄰範圍內的敵軍)
- 將軍卡(給軍團配備一個將軍用來增加攻擊力)
- 元帥卡(給軍團配備一個元帥用來增加防禦力)
- 特殊卡(只有美國,德國,蘇聯,日本,英國,法國,意大利擁有並且7個回合使用一次)

遊戲分為2個模式:
征服模式
在11個能改變世界命運的軸心國和同盟國之間選擇一個來稱霸世界。各種其他勢力將會是你的盟友和敵人還有中立者。有3個時期可以選,1940二戰開始,1942二戰中期,1944二戰後期。

戰役模式
一共有10個改變世界命運的偉大戰役等待您的挑戰!

1942 太平洋戰爭
1943 中印緬戰場
1942 庫爾斯克戰役
1944 諾曼底戰役
1941 北非戰役
1942 科科達戰役
1945 第三帝國的命運
1945 八月風暴
1942 爭霸印度洋
1940 海上之路

雄壯的戰鬥音樂和音效可以讓你很有融入感。

遊戲特色:
- 戰役模式和爭霸模式
- 243個地塊

Play the classic game of O & X on your Apple Watch, iPhone or iPad!

- Play against your friends locally on the same watch, or online using your phone.

- Challenge one of the many computer players to see how good you really are.

- Unlock a multitude of different pieces to show off your skill to your opponents.
 
- Compare your abilities with friends through Game Center leaderboards and achievements.

- Track your games through the stats section, which syncs between phone and watch.

This app will constantly be updated and improved. If you have any feedback or suggestions on what you would like to see, please contact us at: NicholasDeanApps@gmail.com

Mahjong solitaire is a solitaire matching game that uses a set of Mahjong tiles rather than cards. The computer game was originally created by Brodie Lockard in 1981 and named Mah-Jongg after the game that uses the same tiles for play. Lockard claims that it was based on a centuries-old Chinese game called "the Turtle". However, it was not until Activision released Shanghai in 1986 for the Macintosh and Apple IIgs that the game gathered momentum. A version of this game was also included in the Microsoft Entertainment Pack for Windows 3.x in 1990 and went by the name Taipei. It was subsequently included in the Best of Windows Entertainment Pack. Premium editions of the Windows Vista operating system and Windows 7 include a version of the game known as Mahjong Titans.

차분하고 정성껏 손으로 만든 마작 솔리테어 게임으로, 마음의 휴식을 도와줍니다.

하루의 끝, 당신만의 조용한 순간.
따뜻한 레트로 픽셀 아트 스타일로 아름답게 디자인된 보드, 그리고 그것을 풀어가는 단순한 즐거움.

포함된 콘텐츠
 • 항상 풀 수 있도록 손수 제작된 보드 99개. 짧은 한 판부터 깊이 있는 도전까지.
 • 5가지 타일 세트 중에서 선택하고, 플레이 중 실시간으로 전환하세요. 더 많은 세트가 추가될 예정입니다.
 • 무제한 힌트와 되돌리기로 막힐 일이 없습니다.
 • 작곡가 Bjørn Lynne의 오리지널 음악 1시간 이상 수록.
 • iPhone, iPad, Mac에서 15개 언어로 즐기세요.
 • 이제 MFi 게임 컨트롤러로도 플레이할 수 있습니다!
 • 한 번 구매하면 향후 모든 업데이트가 포함됩니다.

광고 없음.
추적 없음.
인앱 구매 없음.
인터넷 연결 불필요.

이 게임을 만든 이유
이 게임은 1980년대에 저에게 마작을 알려주신 아버지께 바치는 헌사입니다.
아버지는 제 아들 Leon이 태어나기 전에 돌아가셔서, 두 사람은 한 번도 만나지 못했습니다. Leon은 게임에서 가장 어린 (그리고 가장 목소리가 큰) 이해관계자로서 이 게임을 함께 빚어냈습니다.
작게나마, 이 게임은 두 사람을 잇는 다리가 되었습니다.

세 세대. 게임을 향한 하나의 사랑.
Lucas와 Leon

Two crews. Two hidden sectors. Break theirs before they break yours.

Black ICE is a duel of hidden information and sharp deduction. Hide five ICE nodes in your sector, then spend your cycles probing your rival's until every one of theirs is broken.

HEAD TO HEAD, NEAR OR FAR
Play a friend on their own iPhone or iPad. NEARBY finds someone in the same room. INVITE sends a friend an invitation through Game Center, wherever they are. Your sector never leaves your phone, so neither of you sees the other's ICE until it breaks. If the link drops, one tap invites your rival back and the match carries on where it stopped. When the match ends, both deployments are revealed, and each phone checks every answer it was given.

MADE FOR THE FOLD

Twenty Squares, or the Royal Game of Ur, a strategy/race board game. dating from at least 2600BCE. The oldest game boards were found in the tombs of Ur in Iraq in the 1920s. While the ancient rules are still fuzzy, two players race around the board to see who can bring all their stones home before the other, with some surprises along the way.

- No ads and no in-app purchases!
- 1 or 2 players

This version currently implements the simple route and rules of the game, perfect for kids and beginners to the game. 

Some reviewers have suggested that the dice rolls are rigged when playing the AI. The dice rolls are not fudged in any way! Part of the allure of Twenty Squares is that you can't predict the winner until the very end of the game, as one bad roll can change the outcome completely.

Feedback/reviews are welcome to help future development. Some things on the go:
- GameCenter support

tw.description:
一座殘破的海島天堂，一位失蹤的外婆，還有30天時間拯救一切！

前夫偷偷揮霍光了兩人的積蓄，佐伊帶著女兒蜜雅連夜出逃，奔向她唯一確信安全的地方——外婆阿嘉莎的熱帶海島度假村Dream Bay。可天堂並沒有在等她：一場猛烈的風暴撕裂了度假村，阿嘉莎下落不明，島上傳說中的黃金神像也從神龕中消失了。
事情還在變糟。當地政府只給佐伊30天時間重建Dream Bay，否則就將永遠失去它；而冷酷的對手薇薇安早已虎視眈眈，趁著合約墨跡未乾就搶走了客人。站在佐伊的立場，合成物品重建度假村，追查阿嘉莎的真相，揪出幕後黑手——不管是人，還是別的什麼。

合成之路，通往天堂 Dream Bay 的每一粒沙、每一顆椰子都能由你組合。調配鮮果製作清晨冰沙，沖泡海島咖啡，做出清涼剉冰，再為沙灘小屋備上客人真正想要的物品。每一次合成都能賺到度假村急需的資金。
重建、翻修、煥然重生 把颶風留下的殘骸變成奢華。修復水上別墅，種下繁茂的熱帶花園，讓海灘提基酒吧重現生機。你的每個選擇，都會讓Dream Bay從風暴蹂躪的廢墟蛻變為群島的明珠。

愛情、謊言與倒數計時 與勇敢無畏的小偵探蜜雅聯手，追查阿嘉莎失蹤的線索。一路上，你的心也變得糾結：是無論風暴損毀多嚴重都不肯退房的富有房客席歐，還是追捕神像竊賊的當地護林員凱？還有，你的前夫羅恩為什麼就是陰魂不散？

核心玩法：合成重建：組合、製作數百種熱帶物品，修復度假村的每個角落。與時間賽跑：在30天期限內完成劇情任務，並智勝對手度假村老闆薇薇安。揭開謎團：暢玩充滿背叛、祕密與海島傳說的劇情章節。
墜入愛河（或者不）：在兩位截然不同的心動對象之間做出選擇，一切由你決定。精彩活動不斷：參與每週小遊戲、限時特惠、季節慶典，贏取專屬獎勵。隨心而玩：忙裡偷閒玩幾局，或沉浸劇情暢玩到底，Dream Bay都能融入你的生活。
時間在流逝，海島在等待，佐伊需要你的幫助。立即下載Dream Bay，今天就開始合成吧！

kr.description:
폐허가 된 섬의 낙원, 사라진 할머니, 그리고 모든 것을 되살릴 30일!

전남편이 몰래 저축을 탕진하자, 조이는 딸 미아를 데리고 유일하게 안전하다고 믿는 곳으로 달려갑니다. 바로 할머니 아가사가 운영하는 열대 섬 리조트, Dream Bay죠. 하지만 낙원은 그녀를 기다려 주지 않았습니다. 거센 폭풍이 리조트를 갈기갈기 찢어 놓았고, 아가사는 흔적도 없이 사라졌으며, 섬의 전설 속 황금 우상마저 사당에서 자취를 감췄습니다.
상황은 더 나빠집니다. 지역 당국은 조이에게 Dream Bay를 복구할 시간으로 30일을 줍니다. 해내지 못하면 영영 잃게 되죠. 게다가 냉혹한 라이벌 비비안은 벌써 주변을 맴돌며 계약서의 잉크가 마르기도 전에 손님을 빼앗고 있습니다. 조이의 쪼리를 신고 결합하여 리조트를 재건하고, 아가사의 진실을 쫓고, 이 모든 일의 배후가 누구인지(혹은 무엇인지) 밝혀내세요.

결합하여 낙원을 만드세요 Dream Bay의 모래알 하나, 코코넛 하나까지 모두 직접 조합할 수 있습니다. 과일을 갈아 아침 스무디를 만들고, 섬 커피를 내리고, 빙수를 만들고, 손님이 진짜 원하는 물건으로 해변 오두막을 채우세요. 결합할 때마다 리조트가 간절히 필요로 하는 돈이 모입니다.
재건하고, 단장하고, 다시 꿈꾸세요 허리케인의 잔해를 럭셔리한 공간으로 바꿔 보세요. 수상 방갈로를 복원하고, 푸르른 열대 정원을 가꾸고, 해변의 티키 바를 되살리세요. 당신의 선택 하나하나가 폭풍에 부서진 폐허였던 Dream Bay를 섬의 보석으로 바꿔 놓습니다.

사랑과 거짓말, 그리고 째깍거리는 시계. 겁 없는 꼬마 탐정 미아와 함께 아가사 실종의 단서를 추적하세요. 그러다 보면 마음도 복잡해집니다. 폭풍 피해가 아무리 심해도 체크아웃하지 않는 부유한 손님 테오일까요, 아니면 우상 도둑을 쫓는 현지 레인저 카이

hk.description:
Landlord Tycoon 是一款獨特的房地產投資遊戲，你可以在全球範圍內購買、出售和交易基於真實地點的虛擬房地產。建立你的商業帝國，收取租金，並在這款刺激的經濟模擬遊戲中與全球玩家競爭。

購買、升級並賺取被動收入
在你的周圍購買房地產，升級它們，當其他玩家簽到時獲得收益。從少量虛擬資金開始，進行明智的投資來增加財富。你的目標是掌控市場，成為最強大的房地產大亨。

每個真實地點都是商機
投資於著名地標、當地企業或人流密集的區域，以最大化收益。透過升級提高房地產價值，增加收入。在你的城市或全球範圍內與其他玩家競爭，擴展你的業務版圖。

擁有世界上最具代表性的地點
在 Landlord Tycoon 中，你可以擁有並交易世界上最知名的地點。想像一下，擁有法國的艾菲爾鐵塔、美國的自由女神像或義大利的羅馬競技場，每當有人簽到時，你都能收取租金。擴展你的投資組合，進駐紐約、東京、倫敦或杜拜等國際都市，並投資著名摩天大樓，如哈里發塔、帝國大廈或倫敦碎片塔。

不僅限於城市，你甚至可以擁有自然奇觀，如美國大峽谷、聖母峰或澳洲大堡礁，打造獨一無二的房地產帝國。

思考更宏大：擁有國家、大陸和海洋
準備好進一步擴張了嗎？購買並管理整個國家，投資於大陸，甚至擁有像太平洋、大西洋或北極海這樣的廣闊海域。無論是建立全球房地產網絡，還是擁有壯麗的自然景觀，你的發展潛力無限。

Landlord Tycoon 特色
- 真實世界房地產投資
- 被動收入，透過聰明投資獲利
- 競技模式與全球排行榜
- 策略性經營與市場分析
- GPS 技術支援的交易系統
- 財務管理與資產配置

遊戲玩法
1. 從虛擬資金開始
2. 購買房地產並收取租金
3. 升級與擴展投資
4. 聰明交易，最大化資產價值
5. 利用市場數據與分析做出最佳決策

越活躍，你的房地產帝國就會越大。

獨特的商業策略體驗
Landlord Tycoon 將真實地理數據、財務模擬與競爭策略相結合。與傳統經營遊戲不同，它讓你與真實世界的地點互動。如果你喜歡大富翁類型的房地產遊戲、經營模擬或投資挑戰，這款遊戲將會非常適合你。

與朋友

あなたを待っているもの

tw.description:
Block Jam 3D – 輕鬆愉快的三消益智冒險

Block Jam 3D 是一款免費的三消益智遊戲，融合了巧妙機制、輕鬆混亂與可愛角色，為經典玩法注入全新樂趣。無論是短暫遊戲時間，還是深入挑戰，每一局都帶來新鮮體驗。而且，離線也能暢玩！

玩法特色

• 創新三消玩法 – 舒適溫馨的圖塊配對，加入策略思考
• 托盤式操作 – 收集並整理方塊，避免托盤塞滿
• 獨特機關 – 膠水、管道、木桶等各種趣味元素，讓每局都充滿驚喜
• 強力道具 – 撤銷、橫移、洗牌、磁鐵，靈活應對挑戰
• 離線模式 – 無需網路，隨時隨地都能玩

豐富內容等你探索

• 競技聯賽 – 參加每週排行榜，晉升技巧等級
• 賽季通行證 – 每月主題更新，解鎖專屬造型與獎勵
• 趣味世界 – 持續過關，打造繽紛主題立體小場景
• 挑戰任務 – 連續挑戰不間斷，永遠有新目標
• 角色收藏 – 收集主題卡片，深入了解 Block Jam 的奇妙角色

精彩活動持續更新

每天都有新活動登場！限時活動輪番上線，讓遊戲保持樂趣與新鮮感：

• 寶石探險 – 一鎬一鎬深入古墓，尋找閃亮寶石與寶藏
• 甜點夥伴 – 與其他玩家合作烘焙點心，共享豐厚獎勵
• 炸彈橋對決 – 即時對戰拼手速，炸彈會朝落後的玩家走來，小心應戰！
• ……更多精彩活動持續推出中！

踏上你的益智旅程

立即下載 Block Jam 3D，探索一個充滿配對策略、拼圖挑戰與每日驚喜的繽紛世界！

gb.description:
6 takes! - Wolfgang Kramer's ingeniously simple card game with "bullheads" - now as an app.

The aim of the game is to avoid getting cards. Each card you have to pick up costs you points for each bullhead on it. The player with the fewest bullheads at the end of the game is the winner. It sounds easier than it is, players will need some great tactics and perhaps a little luck.

6 takes! is regarded as a modern classic among card games and has been sold all over the world.
It has won the German "Games Prize" and has also been nominated "Game of the year". 

Licensed by AMIGO Spiel + Freizeit GmbH

Features:
- 6 takes! Singleplayer mode against up to four computer opponents.
- Three levels of difficulty
- Multiplayer mode for up to four players around the same device
- Quick game or first to 66 minus points

de.description:
6 nimmt! - Wolfgang Kramers genial einfaches Kartenspiel „mit den Hornochsen“ nun auch als App!

Bei 6 nimmt! ist der Name Programm. Es ist ein raffiniertes Kartenspiel, das den Spieler nicht mehr loslässt. Ziel des Spiels ist, möglichst wenige Karten aufzunehmen. Klingt einfacher als es ist. Bei 6 nimmt! zählt ein wenig Kartenglück, aber ganz entscheidend ist die Taktik.

6 nimmt! gilt mittlerweile als moderner Kartenspielklassiker und wurde bereits in über 20 Sprachen übersetzt sowie in mehr als 50 Länder geliefert.

6 nimmt! wurde in den vergangenen 20 Jahren allein in Deutschland über 2 Millionen Mal verkauft und mit zahlreichen Preisen ausgezeichnet. Bereits im ersten Jahr erhielt das Spiel den Deutschen Spielepreis und wurde zum Spiel des Jahres nominiert. Die Zeitschrift Fairplay ernannte 6 nimmt! zum ,Kartenspiel des Jahres'.

Le but du jeu est de ne pas ramasser de cartes. Chaque carte ramassée avec des têtes de bœuf fait perdre des points. Celui qui a le moins de points à la fin du jeu gagne. A première vue, le jeu peut paraître simple. Il n’en est rien ! La stratégie y joue un rôle primordial !

6 qui prend ! est la version modernisée de ce classique des jeux de cartes. L’application sera traduite en 20 langues et vendue dans plus de 50 pays.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
ーカードを制す者が世界を制すー
ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

【概要】
武器や魔法が具現化する不思議なカードを集めてデッキをつくり、モンスターと戦うカードバトル型RPG。
カードを吟味し、知性とアイデアで組み上げた自分だけの勝利の方程式で世界を救え!

【ストーリー】
武器も魔法もアイテムも、すべてが「カード」から繰り出される不思議な大陸があった。
万物を紡ぐ「カード」の扱いに長けた者は畏敬の念を込めて「カード使い」と呼ばれており、
大陸の5つの国の王たちはそんな「カード使い」を重用することで互いの均衡を守っていたという。
しかしあるとき、突如としてモンスターが街やひとを襲い始めたという報せが諸国を駆けめぐる・・・

ちょうどその頃、冒険者を数多く輩出する国として知られるファースタから旅立つ少年が1人。
一人前の「カード使い」を目指しモンスターに戦いを挑み続ける中で
次第に明らかになる世界の秘密とは果たして!?


【ビジュアル&サウンド】
・ドット絵がなつかしいレトロな雰囲気のビジュアル。
・ギルドの娘にカード

gb.description:
"Simple but deep! A deck-building roguelike card game!"
"Defeat the abyssal boss in a medieval fantasy world!"
"Choose a class, collect cards, and build the ultimate deck!"

Game Features
- Deck-building × Roguelike – Experience fresh gameplay every time by utilizing different cards!
- High score system – Break your own records and challenge your limits!
- Endless roguelike elements – A new adventure awaits with every playthrough!
- Various classes to choose from – Fight in a style that suits you best!
- Single-player game – Play at your own pace and take your time!

jp.description:
「シンプルだけど奥深い！デッキ構築型ローグライクカードゲーム！」
「中世ファンタジーの世界で深淵のボスを討伐せよ！」
「職業を選び、カードを集めて最強のデッキを作ろう！」

ゲームの特徴
・デッキ構築 × ローグライク – 毎回異なるカードを駆使して戦う新鮮なプレイ体験！
・ハイスコア機能搭載 – 自己ベストを更新し、自分の限界に挑戦しよう！
・無限に遊べるローグライク要素 – プレイするたびに新たな展開が待っている！
・多彩な職業が選択可能 – 自分に合ったスタイルで戦おう！
・シングルプレイ専用 – 自分のペースでじっくり楽しめる！

tw.description:
### **「簡單但深奧！牌組構築類 Rogue-like 卡牌遊戲！」**  

**「在中世奇幻世界中擊敗深淵首領！」**  
**「選擇職業、收集卡牌，打造最強牌組！」**  

### **遊戲特色**  
**牌組構築 × Rogue-like – 每次遊玩都能利用不同的卡牌，體驗全新的戰鬥！**  
**高分系統 – 刷新最高分，挑戰自己的極限！**  
**無限可玩性 Rogue-like 要素 – 每次遊玩都會帶來全新的發展！**  
**多種可選職業 – 選擇適合自己的戰鬥風格！**  
**單人遊戲 – 依照自己的節奏慢慢享受遊戲！**

kr.description:
단순하지만 깊이 있다! 덱 빌딩 로그라이크 카드 게임!

중세 판타지 세계에서 심연의 보스를 처치하라!
직업을 선택하고 카드를 모아 최강의 덱을 구성하라!

게임 특징
-덱 빌딩 × 로그라이크 - 매번 다른 카드를 활용해 싸우는 신선한 플레이 경험!
- 하이스코어 기능 탑재 - 최고 점수를 갱신하며 자신의 한계에 도전하세요!
-무한히 즐길 수 있는 로그라이크 요소 - 플레이할 때마다 새로운 전개가 기다린다!
-다양한 직업 선택 가능 - 자신에게 맞는 스타일로 전투를 즐기세요!
-1인용 게임 - 자신의 속도에 맞춰 천천히 플레이 가능!

tw.description:
“王權：權力遊戲”是熱門劃卡遊戲“王權”融合了HBO®獲獎劇集《權力遊戲®》劇情改編的遊戲，由Nerial工作室及Devolver Digital傾情呈現。通過火之女祭司梅麗珊卓的視角，玩家可扮演瑟曦·蘭尼斯特、瓊恩·雪諾、丹妮莉絲·坦格利安以及其他著名角色，坐上鐵王座並精心斡旋於七王國之間錯綜複雜、勾心鬥角的關係當中。對狡猾的政治對手，要採取冬天般無情的策略予以打壓；對麾下搖擺不定的封臣，則要傳遞擲地有聲的命令展示手腕。玩家要贏得民意、維持平衡，盡力延長統治。或許只有這樣，在即將到來的凜冽寒冬之中，方可有一線生機。

冰火天團：雄踞鐵王座上的，可以是瑟曦·蘭尼斯特，亦可是瓊恩·斯諾、丹妮莉絲·坦格利安、提利昂·蘭尼斯特、珊莎·斯塔克以及其他知名人物。解鎖各位國王和王后便可在他們之間自由切換，體驗角色獨有的故事、挑戰和神秘事件。

貫徹旨意：面對著維斯特洛人民熱情激昂的請願和變幻莫測的需求，七王國的命運走向就取決於玩家輕鬆滑動的卡牌之後。假如某個角色讓你太過煩心，那就撕了他的卡片，讓他不再影響你的王權——但代價又如何呢？

重新勾畫維斯特洛大陸：玩家通過梅麗珊卓的視角觀察這片大陸，劇情發展遠超電視劇集的內容，可以盡情設想各人坐上鐵王座後可能的命運。作為瑟曦·蘭尼斯特，你甚至可以重建貝勒大聖堂；假如珊莎·斯塔克與詹姆·蘭尼斯特成婚，七王國的未來又會如何呢？

皇室小遊戲：即使是最威嚴的統治者，偶爾也得拋卻重大事項，參加一些瑣碎的活動。從長槍比武到酒館鬥毆，這些小小分歧的代價有時會是驚人的！

格局更大的王朝：王權前作系列遊戲的粉絲看到本作定會欣喜若狂——本作內容宏大、極具深度，不僅重現了你已知的故事，更允許你發揮想像創造新的冒險。

風格獨特的配樂：伴隨著Ramin Djawadi為HBO獨創的恢宏樂譜，玩家可在維斯特洛大陸上恣意譜寫整片大陸及其居民的命運。

©2018 Home Box Office, Inc. 版權所有。HBO以及其他相關註冊商標版權均歸Home Box Office, Inc.所有。

kr.description:
"Reigns: 왕좌의 게임"은 빛나는 수상 경력의 HBO® TV 드라마 Game of Thrones®을 계승한 게임이자 Neria에서 개발하고 Devolver Digital에서 배급한 유명 스와이프 게임 시리즈인 Reigns의 후속작입니다. 멜리산드레의 불 같은 시야를 통해, 세르세이 라니스터, 존 스노우, 대너리스 타르가르옌으로서 철왕좌를 주장하십시오. 칠왕국의 적대적인 세력과 복잡한 관계를 조심스럽게 알아나가세요. 정치적 경쟁자들을 앞지르기 위하여 무자비한 전술을 사용하고 당신의 변덕스러운 기수에게 불굴의 매력을 휘두르세요. 당신의 통치를 이어갈 수 있도록 백성들에게 균형과 호의를 유지하십시오. 그리고, 언젠가 다가올, 겨울의 공포에서 살아남으십시오.

강력한 인물들: 세르세이 라니스터, 존 스노우, 대너리스 타르가르옌, 티리온 라니스터, 산사 스타크 등의 인물들의 입장에서 철왕좌에 앉아 통치권을 휘둘러 보십시오. 서서히 해금되는 왕과 여왕의 역할을 번갈아 플레이하면서, 각자의 스토리에서 독특하게 발생하는 난관과 수수께끼들에 맞서 보십시오.

자신의 의지를 관철해 보십시오: 웨스테로스의 백성들로부터 간절한 부탁이나 예상치 못한 부탁을 들었을 때, 한순간의 좌우 넘김만으로 칠왕국의 운명을 영원토록 바꿔버릴 수 있습니다. 특정한 인물이 골칫거리로 다가온다면, 이들이 자신의 왕권에 방해가 되지 않도록 카드를 반으로 찢어버릴 수도 있습니다. 하지만 어떤 대가를 치르게 될지는 알 수 없습니다…

웨스테로스를 다시 그려보십시오: 멜리산드레가 본 시야는 여러분이 게임을 플레이할 배경이 되어줍니다. 철왕좌에 앉을 수 있었던 자들이 TV 시리즈의 스토리와는 다른 길을 택했더라면 어떤 운명을 맞게 되었을지 한번 상상해 보십시오. 직접 세르세이가 되어 바엘로르의 대셉트를 재건하거나, 산사 스타크가

gb.description:
If you're looking for the card game Oh Hell! then this is the app for you! 

It's got a powerful AI so you'll never have an easy game (I write AIs for a living!) and a huge range of customisable rule options to suit however you've traditionally played the game yourself. The AI players even have emotions and get happy and sad when they think they're going to make their bid or not. You can also play against your friends on their own devices over local WiFi or Bluetooth. 

For newcomers to the game, Niggle (also known as "Oh Hell") is an easy to learn card game in which you must try to guess how many tricks you are going to win each round. The fun comes from trying to get exactly the number of wins you guessed while stopping your opponents from achieving their target.

For the latest news on all of my games follow @SeansGames on Twitter!

Omar Sharif Bridge supports the following 3 modes of play:

In Rubber Bridge a rubber is played as the best of three games. A game is won by the first partnership to score 100 or more points in successful contracts.

In Chicago Bridge, also known as Four-Hand Bridge, you play exactly four hands of Bridge. The winner is the partnership that scores the most points.

A standard 52 card deck is used. The cards in each suit rank (from high to low) A K Q J 10 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2. 
13 cards are dealt to each player.

A player leads the first card. Each player must follow the suit led, if he can. If not, he should play the trump, or any suit if he has no trump. The player who has played the card with the highest value ( the trump card or the card of the suit led, if no trump was played) wins the trick. That player then leads to the next trick. Continue until all tricks have been played and won.

gb.description:
Don’t just memorize the odds, *understand* them ... This app teaches you a general method for estimating the odds for just about any Texas Hold’em scenario in your head in real time.

*** Pay once and enjoy forever ***
No in-app purchases/fees.
Continual improvement for many years.

***
Note:

(1)
This is a challenging app. You need to be pretty good at doing basic math operations in your head. For example, what’s the value of:

16% * 20%

We’ve added a “Math” help button to show you how to calculate this in your head. One way is, 20% means one-fifth. One-fifth of 16% is (16% / 5), which is a little more than 3%. 3.2% to be exact. Or, convert to decimals, multiply, then convert back to %age’s.

(2)
This app uses specific hand situations, and some people don’t see the value in this because in real life play we don’t know our opponents’ cards. There’s still value in specific hand situation

던전에 수많은 함정과 시설을 배치하고, 전투를 통해 성장하는 몬스터를 고용하고, 신비한 힘을 지닌 유물을 발견하고, 던전을 노리는 용사들을 무찔러보세요!

◆ 컨텐츠
- 특수한 능력으로 던전을 지휘하는 9 명의 마왕!
- 300여종의 용사와 몬스터들
- 던전에 배치할 수 있는 100여개의 함정과 시설들
- 200여가지의 신비한 유물들
- 여러가지 이벤트
- 각종 해금 요소

◆ 당신만의 던전을 만들어보세요.
함정과 시설, 몬스터들을 고민해서 배치하세요. 용사를 처치하고 획득하는 보상으로 더 강력한 던전을 꾸밀 수 있습니다. 어떤 시설과 어떤 몬스터가 잘 어울릴지 고민하면서 최고의 효율을 지닌 던전을 만들어보세요.

◆ 운명을 탐험하세요.

gb.description:
7 Card Blackjack - The Original British Card Game
The classic British card game is back and it's better than ever.
7 Card Blackjack, the game you know and love! Played around tables for decades. Now it's online, free, and in your pocket.

Play your way
Set your house rules before every game. Queens a Sl*g, Jacks on 2s, Bring Backs, Jokers — toggle the rules you play with. Every game, exactly how you remember it.

Online multiplayer
Create a game, share the code, play with friends anywhere. Real-time, no waiting around.

Single player
Practice against Easy, Medium or Hard AI

Daily Spin
Spin the wheel every day for free coins. Climb from London to Las Vegas.

Free to play. No nonsense.

Traditional Mahjong game in which you play against 3 other players - sole against all computer players, or play with one to three other friends or network players via Game Center.  Seats  not filled by friends or network players are played by the computer.  You may exchange group text messages and voice chats while in the multiplayer game.

Each player is dealt 13 tiles in a hand. The players take turns to draw a tile and discard one. The goal is to make 4 sets and 1 pair.  Declare a win by tapping on a received tile or tapping/dragging on discarded tile that completes the hand of 14 tiles.  The default mode will auto prompt you when a set or a winning hand can be formed with a tile drawn or discarded.   Hands formed must be of some minimum  point value (0-3) in order to win the round. A zero base point would allow chicken hand. The default is 0 base point, but can be customized.

hk.description:
通過遊戲中心在互聯網上與朋友和其他玩家打麻將: 任選由兩個到四個人, 然後其餘席位由電腦打; 你也可選擇單人對電腦。程序帶給你真的麻將體驗, 好比可以用手抓牌, 出牌, 推牌來報吃,碰,槓,糊。亦能自動提示吃碰槓糊讓你確認。你也可以隨意排列手牌和移動已被打出的牌。你還可以在手牌上方橫刷來自動排列手牌。

程序提供各種的難度選擇, 例如速度起,糊番數和是否打花牌,打季牌。可選擇整齊排列棄牌,否則牌將被隨意旋轉放置。點擊齒輪圖示看遊戲規則,或更改遊戲難度及背景。本遊戲允許0底番雞糊,可更改0-3分起糊。未達底番不能胡, 如果別人要碰自然優先。反之達底番當能胡。如多人能胡則按要座次決定誰胡牌。

能設置背景和牌的顏色及背景圖像,亦可更改對手的名字。在牌局中可點擊玩家名字來顯示在手的金額。你在遊戲的名字取自遊戲中心,並可在遊戲中心設定。如果您沒有登入到遊戲中心, 名字取自下列: iCloud使用的名字, 電子郵件使用的名字, iPad/ iPhone / iTouch的名稱。

支持多多工作業。切換離時會暫停遊戲, 返回後會自動恢復。如果程序被終止, 仍可用繼續舊局按鈕繼續先前的遊戲。

gb.description:
Race for the Galaxy is a strategy boardgame where players advance their empire by playing cards to build technological developments or to settle planets. Its core mechanic is a phase choosing game. Players secretly and simultaneously determine which one of seven phases they will lock in, all reveal at once, then execute the phases in order. Will you build an engine to ramp up VP generation on cheapo production planets? Will you invest in exploration and settle rare and valuable VP rich planets? Or will you rush a military conquest to cut off your opponents before they have a chance to develop their strategy?

Game Features

▪ 2 – 4 player with network multiplayer
▪ Single player mode with advanced neural network AI
▪ Five starting worlds and ninety settlement and development cards
▪ Free promo pack included: New Worlds with six additional starting planets
▪ Gathering Storm and Rebel Vs.

jp.description:
Make Me Hotは、前戯に遊び心をプラスする、カップル向けのエロティックなカードゲームです。カードを引いて運に任せれば、いつもの夜が忘れられない特別な夜に変わります。

見た目は普通の52枚のトランプ。どのカードにも、感覚を刺激する、ワクワクするアクティビティや、ときにはもっと大胆なアクティビティが隠されています。制限時間内に、交代でパートナーを官能的に楽しませましょう。次にどんなカードが出るかわからないのが、このゲームのいちばんの魅力です。

遊び方
• 自分の番になったらカードを引いて、アクティビティを確認します。
• もう一方のプレイヤーが、カードに指定されたアクティビティを行います。
• アクティビティの制限時間は、カードのマークで決まります。

ダイヤのルール
ダイヤのカードにはルールがあります。誰がパートナーを気持ちよくさせるのか、最後まで予測できません。
ダイヤを引いた場合は、カードを引いたプレイヤー自身がアクティビティを行います。

クライマックス
ハートのAかダイヤのAが出たら、ゲームは終了です。最後のアクティビティでは、パートナーが望む方法で相手を絶頂へ導きましょう。制限時間はありません。
最後まで待ちきれない？「最後の選択」を選べば、2枚のカードから選ぶことができます。まだ終わりたくない？「エンドレスモード」をオンにすれば、好きなだけゲームを続けられます。

デッキはやさしいものからワイルドなものまで
ロマンチックなものから刺激的なものまで、7つの既成デッキから選べます。デッキはいつでも切り替え可能。今の気分に合ったデッキを選ぶのも、まずはやさしい内容から始めて、ふたりの気分に合わせて徐々に大胆なデッキに挑戦するのも自由です。

オリジナルデッキ
90以上の既成アクティビティを使って、既存のデッキを自由にカスタマイズできます。オリジナルのアクティビティを追加したり、ふたりのアイデアだけでまったく新しいデッキを作成したりすることもできます。

カップルに愛される理由
• インタラクティブなチュートリアル付きで、初めてでも簡単に遊べる
• デート

tw.trackName: Make Me Hot：情侶性愛紙牌遊戲
tw.description:
Make Me Hot 是一款專為情侶設計的情趣紙牌遊戲，讓你們的前戲多一點俏皮的樂趣。抽一張牌，讓運氣決定，把平凡的夜晚變成難忘的一夜。

它看起來就像一副普通的 52 張撲克牌，但每張牌都藏著讓人心跳加速、有時甚至更大膽的活動，喚醒你們的感官。在設定的時間內，輪流用這些性感的活動寵愛對方。最好玩的是，你們永遠不知道下一張牌會出現什麼。

玩法
• 輪到的玩家抽一張牌，揭曉一項活動。
• 另一位玩家完成牌上的活動。
• 牌的花色決定活動要持續多久。

方塊規則
有了方塊規則，直到最後一刻，你們都不知道誰會取悅誰。
抽到方塊時，改由抽牌的玩家自己完成這項活動。

高潮
抽到紅心 A 或方塊 A 時，遊戲就結束。最後的活動是用伴侶想要的方式讓伴侶達到高潮，沒有時間限制。等不及了嗎？選擇「最後的選擇」，只從兩張牌中抽一張。還不想結束？開啟「無限模式」，想玩多久就玩多久。

牌組：從溫柔到狂野
7 個預設牌組任你們挑選，從浪漫到狂野一應俱全。你們隨時都可以切換牌組。挑一個符合當下心情的牌組，或是先從溫柔的開始，等你們都準備好了，再嘗試更大膽的。

你們自己的牌組
超過 90 項預設活動，讓你們可以照自己的喜好調整現有的牌組。加入你們自己的活動，或用你們的點子建立全新的牌組。

情侶們愛它的理由
• 簡單好上手，還有互動式教學
• 適合約會之夜、紀念日、蜜月和慵懶的週末
• 鼓勵你們嘗試新事物，坦白聊聊彼此喜歡什麼
• 讓長久的感情依然保有火花
• 個人化設定：你們的名字、自訂時間限制，以及會響鈴的倒數計時器
• 支援 45 種語言
• 不需要帳號或註冊，牌組只會儲存在你的手機上

獻給每一對情侶
Make Me Hot 適合所有成年情侶，不分性別或性傾向。無論你們想要浪漫、更親密的關係，還是新鮮的火花，都能用俏皮的方式享受兩人時光。

僅限成年人（18+）。

gb.description:
Traditional Italian Scopa, on iPhone since 2008.

Scopa is one of the best-loved Italian card games and has been played for centuries. You learn it in one game, and you'll keep coming back.

HOW YOU PLAY
- Two players, against the computer
- Four players, each for themselves or two against two as partners
- Online, with friends or random players
- Nearby, on the same Wi-Fi network
- Two players on the same device

YOUR RULES
- Classic Scopa
- Asso Piglia Tutto
- Scopa d'Assi
- Sbarazzino
- Napula
And every rule can be changed: cards, coins, settebello, re bello, primiera, scope, napula (simple, flush or napoleone), declarations (accuse/cucite), scopa on the last hand, single or multiple captures, the ace.
Play to 11, 21, 31, 41 or 51 points, or "a perdere" (lose to win).

YOUR WAY
- Four difficulty levels
- 15 Modiano decks: 13 Italian regional decks, plus Poker and Salzburger
- Intercha

de.description:
Die traditionelle italienische Scopa, seit 2008 auf dem iPhone.

Scopa ist eines der beliebtesten italienischen Kartenspiele und wird seit Jahrhunderten gespielt. Nach einer Partie kennst du die Regeln – und du kommst immer wieder zurück.

SO SPIELST DU
- Zu zweit, gegen den Computer
- Zu viert, jeder gegen jeden oder zwei gegen zwei im Team
- Online, mit Freunden oder zufälligen Mitspielern
- In der Nähe, im selben WLAN
- Zu zweit auf einem Gerät

DEINE REGELN
- Klassische Scopa
- Asso Piglia Tutto
- Scopa d'Assi
- Sbarazzino
- Napula
Und jede Regel lässt sich ändern: Karten, Münzen, Settebello, Re Bello, Primiera, Scope, Napula (einfach, Flush oder Napoleone), Ansagen (Accuse/Cucite), Scopa in der letzten Hand, einfache oder mehrfache Stiche, das Ass.
Gespielt wird bis 11, 21, 31, 41 oder 51 Punkte oder „a perdere“ (verlieren, um zu gewinnen).

WIE DU WILLST
- Vier Schwierigkeitsstufen

fr.description:
La Scopa italienne traditionnelle, sur iPhone depuis 2008.

La Scopa est l'un des jeux de cartes italiens les plus appréciés, joué depuis des siècles. On l'apprend en une partie, et on y revient sans cesse.

COMMENT JOUER
- À deux, contre l'ordinateur
- À quatre, chacun pour soi, ou deux contre deux, en équipe
- En ligne, avec des amis ou des joueurs au hasard
- À proximité, sur le même réseau Wi-Fi
- À deux sur le même appareil

VOS RÈGLES
- Scopa classique
- Asso Piglia Tutto
- Scopa d'Assi
- Sbarazzino
- Napula
Et chaque règle se modifie : cartes, deniers, settebello, re bello, primiera, scope, napula (simple, flush ou napoleone), annonces (accuse/cucite), scopa à la dernière main, prises simples ou multiples, l'as.
Parties en 11, 21, 31, 41 ou 51 points, ou « a perdere » (perdre pour gagner).

À VOTRE FAÇON
- Quatre niveaux de difficulté
- 15 jeux Modiano : 13 jeux régionaux italiens

gb.description:
MIYAMOTO is a single player card game with a miniature board.
Game art is simple and oriental world with Samurai.
Also offers fast paced gameplay and strategy for mobile optimized.

This game is not TCG/DCG. Like a Roguelike card game.
The important tactics is when and where and which play your card.
Random deck on each battles will not promise their results, It's up to your tactics.
Collect unique heroes and defeat MIYAMOTO.


Features
- Solitaire style gameplay 
- 8 unlock unique Heroes
- Random instant deck building and loot a card by every fights
- 2-3mins fast paced gameplay

jp.description:
MIYAMOTOはミニチュアのボードを舞台にしたシングルプレイ用のカードゲームです。
MIYAMOTOのビジュアルはシンプルなアートに侍が登場する和風の世界観です。
そしてスマホ向けに作られたテンポの早いゲームプレイと戦略性を提供します。

このゲームはTCGやDCGではなく、ローグライクカードゲームです。
重要な戦術は"いつ"、"どこに"、"なに"のカードをプレイするかです。
各バトルでランダムに配られたデッキはあなたの戦術に左右されます。
様々なスキルを持ったマスターを集め、MIYAMOTOを倒しましょう。


特徴
- シングルプレイ
- 集められる8人のマスター
- ランダムなカードと各バトルの報酬カードで構築された即興のデッキ
- 2-3分で遊べるシンプルなゲームプレイ

Zombies!!!  : This one's a no brainer!

• Play up to 4 friends : local and cross-platform
• Survival mode
• Build a city or play in a prebuilt city
• Expansion Pack : Not Dead Yet

Zombies!!! puts you in the middle of the action in this video game adaptation of the hit board game. 

In order to escape the ever advancing zombie horde, players must use a combination of wits and brawn to be the first to the heliport and certain escape. The only problem is, the zombies are everywhere, they appear to be very hungry and your opponents would really prefer if you didn't escape. However, there’s no need to take this horde on your own. The game allows up to 4 other human or AI players to join in on the fun. AI players can be chosen from 10 different characters, each with a unique play style.

Zombies!!!는 다가오는 좀비 떼를 물리치고 탈출하는 게임입니다. 플레이어는 지혜와 용기로 가장 먼저 헬기 착륙장에 도착하여 탈출해야 합니다. 문제는 사방에 배고픈 좀비가 깔려 있고 상대편이 당신의 탈출을 막으려고 한다는 점입니다.

당신은 어떠한 질문, 요청, 아이디어, 또는 버그를보고하려면이있는 경우에는, 저희에게 '재생하는 방법'메뉴에서 이메일을 보내 주시기 바랍니다. 또는 http://zombies.babaroga.com 또는 http://facebook.com/babarogagames에서 지원 사이트를 방문하십시오. 우리는이 게임에 대해 깊이 걱정하고, 더 나은하는 방법에 대한 어떤 제안이 있다면, 우리는 향후 업데이트에 그것을 할 것입니다. 우리는 당신에 대해 게임과 당신의 경험을 걱정한다.

gb.description: Reigns: The Witcher is the latest mutation of the smash-hit swipe ‘em up Reigns series from Nerial and Devolver Digital, set this time in the merciless, dark-fantasy world of CD PROJEKT RED’s award-winning The Witcher series. As Geralt of Rivia, legendary monster slayer of the School of the Wolf, you will fight for survival within the drunken ballads of his dear friend, Dandelion the bard. Will you hunt monsters, upset the locals, or run a hot bath? Navigate the moral meanderings of the world through the eyes of the bard. Swipe right, swipe left, seek glory, find death! Compose an inspiring epic to perhaps, one day, claim immortality.

de.description: Reigns: The Witcher ist die neueste Mutation des wischfreudigen Kulthits Reigns von Nerial und Devolver Digital und verlegt das Geschehen diesmal in die unbarmherzige, düstere Fantasiewelt der preisgekrönten Serie The Witcher von CD PROJEKT RED. Schlüpfe in die Rolle von Geralt von Riva, dem legendären Monstertöter der Wolfsschule, und kämpfe in den trunkenen Balladen deines treuen Freunds Rittersporn des Barden um dein Überleben. Wirst du Monster jagen, für Unmut sorgen oder dir ein Bad gönnen? Stelle dich den moralischen Irrungen und Wirrungen der Welt in den Augen des Barden. Wische nach rechts, nach links, strebe nach Ruhm, finde den Tod! Schaffe ein inspirierendes Epos in der Hoffnung, eines Tages unsterblich zu werden.

fr.description: Reigns: The Witcher est la nouvelle mutation de Reigns, la série de « swipe 'em all » à succès par Nerial et Devolver Digital, qui se déroule cette fois-ci dans le redoutable univers dark fantasy de The Witcher, la série récompensée de CD PROJEKT RED. Incarnez Geralt de Riv, légendaire tueur de monstres de l'École du Loup, et luttez pour votre survie dans les ballades enivrées de son cher ami, le barde Jaskier. Allez-vous chasser des monstres, ennuyer les locaux ou vous faire couler un bon bain chaud ? Voyez le monde à travers les yeux du barde et parcourez les méandres moraux de cet univers. Glissez à droite, glissez à gauche, cherchez la gloire et trouvez la mort ! Écrivez une glorieuse épopée et vous atteindrez peut-être l'immortalité.

kr.description: Reigns: The Witcher는 Nerial과 Devolver Digital에서 선보이는 성공적인 스와이프 게임 Reigns 시리즈의 최신 변주입니다. 이번에는 다수의 수상 경력에 빛나는 CD PROJEKT RED의 위쳐 시리즈 속, 무자비한 다크 판타지 세계를 무대로 합니다. 늑대 교단의 전설적인 괴물 사냥꾼인 리비아의 게롤트가 되어 절친한 친구, 음유시인 단델라이온이 취중에 쓴 노래 속에서 생존을 위해 싸워나가세요. 괴물을 사냥하시겠습니까? 주민들을 화나게 만드시겠습니까? 아니면 뜨거운 목욕을 하시겠습니까? 음유시인의 눈을 통해 세상의 도덕적 갈림길들을 헤쳐 나가세요. 왼쪽으로, 오른쪽으로 스와이프하며 영광을 추구하고, 죽음을 발견하세요! 용기를 주는 대서사시를 작곡하면 언젠가는 불멸을 거머쥘 수 있을지도 모릅니다.

Romi lets you play Rummy Tile (RummyCube, Rummikub, Rami) games against the computer at three different levels. 
Romi is played with two sets of 52 cards and with two wild cards. The purpose of this game is to form groups of three or more cards, which contain either consecutive cards of the same suit or cards of the same number value but of differing suits.

《州長撲克》帶你展開狂野西部的撲克之旅，隨時隨地都能開局，與好友同桌切磋牌技，也能挑戰世界各地的玩家。無論你喜歡輕鬆上桌、參加錦標賽，還是透過任務和日常挑戰贏取獎勵，這裡都有豐富的玩法等你體驗。

從西部撲克新手開始，你將一路穿越德州，在不同地圖中不斷前進，面對更強的對手，進入更高注額的牌局。隨著旅程推進，你可以贏得更多獎勵，逐步成長為真正的撲克高手。

遊戲特色：

歡迎禮包  
立即下載即可獲得免費撲克籌碼、黃金和頭像帽子，輕鬆展開你的西部撲克之旅。

多種撲克玩法  
除了經典德州撲克，你還可以體驗現金桌、單桌即時賽、大輪盤、一對一挑戰賽、皇家撲克模式全押或棄牌、無限制和壓注限制等多種玩法。

與好友一起玩  
邀請好友加入你的私人牌桌，或與來自世界各地的玩家同桌較量。你也可以加入團隊，和隊友一起參與挑戰並贏取更多獎勵。

免費籌碼與每日獎勵  
固定時間領取線上免費籌碼，每日獲得免費拉霸機次數，持續解鎖更多獎勵。

撲克之旅  
從新手湖區一路前往拉斯維加斯。旅程越長，賭注越高，挑戰也越多。

21點、拉霸與骰子玩法  
除了撲克，你還可以體驗 21 點、拉霸機和骰子遊戲，享受更多不同節奏的玩法。

任務、成就與排行榜  
完成地圖任務，贏取更多獎勵；收集戒指、徽章和獎盃，展現你的撲克技巧；不斷提升排名，向頂級撲克明星邁進。

互動聊天  
使用訊息和動畫表情與其他玩家交流，在牌桌上享受更豐富的社交體驗。

隨時隨地盡情遊玩  
使用相同的帳號，即可在手機、平板電腦、網頁、筆記型電腦或桌上型電腦上暢玩。

認證 RNG  
遊戲採用業界標準的 RNG 隨機機制，確保所有遊戲公平進行。

如果你熟悉奧哈瑪撲克或大老二，那麼在《州長撲克》中學習德州撲克會更輕鬆。學會跟注、棄牌、過牌和加注，觀察對手的節奏與策略，在每一場對局中不斷提升自己。

jp.description:

あなたの世界をあなたの戦略で！ 広々としたゲームボード上で、パズルピースをドラッグしたり、マージしたり、マッチしたり、好きなようにオーガナイズすることができます。

どんどん採掘しよう！資源不足？石や木材など建設に必要なアイテムを集めましょう。

もっと発見しよう！ デイリークエストに参加してコインやルビーを集め、おとぎ話の登場人物たちが注文する、おいしいレシピを完成させて報酬をゲットしましょう。
スペシャルイベントを開催！イベントのテーマにちなんだ、さまざまなユニークなアイテムをマージし完成させて、豪華賞品を獲得しましょう。

何百ものアイテムをマッチさせて、より大きなアイテムや建物を作り、想像もしていなかった素晴らしいものを完成させましょう！

宝箱を獲得したり、資源を採掘したり、新たな作物を収穫したりしながら、ファンタジックな冒険を進めていきましょう。

tw.description:
嘟嘟！全員登上動物快線！

踏上迷人的冒險之旅，動物、火車和你的管理技能交織在一起，創造難忘的鐵路體驗。現在就加入我們，讓旅程開始吧！體驗充滿樂趣的動物遊戲、引人入勝的火車模擬，以及讓你渴望更多的閒置大亨體驗。準備好建立你自己的鐵路帝國，成為這個輕鬆且引人入勝的遊戲中的終極大亨吧。今天就下載動物快線，免費開始你的冒險！

登上動物快線

沉浸在繁忙的火車站和動物冒險的世界中。賣票、引導乘客，並確保所有動物的快樂旅程。

吸引新乘客

擴展你的收藏，吸引各種各樣的乘客到動物快遞！探索各種棲息地，冒險進入未知領域，發現稀有和異國情調的動物，加入你不斷增長的乘客名單。

享受風景

坐下來，放鬆身心，看著壯麗的景色在你的火車穿過如畫的風景時展開。驚嘆於鬱鬱蔥蔥的森林、起伏的丘陵和閃耀的河流。火車上的動物會被整個旅程中迎接他們的美麗景色所吸引。

娛樂和參與

保持你的動物乘客在這次一生難忘的旅途中得到娛樂。舉辦精彩的遊戲，提供有趣的活動，並為需要休息的動物提供舒適的休息區。快樂的動物會讓旅程更加難忘和愉快！

擴展你的鐵路帝國

從一列簡單的火車開始，逐步建立一個龐大的鐵路帝國。解鎖新火車，並建立與新的和遙遠目的地的聯繫。成為終極大亨，征服鐵路管理的世界！

動物快線的主要特色：

放鬆的閒置大亨玩法-
即使你沒有積極遊玩，也能輕鬆管理你的火車和車站。在你休息時，動物快遞的繁忙活動也會繼續進行。

完美適合動物和火車愛好者-
如果你對動物和火車有特別的喜愛，這個遊戲就是為你量身打造的！在一次引人入勝的冒險中，同時體驗管理這兩個方面的樂趣。

引人入勝的模擬和大亨元素-
展示你的戰略技能，管理售票、火車升級和乘客滿意度。擴展你的鐵路帝國，成為成功的大亨！

適合所有遊戲愛好者-
無論你喜歡放鬆的閒置遊戲、沉浸式模擬還是免費遊玩冒險，動物快線都提供一種能夠吸引各類玩家的體驗。

gb.description:
Have fun with your friends by playing multiplayer games and doing fun challenges.

Challenge Your Friends requires two players and one device. This is not online multiplayer game, but both players play on the same device. Play games for two.

Some of the games included are: Red Hands, Pong, Tic Tac Toe, Memory, Checkers and few others.

HOW IT WORKS:
Step 1: Find a friend.
Step 2: Choose one of the multiplayer games.
Step 3: The game gives you random challenge.
Step 4: If you both accept the challenge - press ACCEPT.
Step 5: PLAY.
Step 6: When the game is over, do the challenge.

Follow Challenge Your Friends on Facebook for news and updates:
https://www.facebook.com/challengeyourfriendsgame

Challenge Your Friends is multiplayer (two player actually) game and it is played on one device/phone/tablet.

Enjoy!

gb.description:
Dive into the ultimate 3D pool experience with stunning visuals, realistic physics, and addictive gameplay.

Ever wondered what it's like to play billiards on a real table?

Real Pool 3D is the perfect way to explore a variety of game modes with lifelike graphics and accurate angles to help improve your skills.

Customize your pool table by choosing your favorite colors and cloth patterns.

Play Practice Mode if you just want to relax and play without any rules.

FEATURES:
• 8 Ball, 9 Ball, UK 8 Ball and Snooker
• Single Player vs CPU
• Pass n Play with friends
• Spin / English control
• 3 difficulty levels
• 6 cues to choose from
• Realistic physics
• Relaxing music

Simple to play, hard to master, challenge your skills and have endless fun.

So what are you waiting for? Download now for Free!

Find out more about EivaaGames: 
https://www.eivaagames.com

gb.description:
Get ready for an exciting drawing experience with Draw with Buddies! Whether you're a fan of classic games like Pictionary or looking for a new multiplayer challenge, this game has something for everyone.
Draw, guess, and make friends!
Play with other players online, drawing words and guessing what others have drawn. Meet awesome artists along the way? Add them as friends right in the game! Invite buddies to play with one tap, see who's online, and build your creative crew.
Two ways to play:
1v1 Mode — Craft your best art without the pressure of a time limit. Create stunning masterpieces and send them to your opponent to guess. React with emojis and take your time perfecting every detail.
Party Mode — Non-stop fun! One player draws while everyone else guesses in real-time. No player limit, no end — just jump in and keep the creative energy flowing!

tw.trackName: 猜字謎：比手畫腳你演我猜聚會遊戲
tw.description:
快來體驗這款備受喜愛的社交猜謎遊戲。

猜字謎是一款旨在讓人們聚在一起的終極多人猜謎遊戲。無論是派對破冰、家庭聚會還是好友相聚，這款應用程式都是您的不二之選。讓您的表演技巧、模仿天賦和知識儲備接受終極考驗！

Heads up! 這是一款經典的貼額頭風格遊戲，只需將手機放在額頭上即可開始猜詞。擁有數千張卡片，涵蓋數十個類別，包括 Netflix 熱門影集和哈利波特魔法，樂趣永無止境。您甚至可以建立自定義卡組，打造專屬的聚會體驗！

為什麼猜字謎是派對的首選：
• 極佳的聚會遊戲：適合大型團體、情侶或小團隊。

• 海量內容庫：在各種不同的卡組中暢玩數千張獨特卡片。

• 比手畫腳與模仿：透過搞笑的模仿和肢体動作提升溝通能力和創造力。

• 社交問答與百科：測試您對流行文化、歷史和現代趨勢的瞭解。

• 多人互動樂趣：2人或100人均可參與。它是適合各種場合的最佳社交遊戲。

• 無需網路的遊戲：我们的應用程式可以在離線狀態下完美運行。它是公路旅行、飛行和露營時理想的無需網路遊戲。

• 自定義卡組：為圈內好友或特定活動建立並儲存您自己的專屬卡片。

如何開始玩：簡單快速
開始這款比手畫腳風格的遊戲非常簡單。它是任何社交場合下完美的離線遊戲：

1. 選擇類別：選擇一個符合聚會氛圍的卡組。

2. 貼額頭挑戰：Heads up! 一名玩家將裝置舉到額頭。倒計時開始！

3. 表演與描述：朋友們將使用肢體動作、舞蹈和線索來描述螢幕上的詞語。

4. 傾斜計分：
    - 如果猜對了，向下傾斜手機即可獲得一分！
    - 如果想跳過並切換到下一個詞，向上傾斜手機。

5. 挑戰計時：在時間用完之前嘗試獲得盡可能多的正確答案！

探索多樣化的類別：
我們的庫經過精心組織，方便您找到所需內容。我們的卡組涵蓋了從經典表演到 2026 年最新趨勢的所有內容：

• 流行文化與媒體：大片電影、影集、Netflix、動漫、K-pop 和知名實況主。
• 特別興趣：哈利波特、超級英雄、足球傳奇、NBA 球星和網路梗圖。
• 遊戲與科技：電子遊戲、寶可夢、程式設計和加密貨幣。
