kr.description:
최고의 제스처 게임으로 파티 분위기를 한층 더 뜨겁게 달궈보세요!

몸으로 말해요는 사람들을 하나로 모으기 위해 설계된 최고의 멀티플레이어 추측 게임입니다. 파티의 어색한 분위기를 깨는 아이스브레이킹, 즐거운 가족 모임, 혹은 열정적인 팀 대항전 등 어떤 상황에서도 완벽한 선택이 될 것입니다. 당신의 연기력, 표현력, 그리고 상식을 한계까지 시험해보세요!

Heads up! 이 게임은 스마트폰을 이마에 대고 제시어를 맞히는 클래식한 headbands 스타일 게임입니다. 넷플릭스 인기작부터 해리포터의 마법 세계까지, 수십 개의 카테고리와 수천 개의 카드가 준비되어 있어 즐거움이 끝이 없습니다. 자신만의 커스텀 덱을 만들어 우리만의 특별한 추억을 게임으로 즐길 수도 있습니다.

몸으로 말해요가 파티 게임의 최고인 이유:
• 완벽한 파티 게임: 단체 모임, 커플, 또는 소규모 팀 게임으로 최적화되어 있습니다.

• 방대한 콘텐츠 라이브러리: 다양한 테마의 덱에 포함된 수천 개의 독특한 카드를 즐겨보세요.

• 연기와 모사: 폭소를 유발하는 판토마임과 제스처를 통해 소통 능력과 창의력을 높일 수 있습니다.

• 소셜 퀴즈: 팝 컬처, 역사, 그리고 2026년 최신 트렌드에 대한 지식을 테스트해보세요.

• 멀티플레이어의 즐거움: 2명부터 100명까지 동시에 즐길 수 있습니다. 모든 모임에 가장 적합한 소셜 게임입니다.

• 인터넷 없이 즐기는 게임: 오프라인에서도 완벽하게 작동합니다. 자동차 여행, 비행기 기내, 캠핑 등 인터넷 연결이 어려운 곳에서도 즐길 수 있는 이상적인 게임입니다.

• 커스텀 덱: 친구들만 아는 농담이나 특별한 행사를 위해 나만의 카드를 만들고 저장하세요.

게임 방법: 쉽고 빠릅니다

gb.description:

Made by MobilityWare - original creator of Solitaire (300,000,000+ downloads) - this easy to learn card game is perfect for fun and relaxation.

TRIVIAL is a trivia game divided into several categories to challenge your knowledge!


How to play:
• Start a new game 
• Select your favorite category 
• Answer the 7 questions in the shortest time 
• The more correct answers in a row, the more points you get!


You can choose from the following categories:
• Geography (Countries, capitals, flags...)
• Entertainment (Movies, music, artists...)
• History
• Art and Literature (Books, paintings...)
• Science and Nature
• Sport (Football, board games...)

Want more than one category? No problem! You can choose the random mode so your game has a bit of everything ;)

TRIVIAL shows a set of statistics for you to stay on track of your performance in the game and always try to improve your maximum!

Terms of Use: https://mobilesolutions.pt/privacy-policy-terms-services/

Duo Draw turns your iPhone into the ultimate party drawing game. You draw on the inside screen while everyone else watches the drawing on the back screen.

• Draw inside, they guess outside: your drawing shows live on the back screen
• Set it down half-folded like a laptop and keep drawing
• Pick one of three random words each turn, from over 2,400 words

• Play online: jump into a quick game, or share a room code with friends

DUO DRAW PRO
• Every theme pack: Food, Fairy Tales, Sports & Games, Space & Science and more
• Words in Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Chinese
• Your own word lists, for inside jokes and themes
• Four more app icons for your Home Screen

「別世界」は3つのユニークなテーマの環境に 30を超えるレベルを持つ『Shadowmatic』のチャプターです：古代世界、音楽、空間。このチャプターは別売りで発売中です。


Shadowmaticは美しいグラフィックとリラックスしながらじっくりと楽しめるゲームプレイを組み合わせています。

正しい答えを見つけるまでにプレイヤーは数え切れないほどの想像力を刺激するシルエットを見ることになります。

ゲームには15つの部屋があり、それぞれが独自のコンセプトと空間、音楽で特徴づけられています。

ヒント
ゲームにはヒントシステムが採用されています。ただし、ゲームを最大限に楽しむためには出来る限りヒントを利用しないことをおすすめします。

支援ボタン
右上隅の支援ボタンはオブジェクトをゆっくり正しい方向に回転させることでパ ズルを解くのを支援します。ボタンを押すと、ヒントポイントが使用されます。

音楽
各部屋で独自アレンジの音楽が流れ、独特の空気と感覚を生み出しています。音楽はヘッドホンを使うことで最大限に楽しむことができ、また個別にiTunesでお求め頂けます。

-- 美しいグラフィック
-- 第2目的（追加ゲーム要素）
-- 支援ボタン
-- 一直線ではないゲーム進行
-- 3D立体ビュー
-- アーケードモード
-- Apple TVとの同期

tw.description:
** 2015年Apple Design Award得主 **
** App Store. iPhone 年度最佳游戏 2015 **
** App Store. iPad 年度创新游戏 2015 **

Shadowmatic是一款能夠激發想像力的謎題遊戲，遊戲過程中，你將在聚光燈下旋轉抽象物體，在牆上找出可辨認的投影。

「其他世界」是 Shadowmatic 中的一個篇章，在 3 個獨特的主題環境中有 30 多個關卡：古代世界、音樂和空間。本篇章現可供單獨購買。

這款遊戲融合了精彩的視覺效果和既輕鬆又令人愛不釋手的遊戲玩法。

在探索的旅程中，您將驚喜地發現很多超乎想像、變幻無窮的投影。

遊戲有15個房間，每個房間都有獨特的概念設計、環境氛圍以及音樂效果。

提示。
遊戲中包含一系列的提示。為能夠充分享受遊戲的樂趣，我們建議您僅在個別情況下進行求助。

輔助按鈕
輔助按鈕位於右上角，會慢慢旋轉物品至正確的方向，藉此幫助你慢慢破解謎題。 當你按下按鈕時，就會花費提示點數。

音樂。
每個房間都有自己獨特的音樂編排，形成了獨特的氛圍和與眾不同的感受。佩戴耳機可獲得最佳音樂效果，同時，這些音樂還可在iTunes單獨購買。

-- 炫酷的畫面
-- 次級目標
-- 輔助按鈕
-- 非線性關卡進度
-- 3D視差效果
-- 街機模式
-- 與 Apple TV 同步

** Shadowmatic要求裝置為iPhone 5s及更高版本。

kr.description:
*** Apple Design Award 2015 우승자 ***

Shadowmatic은 모든 상상력을 발휘해 비정형적인 추상 물체를 회전시키고 이 물체가 만들어 내는 그림자를 주변 그래픽과 관련된, 식별 가능한 사물의 실루엣으로 완성하는 퍼즐 게임입니다.

“또다른 세계”는 Shadowmatic의 한 챕터로, 30개 이상의 레벨을 3가지 독특한 환경인 고대 세계, 음악 및 우주를 무대로 제공합니다. 이 챕터를 지금 별도로 구매할 수 있습니다.

환상적인 비주얼을 구현한 Shadowmatic을 통해 천천히 생각하며 퍼즐 조각을 맞춰나가는 독창적인 게임플레이를 즐길 수 있습니다.

퍼즐의 최종 형태를 완성해 가는 과정에서는 예상치 못한 독특하고 다양한 실루엣을 발견할 수도 있습니다.

Shadowmatic의 게임맵은 15개의 방으로 구성되어 있으며, 각 방은 서로 다른 컨셉, 분위기, 음악을 활용해 독특하게 연출되어 있습니다.

힌트.
게임은 퍼즐에 대한 힌트를 제공합니다. 하지만 게임이 주는 매력과 즐거움을 온전히 경험해 보기 위해서는 최소한의 힌트만 사용해 플레이하는 것을 권장합니다.

도움 버튼.
상단 우측 도움 버튼은 물체를 올바른 방향으로 조금씩 돌리며 퍼즐을 푸는 데 도움을 줍니다 . 버튼을 누르면, 힌트 점수가 사용됩니다. 

음악.
게임이 진행되는 각 방마다 다른 음악이 사용되어 더욱 특별한 분위기 속에서 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다. 음악은 헤드폰으로 들을 때 더욱 풍부하고 멋진 사운드를 경험할 수 있으며, 게임 음악은 iTunes에서 별도로 구매할 수도 있습니다.

-- 15개의 방에서 펼쳐지는 130여 가지 레벨
-- 환상적인 그래픽
-- 퍼즐 속에 숨겨진 2차 목표 
-- 도움 버튼
-- 비순차적 레벨 진행

gb.description:
IT’S TIME TO GET HORRID AND PLAY SOME PRANKS HORRID HENRY STYLE!

Big Box of Pranks is a fast and funny, action-packed collection of mini-games based on Horrid Henry’s love of pranks and mischief.
  
Featuring your favourite characters and all of Henry’s nemeses from the BAFTA nominated TV series; play through a wide range of fast moving mini-games.  The difficulty level increases as you progress through all the pranks, becoming more and more frantic until you lose all your lives!

The challenge is on, beat your own high score and unlock new games by moving up the levels – ultimately to become ‘Lord High Excellent Majesty of Pranks’!  

There are NO IN-APP PURCHASES in this App. Bonus pranks are unlocked automatically as you play.

Be Horrid…be really horrid.  Download now…if you dare!

FEATURING THE FOLLOWING AWESOME PRANKS
• SUPER SPIDER 
• SCARE GROSS GOO 
• BUMPER BURPTASTIC 
• LOUNG

gb.description:
Even you can become a great artist! Wrestle subjectivity as you attempt to sell your art to rude customers in order to progress in this confusing art scene. The only thing threatening you is your expensive wine and baguette addiction! Will your art end up in the Louvre or on your parents' fridge?


Passpartout puts you into the shoes of a French artist trying to navigate the beautifully confusing art scene. Paint and sell your own art to survive your expensive baguette addiction.


Features
- Paint your own masterpieces! Even you can become the next Van Gogh!
- Battle with subjectivity and try to charm a variety of self-proclaimed art connoisseurs without losing your "artistic integrity"!
- Survive your wine and baguette bills. Will your addiction to baguettes be your downfall?
- Unlock fancier galleries and customers!
- Experience the French art world through a living puppet theater!
-

Passpartout는 프랑스 예술가의 입장에서 아름답지만 혼란스러운 예술계를 경험할 수 있는 게임입니다. 그림을 그리고 완성된 작품을 팔아서 값비싼 와인과 바게트에 중독된 삶을 이어 가세요.

특징
- 자신만의 걸작품을 그리세요! 당신도 반고호처럼 거장의 반열에 오를 수 있습니다!
- 예술적 개성을 찾고 ""예술적 자존심""을 지키면서 자칭 예술 애호가들의 마음을 사로잡으세요!
- 와인과 바게트 값을 지불하세요. 바게트에 중독된 삶은 당신을 나락으로 인도하게 될까요?
- 더 화려한 갤러리와 고객들을 잠금 해제하세요!
- 생동감 넘치는 인형극을 통해 프랑스 예술계를 경험하세요!
- 인기 절정의 그루브 공룡 Synkronosaurus가 선사하는 놀라운 사운드트랙이 포함되어 있습니다.

gb.description:
Come to Dr. Panda’s Restaurant and cook delicious food for the animal guests!  

In this app, kids will be introduced to cooking through fun and exciting mini-games. They will be exposed to a wide range of foods as Dr. Panda has a recipe book which contains 10 different dishes and drinks. Among many others, it includes pizza, apple pie, corn soup, Chinese wok and fruit milkshakes.

For kids, this game combines meal time with fun time, without any mess!

To prepare all of these delicious things, kids will complete varied activities such as slicing, frying, toasting, mixing and baking. Besides preparing and serving food, they will also have fun while feeding the animals, decorating the dining rooms, cleaning the tables, and recycling garbage.

KEY FEATURES

- 8 adorable animal guests to serve and feed 
- Learn the basics of cooking with Dr. Panda’s 10 recipes
- Learn to help with the house

像一名真正的大廚一樣料理吧！

快來熊貓博士餐廳爲小動物客人們烹飪美味可口的食物吧！ 熊貓博士將通過一系列充滿趣味的迷妳遊戲將孩子們帶入奇妙的烹飪世界。 孩子們將在遊戲中領略並烹飪世界各地的風味美食如: 披薩餅、蘋果派、玉米濃湯、中華炒菜和果味奶昔等等，更多美食盡在熊貓博士的11種美味食譜哦！

對孩子們來說，在寓教于樂的遊戲過程中學到烹飪知識真是再好不過了！

想要做出美味可口的菜肴，孩子們需要在遊戲過程中學習各種烹飪技藝：烘、炒、烤、拌等樣樣不落。 此外，孩子們還將從洗滌餐具、清潔餐桌、分類垃圾的迷妳遊戲中獲得額外的收獲和樂趣。

- 8種可愛的小動物客人
- 通過11種菜譜學習烹飪技藝

hk.description:
像一名真正的大廚一樣料理吧！

快來熊貓博士餐廳爲小動物客人們烹飪美味可口的食物吧！ 熊貓博士將通過一系列充滿趣味的迷妳遊戲將孩子們帶入奇妙的烹飪世界。 孩子們將在遊戲中領略並烹飪世界各地的風味美食如: 披薩餅、蘋果派、玉米濃湯、中華炒菜和果味奶昔等等，更多美食盡在熊貓博士的11種美味食譜哦！

對孩子們來說，在寓教于樂的遊戲過程中學到烹飪知識真是再好不過了！

想要做出美味可口的菜肴，孩子們需要在遊戲過程中學習各種烹飪技藝：烘、炒、烤、拌等樣樣不落。 此外，孩子們還將從洗滌餐具、清潔餐桌、分類垃圾的迷妳遊戲中獲得額外的收獲和樂趣。

遊戲特色：
- 8種可愛的小動物客人
- 通過11種菜譜學習烹飪技藝 
- 通過3款額外的迷妳遊戲培養孩子做家務和環保的意識 
- 觸摸與發現：精美的畫面，诙諧的動畫和音效
- 兒童易用：專爲兒童設計的圖形界面簡潔易上手
- 兒童安全: 杜絕第三方廣告植入和應用內購買 

隱私策略 
作爲兒童遊戲的設計者，我們非常清楚個人隱私在這個數字化的時代有多麽的重要。您可以從這裏閱讀我們的隱私策略：http://www.drpanda.com/privacy 

關於熊貓博士
熊貓博士(Dr. Panda) 為孩子們提供最優質的兒童教育遊戲，讓他們在開心玩耍的過程中學到知識，認識世界。

如果您想了解更多關於我們或對我們是如何爲孩子們設計遊戲感興趣的話，請訪問我們的網站www.drpanda.com。發電子郵件到 support@drpanda.com 或聯繫我們的  

Facebook ：facebook.com/drpandagames
Twitter：twitter.com/drpandagames

fr.description:
Venez au restaurant de Dr. Panda et cuisinez de délicieux plats pour ses clients les animaux ! 

* Tablette.com - « Dr Panda Restaurant est un joli jeu de cuisine pour les enfants. On appréciera ses graphismes et sa durée de vie. A essayer ! » 

* SOSiPhone - « Une très bonne application pour responsabiliser l’enfant et lui donner l’envie d’aider à la maison. » 

Dans cette application, votre enfant fera ses premiers pas en cuisine à travers des mini-jeux amusants et deviendra un vrai chef cuistot! Il aura la possibilité de choisir les ingrédients qu’il souhaite afin de concocter les plats que propose le menu du restaurant de Dr. Panda. Parmi les 10 plats et boissons à la Carte du Dr. Panda, il pourra préparer entre autres des pizzas, tartes aux pommes, potages de légumes, plat au wok ou encore des milkshakes. 

Ce jeu pour enfants combine cuisine et amusement, sans les dégâts !!

kr.description:
닥터팬더의 레스토랑에 와서 동물손님들을 위한 맛있는 음식을 만들어보아요!

이 앱에서, 아이들은 재미 있고 흥미 진진한 미니 게임을 통해서 요리들을 소개하게됩니다 . 닥터팬더의 10 가지 요리와 음료를 포함하는 요리 책으로 아이들은 음식의 다양함을 깨닫게 될 것입니다. 몇몇 유명한 요리 외에도, 피자, 사과 파이, 옥수수 수프, 중국 웍과 과일 밀크 쉐이크 등이 포함됩니다.

아이들에게 이 게임은, 문제 없이 즐거운 시간과 함께 식사 시간을 갖춘 게임입니다!

이 모든 맛있는 음식을 준비하기 위해 아이들은 썰기, 튀기기, 굽기, 섞기 및 제빵 같은 다양한 활동을 경험할 것입니다. 음식을 준비하고 제공하는 것 외에도 동물들을 먹이고, 식당을 장식하고, 테이블을 청소하고, 쓰레기를 재활용하는 재미를 찾을 수 있습니다.

정식버전 주요특징
- 음식을 서빙하고 먹여 줄 수 있는8가지의 귀여운 동물손님들
- 닥터팬더의 10가지 요리법으로 기초 요리법을 배워보아요
- 집안일 돕기를 배울 수 있는 세 가지의 미니게임
- 터치와 발견: 환상적인 그림들, 재미있는 애니메이션과 음향효과들
- 아이에게 친근: 쉽고 간단한 접속방법, 읽기 필요 없음
- 아이에게 안전: 타사광고나 ‘앱인’ 구매페이지 없음

개인정보 보호정책 
아이들의 게임 개발자로서 우리는 현대 디지털 세상의 개인정보가 얼마나 중요한지 잘 알고 있습니다. 저희 개인정보 보호정책을 www.drpanda.com/privacy 에서 확인 하실 수 있습니다. 

Dr. Panda 소개
닥터팬더는(Dr. Panda) 아이들을 위한 게임을 개발하는 회사입니다. 저희는 아이들이 세상에 관해 배울 수 있는 교육적인 가치가 있는 게임을 개발합니다. 

저희가 어떻게 어린이들을 위한 게임을 디자인 하는지 궁금하시면 주저 말고 연락하세요. support@dr

gb.description:
Are you Upperclass? Or full of Sass?

This dress up game lets you create infinite girl characters, hoping for their own happily ever after.  High school can be tough, but they're up to the challenge!

Play stylist to your avatar doll as you customize each part of her look.  Mix and match bangs, pull-back styles and long hair to create unique cuts.  Infuse up to three different colors into her natural or magical hairstyle!

Put together your own fashionable outfit, even designing your own FABRIC! Customize and layer skirts to your heart's content. This game even let's you mix and match to design your own shoes!  Lace with satin and gold embroidery? You got it!  Sweet Lolita dress elements or a Japanese kimono? That's there too!

Take a walk on the wild side with animal items that can create nekos, angels, fairies and more!  Choose cat-eyes, tails and ears to create adorable cat girls! The

Best of Mac App Store 2016 game now on iOS!

Pirate heroine Nelly Cootalot takes on the evil Baron Widebeard in this hilarious adventure game. 
Meet an outlandish cast of characters featuring the voice of Tom Baker (Dr Who), and face perplexing challenges in your search for the Treasure of the Seventh Sea.

• "The puzzles are as perfect as possible" - Just Adventure

Join Nelly and explore a hand-drawn world created by award-winning comedian Alasdair Beckett-King. This is your opportunity to:
• Race aristocrats for fun and profit.
• Commandeer an ancient airship.
• Enter the mind of a monkey wizard.
• Borrow moonshine from a surly Viking.

The animated sticker app for children with descriptive audio and fun sound effects! Join over half a million users already enjoying Make a Scene! Over 100 million scenes created! 

- WHY PARENTS AND TEACHERS LOVE THIS APP

Make a Scene Dinosaurs is a fun interactive game that engages children’s natural sense of creativity. It is aimed primarily at pre-school age children, but will provide hours of entertainment for children (and adults!) of all ages. Helping to develop vocabulary, fine motor skills, co-ordination and creative thinking, Make a Scene offers a great way for children to play and learn at the same time. 

Make a Scene Dinosaurs uses drag and drop interactions, descriptive audio, fun sound effects and engaging animations to create an entertaining, educational platform. Children will have endless fun using their imagination to create their very own prehistoric scenes.

- WHY CH

Journey into the forest, the jungle or the depths of the deep blue sea. Find chestnuts for the pigs, a caterpillar for the crocodile or a starfish one, two three.

- gorgeous hand-drawn watercolor visual
- relaxing gameplay and audio
- accessible to everyone because no text! (just numbers)
- 9 different locations all over the world
- 29 animated animals to discover
- 50+ iMessage stickers

jp.description:
森の中、ジャングル、青い海の底へと旅に出てみませんか。 豚のために栗を、ワニのために毛虫を探してみませんか。ヒトデをいくつか見つかるはずです。 動物の世界をテーマにしたカラフルな探し物ゲームです。 美しい手書きの水彩画と心休まるサウンドにより、エキゾチックな体験をお楽しみいただけます。

- 美しい手書きの水彩画
- 心休まるゲーム体験＆サウンド
- 文字がないため（数字のみ）誰でもお使いいただけます
- 世界中から厳選された9つの場所
- アニメーションする動物が29匹隠れています
- iMessageステッカー50枚以上

tw.description:
到叢林、森林、或深海中探索。 為野豬尋找栗子，為鱷魚尋找毛蟲，或尋找各式各樣的海星。 一款在色彩繽紛的動物世界中尋找隱藏物品的遊戲。 沉浸在絢麗的水彩手繪及柔和的音樂環境中，輕鬆漫遊異域。

- 絢麗的水彩手繪
- 柔和的音樂及輕鬆的遊玩體驗
- 適合所有年齡層！（沒有文字，只含數字）
- 包含世界上 9 種不同的地方
- 發現 29 種會動的可愛動物
- 50+ 個 iMessage 貼圖

kr.description:
숲이나 정글, 깊은 바다로 여행을 떠나보세요. 돼지에게 호두를, 악어에게 애벌레를 찾아주거나 불가사리를 한 개씩 한 개씩 찾아보세요. 동물의 세계를 배경으로 한 숨은그림찾기 게임입니다. 손으로 채색한 수채화와 같은 멋진 그림과 편안한 배경 음악으로 이국적인 경험을 하게 됩니다.

- 손으로 채색한 멋진 수채화
- 편안한 게임플레이와 오디오
- 텍스트 없이 숫자만 있어 모두가 이용 가능
- 전 세계에 걸쳐 9개의 다양한 위치
- 그림으로 된 29개의 동물 찾기
- 50개 이상 iMessage 스티커

gb.description:
** The New Innovative Physics-puzzle Game ! ** 

You can have amazing experiences in the whole new world of candy machine!
Collect the stars by rolling the coins in a variety of structures, and get the candies.
Now, Put a coin into the machine, and the fantastic adventure will begin!

FEATURES:
- High quality graphics and exciting gameplay
- 160 levels made up of the dynamic kinematics
- Enjoy the game with various coins!
- Adjust the speed or the tilt under your control
- Easily get all the candies using punch!
- Magnetic stars stick to the nearby coin!
- We offer new features and additional levels through free updates

How to play:
Tilt to move left or right, tap the screen to shoot.

Be warned! Santa isn't always so jolly, especially when being shaved!

Open up shop, and start shaving your most valued clients today, Santa and Rudolph are only in town this time of year! Give them custom beard designs, getting them ready for the big night just around the corner!

Just remember, don't go too crazy shaving...you still want to make sure you are on the nice list!


FEATURES 
* Choose between Santa and Rudolph and your other favourite christmas characters
* Cut and trim hair with a scissors, razor blade, and clippers 
* Patch up any sore spots with paper bits. 
* Get rid of any rashes with the rash cream 
* Apply aftershave and wait for the reaction! 
* Kid friendly interface! 

Shave Santa™ is a trademark of Bluebear Technologies Limited.

About Bluebear 
Bluebear makes fun games for family and kids. Our popular cooking apps have legions of fans, and we pride ourselves in

A selection of games to test and improve your memory.

Kim's Game: The classic. A number of objects are placed on the table. After a minute they are covered and one is removed. Can you remember which?
Pairs: The cards are laid face down. Pick two to try and find a pair. If you succeed those two will disappear. How quickly can you clear the deck?
Colours: Can you remember which colour came 3rd in the sequence?
Sequences: Listen to the notes. Can you repeat the sequence?
Flags: Learn to identify the flag of every country in the world.
Flip Cards: Learn and then test yourself on a variety of topics. More topics will be added with each release.

A little green alien stopped on Earth for snacks and now the whole planet wants him gone. Chickens hop at him, bananas leave peels, mowers charge, umbrellas drop out of the sky, and that's just the start. Your job is to run, jump and zap your way back to the ship.

Pick up and play. Easy to dip into for five minutes, hard to put down.

It's a platformer with 60 levels and 21 kinds of Earthling, each with its own trick. Watch out: they start teaming up as you go. Gnomes pounce, toasters fire toast, kites block the way, trolleys come at you flat out. Every fifth level ends with a boss, 12 in all, and the big ones at the end of each tier take some working out.

If you like chasing a perfect run, there is plenty here. Three stars for a fast, high scoring level. Do it without losing a life and the tile turns blue-gold. Practice makes perfect. (Here it really does!) Five ranks to climb, all th

Ślimak Ortoptyczny to gra wzrokowa dla dzieci z zaburzeniami konwergencji. Może być stosowana u dzieci z zezem rozbieżnym, wspomaga również ćwiczenia niedowidzenia. W tym przypadku należy ćwiczyć ze szczelnie zasłoniętym okiem prowadzącym. 

Ważne! Przed zastosowaniem gry skonsultuj się ze specjalistą (okulistą, ortoptystą lub optometrystą).

Instrukcja:

1) Ćwiczenia konwergencji:

Urządzenie trzymaj na wysokości oczu dziecka; płynnym i powolnym ruchem zbliżaj je do nosa obserwując jednocześnie oczy dziecka. 

Zadaniem ćwiczącego jest trafienie komara, który pojawi się na środku tarczy i zebranie jak największej liczby punktów. Uważaj na ślimaki, one zabierają punkty! 

2) Ćwiczenia przy niedowidzeniu:

Dziecko ma również za zadanie trafić komara na środku tarczy jednak tym razem ma szczelnie zasłonięte zdrowe oko i gra jedynie okiem niedowidzącym.

Osoba dorosła może trzymać urządzenie

Красочная игра в слова, где черно-белые картинки раскрашиваются по мере разгадывания загаданных слов. Сложность игры возрастает постепенно от простых знакомых слов к более сложным. Эта увлекательная игра поможет расширить кругозор ребенка, познакомить с новыми словами, отработать навыки чтения и правописания. 

Простой и понятный интерфейс позволяет ребенку играть без помощи взрослых, которые особенно оценят, что ребенок проводит время не только с большим интересом, но и пользой.
 
В приложение входят 6 раскрасок и 150 слов из самых разных категорий - одежда, животные, цвета, овощи, фрукты и многое другое.

Awesomely original, creative fun for boys and girls ages 2 to 8. Kids choose clothes, colours and patterns by tapping and moving items on the screen. Boy and girl dolls are included. There are no ads, no makeup, no immodest clothing. Kids focus on their task, show their designs to siblings or parents or save them to the Photos app, then tap the arrow to start a new doll. Clothes snap into place so finger accuracy is not required.

Dress-up is perfect for teaching touch-screen concepts to toddlers, kids with special needs, and new iPad users. The interface is super-responsive and simple. Kids see girl and boy dolls of all colours, wearing clothes any child might wear. Children who are learning to dress themselves love it.

gb.description:
Three rounds. Three bosses. One mallet.

Mallet Mayhem is a 3D mole-whacking game set in a storybook wood. The moles pop up, you bring the mallet down. Be quick: the faster the whack, the more it's worth.

KNOW YOUR MOLES
• Plain moles, moles in shades and sneaky ones
• Hard hats take two whacks: knock the hat off first
• The rare Golden Mole in his crown is worth 250
• Not the hedgehog! Spikes cost you points and your multiplier

THREE ROUNDS, THREE BOSSES
• Round 1 ends with KING MO. Empty his health bar before the clock runs out
• Round 2: the hills shuffle, then BRISTLE the hedgehog chief. Quills up, hands off!
• Round 3: the hills turn on a ring, then BASHER, the toughest of them all
Beat all three to become MALLET CHAMPION, and the whole cast sings for you.

KEEP IT GOING
10 in a row is ×2, 25 in a row is ×3, and every 25 is a MOLE RUSH.

MADE FOR YOUR SCREEN
Plays on iPhone and iP

Your journey as a Train Driver begins today in this realistic train simulator! From the makers of the world-leading Trainz series, take charge of a wide range of powerful locos, hauling thousands of tonnes of freight, shunting in the yard or shuttling passengers along suburban lines. Explore amazingly detailed and interactive routes from around the world from a variety of camera angles. Fun for ages 5 to 95!

Rosworth Vale is set in the North of England, crossing the fells to Scotland.  The line was built in 1870 by the LNWR.  Today it sees lots of traffic as a diversionary route, through the lumber industry, tourism and rail excursions. 

Sessions included in this Train Driver Journey include:

Coal Transporter
HST to London
Morning Passenger
Rosworth Goods Run
Free Drive

gb.description:
Pango, Piggy, Fox, Squirrel and Bunny… they all invite you to their home with lots of games and activities. Pangoland is the first game that gives free rein to your little ones’ imagination. With this open world application, kids can explore a fascinating universe and enjoy a freedom like they have never experienced before. 

In Pangoland, everyone can find his own way to play and everyday is full of surprises. You can change the season, the weather and even switch from day to night in one click. It is cold outside and you feel like staying at home? Then light a fire, decorate the Christmas tree with Pango, cook a delicious meal and invite all characters for a lovely dinner. 

You prefer adventure and exploration? Don’t wait any longer and take your car to discover exciting activities. Helping Bunny to grow vegetables in the garden, digging up prehistoric fossils with Squirrel, building

Truck Doodle is a fun, yet simple app that allows your little ones to design their very own monster trucks! They choose and customize the body style, add an engine, shocks, and tires. Then, they can paint it any color they like, including two-tone paint and finish with one or several cute decals.

Once their truck is just the way they like it, they can drive it along our peaceful countryside scene. To make the driving especially fun, they can try to hit (or avoid) various fruit obstacles along the way. Their truck becomes covered with splatters as they hit the fruits and will inevitably need a car wash. Good thing we've included one!

Once in the car wash, your little one can clean up their truck with a sponge, a spinning brush and a water hose. Then, take their truck back to the garage to further customize or just run it along the path again.

'Babalonia Playtime' is a collection of beautiful educational games for children aged 3-6.
The games are specially designed to combine entertainment and learning. They develop skills such as observation, shape and colour recognition and general problem solving.

The menus are simple so that the children can easily jump from one game to another. 
In addition, the games are easy to start playing with and get more challenging gradually. They do not contain text, so they are suitable for children of any age and linguistic ability.
At the end of each level, the kids receive positive feedback with happy music and animation.
Babalonia Playtime is a safe app because it does not have advertising of any kind, web access, external links, unwittingly purchasing app content or credits.

• Games/challenges that boost creativity and imagination
• Colourful illustrations and characters

Get ready for an exciting adventure with Fruit Memory! This thrilling matching game is perfect for the whole family. Choose your favorite character and dive into a world of fruity fun! Match the different fruit cards with up to 4 players, or challenge yourself in single-player mode.

In single-player mode, keep track of your time and number of guesses to beat your personal records! With multiple modes, you can customize your gameplay. Preschool mode is perfect for little ones, showing all cards at the start to help them learn. Speed mode is for the competitive player, with animations off to test your speed. Pro tip: try tapping two cards at a time to boost your score! Let the fruity fun begin!

Blek is a unique game about imagination and personality. Everything you draw keeps moving – and watching your creations move is like watching magic.
 
The goal is simple: shape a line that collects all colored circles avoiding black holes on its route. There are no specific moves that you need to master. To every level countless solutions exist, from delightfully simple to exceptionally deep and complex, yet always elegant.
 
----- Articles & Commentaries -----
 
"The Most Brilliant iPad Game I've Played All Year." ~ Kotaku
 
"One of the greatest joys of Blek is experimenting with your approach." ~ WIRED
 
"It’s the sort of game you’d want to put on a space probe: when the aliens play it, they’ll take a liking to us right away." ~ The New Yorker
 
"Wonderful experience" ~ Pocket Gamer
 
"Blek is a thing of elegant, intuitive beauty" ~ Edge

"One of the year’s best" ~ The New York Times

de.description:
Was auch immer du zeichnest, erwacht zu Leben  – und die eigenen Kreationen in Bewegung zu sehen ist wie Magie.

Das Ziel ist einfach: kreiere eine Linie, die auf ihrem Weg alle farblichen Kreise trifft und dabei den schwarzen Löchern ausweicht. Durch seine Offenheit und Eleganz ermutigt dich Blek zu einem intuitiven, spielerischen Zugang. Es schreibt dir nichts vor. Für jedes Level existieren nahezu unendlich viele Lösungen. Sie sind manchmal unglaublich einfach, dann wieder tief und komplex - doch immer wunderschön.

----- Presse -----

""Irgendwann folgt man nicht mehr dem Ziel des Spiels, sondern zeichnet Figuren, schaut zu, wie sie sich fortsetzen. Lässt die Linie gegen den seitlichen Bildschirmrand prallen, beobachtet, wie sie zurückwandert. Und entspannt dabei. "" ~ Carsten Görig, KulturSPIEGEL

""Besser als jedes Game, das ich dieses Jahr entdeckt habe, verkörpert Blek den Geist

「このゲームはまるでモダンアートだ……今年最高の作品のひとつである」 ~ The New York Times

ゲームの目的はシンプルです。一本の線を描き、途中のブラックホールを避けながら、色のついたサークルをすべて集めること。特別な動きをマスターする必要はありません。どのステージにも、面白いほどシンプルなものから非常に難解かつ複雑なものまで無数の答えがあり、それでいていずれもエレガントな躍動感に満ちているのです。

Blek est un jeu primé de l'imagination et de la personnalité.
Tout ce que tu dessines bouge – et le visionnement de tes propres créations est comme le visionnement de la magie

L’objectif du jeu est simple : il s’agit de dessiner une ligne qui doit tracer le chemin jusqu’à tous les cercles coloriés, tout en évitant les trous noirs.  Il ne faut maîtriser aucune compétence particulière ou mouvement. Pour chaque niveau, il existe un nombre illimité de solutions, dont quelques-unes sont étonnamment simples et d’autres bien complexes, mais toujours très élégantes.

Blek ne peut pas s'expliquer avec des mots - visualisez la bande annonce.

gb.description:
Sneezies is an overload of cuteness!

Grab a cup of tea, sit back in your favorite plush chair, and enjoy the soothing relaxed gameplay featuring fantastic graphics and sweet melodies.

Touch the screen to drop a burst of sneezing powder into the field of floating Sneezies and watch as they sneeze themselves out of their bubbles. Try to initiate a chain reaction to rescue as many Sneezies as you can in this family fun puzzle game.

Touch the screen to drop a burst of sneezing powder into the field of floating Sneezies and watch as they sneeze themselves out of their bubbles in a marvelous chain reaction. Try to rescue as many Sneezies as you can in one go.

Sneezies features beautiful graphics, varied backgrounds, hilarious sound effects, and relaxed, soothing background music

Play through 45 relaxing levels of Sneezies in the Classic Mode, or unleash your skills in the 15 Challenge Mod

de.description:
Sneezies ist eine Überdosis an Niedlichkeit!

Hol dir eine Tasse Tee, lehn dich zurück in deinem Lieblingsstuhl und geniesse das beruhigende, Spiel mit fantastischer Grafik und süssen Melodien.

Berühre das Display um einen Stoss des Niespuders in das Feld der freien Sneezies zu werfen und schaue zu wie sie sich aus ihren Blasen niesen - in einer fabelhaften Kettenreaktion. Versuche so viele Sneezies wie möglich in einem Durchgang zu retten.

Sneezies beinhaltet wunderschöne Grafik, verschiedene Hintergründe, lustige Soundeffekte und entspannende Hintergrundmusik.

Spiele durch 30 entspannende Sneezies-Levels im Klassischen Modus oder entfessle deine Fähigkeiten in einem der 10 Herausfordernden Modi.

Poste deinen Highscore gratis online, direkt aus dem Spiel heraus und sehe wie gut du gegen andere Sneezies-Spieler aus aller Welt stehst.

genres: エンターテインメント
jp.description:
とってもキュートなSneezies達を見逃すな!

さあ、コーヒーを片手にソファーでくつろぎながら美しいグラフィックと可愛いメロディーで繰り広げられるリラックスシューティングプレイを楽しもう。

スクリーンをタッチし、ふわふわ浮かぶスニーズ達にくしゃみを起こさせるスニーズパウダーをぶつけよう。パウダーがあたると泡に閉じ込められたスニーズ達がくしゃみをしながらどんどん飛び出すぞ。一度にできる限り多くのスニーズを助け出そう。

Sneeziesは美しいグラフィックにバラエティー豊かな背景、楽しい音響効果そしてリラックスできるシューティングミュージックを搭載。

30種類の癒し系レベルでプレイできるクラッシックモードで遊んだり、10種類のチャレンジモードで君のスキルを引き出そう。

ゲームから直接ハイスコアをオンラインに投稿し世界のSneeziesプレーヤーに君の腕前を見せつけよう。

*****************************************
"Un gameplay simple, attrayant et complètement captivant." - www.ApplicationiPhone.com

*****************************************

SNEEZIES est plein de douceur !

Saisissez une tasse de thé, asseyiez vous dans votre fauteuil favoris et profitez du gameplay apaisant comportant de fantastiques graphismes et des mélodies douces.

Touchez l’écran pour déposer une touche de poudre à éternuer dans le champ de Sneezies flottants et regardez les éternuer en dehors de leur bulle dans une merveilleuse réaction en chaine. Essayez de sauver autant de Sneezies que vous le pouvez, en un seul coup.

Sneezies présente de somptueux graphismes, des arrières plans variés, des effets sonores amusants et une musique de fond douce et agréable.

Jouez durant 30 niveaux relaxants de Sneezies dans le mode classique ou améliorez votre niveau dans le mode Challenge.

gb.description:
Prove your accuracy by destroying popping-up moving targets and fight against time in the new "hit-the-target" mode! Show off your skills and impress your friends while collecting bonuses and knocking down cans moving on a conveyor! Can Knockdown 2 is like three top-notch games in one - it will keep you, your family and friends hooked for months to come! Get this new iDreams title now and lose yourself in a world of addictive gameplay, amazing physics and global competition! Definitely a must have in your games collection!

Millions of players can't be wrong! Once again your aiming skills will be put to test but this time more challenges await! Can Knockdown 2 is the ultimate sequel you've been wishing for - 3 amazing and rewarding game modes which will keep you playing all night long, high-resolution eye-catching gorgeous 3D graphics, full Game Center support, true to life physics, real

de.description:
Beweisen Sie Ihre Treffsicherheit durch die Vernichtung von auftauchenden beweglichen Zielen und kämpfen Sie gegen die Zeit in dem neuen "hit-the-target"-Modus! Zeigen Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten, beeindrucken Sie Ihre Freunde und sammeln Sie Boni und die umgeworfenen Dosen, die sich auf einem Förderband bewegen! Can Knockdown 2 ist wie drei erstklassige Spiele in einem - es will Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für die kommenden Monate abhängig machen! Holen Sie sich diesen neuen iDreams-Titel jetzt und verlieren Sie sich in einer Welt des fesselnden Gameplays, der tollen Physik und des globalen Wettbewerbs! Definitiv ein Muss in Ihrer Sammlung von Spielen!

Millionen von Spielern können nicht falsch liegen! Noch einmal wird Ihre Zielsicherheit auf die Probe gestellt, diesmal jedoch erwarten Sie viele Herausforderungen! Can Knockdown 2 ist die letzte Folge, die Sie sich immer gewünscht haben - 3

kr.description:
툭 튀어 오르는 움직이는 목표를 파괴하여 여러분의 정확한 사격 실력을 증명하고 새로운 "목표 때리기" 모드에서 시간에 맞서 싸워 보세요! 보너스를 모으고 운반 장치위로 움직이는 깡통을 때려눕히는 도중에 여러분의 솜씨를 뽐내고 친구들이 주목하게 만들 수 있습니다! Can Knockdown(깡통 때려눕히기) 2는 세 가지 일류 게임을 하나로 모아 놓은 것과 마찬가지인 게임입니다. 여러분, 가족 및 친구들이 몇 달 동안  이 게임을 계속해서 매우 즐기게 될 것입니다! 이 새로운 iDreams 게임을 구입하여 중독성 있는 게임 스토리, 놀라운 움직임 및 전세계에 걸쳐 벌어지는 경쟁의 세계에 푹 빠져 보세요! 여러분의 게임 컬렉션에 반드시 소장해야 될 필수 게임입니다!

수백만 명의 게이머들이 틀릴 리가 없습니다!  Can Knockdown(깡통 때려눕히기) 2는 밤새도록 계속 즐기게 만드는 3가지 놀라운 게임 모드, 시선을 끄는 고해상도의 멋진 3D 그래픽, 실제에 가까운 움직임, 실제적인 음향을 비롯한 다양한 특징을 갖춘 여러분이 원해 온 최고의 속편 게임입니다!

FOLLOW US: http://twitter.com/idreamsgames 
WATCH US: http://youtube.com/idreamsgames

gb.description:
Over 25 million people around the world are playing this original arcade bubble shooter! 

 - "From the second I started playing, I couldn't put it down until I completed it. Literally. Bubble Bust! is a top-quality, highly-addictive puzzle game."
 -- App Unwrapper: 4.5/5

 - "Bubble Bust just might be one of those addictive match three games that will surprise you... can be easily grasped within the first level or two, but ends up being very addictive. The game features a bright and enjoyable presentation package as well." 
 -- 148Apps.com "POPPING GOOD"

Some player reviews: 

 - "WOW!!! I've seen a lot of games like this but this is by far the best one out there, stunning visuals and intense gameplay" - 5 star review

 - "I LOVE THIS GAME! I've played other bubble type games but this one is fantastic! I love the way everything moves, the graphics, the game itself! - 5 star review

 -

gb.description:
What are cats up to at dawn, when nobody's around?

Sneaking around the back alleys? Probably!
Going through garbage cans? Not likely!
Playing ball games? Most certainly!

Join the cats in their favorite midnight ball game: CAT PHYSICS!

The objective is simple -- Pass the ball from one cat to another!

Sound too simple?
Oh, wait... did we mention flip boards, glass windows, trap doors and other obstacles?

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

WHAT REVIEWERS SAY:

- "Highly Recommended" -- TouchArcade
- "App Store Game Of The Week" -- GamePro

- "Totally recommend it"

gb.description:
AN ENTIRELY NEW GAMING EXPERIENCE 

**USA TODAY: Rating: 4 stars (out of 4)
"In the crowded market of puzzle apps, Blueprint 3D HD shines for its uniqueness."

Magical 3D motion puzzle game
Never before seen gameplay
NEW: Create own 3-D puzzles

• OVER 300 LEVELS OF PURE AMAZEMENT!
Each level begins with a mysterious clutter of seemingly chaotic dots and lines. Underneath all the chaos, however, lies a beautiful blueprint image waiting to be uncovered. It’s right there in front of you: Just drag your finger across the screen to rotate the figure, and all of a sudden you’ll notice that the lines start to make sense! Solve the puzzle by rotating the figure in all directions and on all planes until you hit the sweet spot.  Once you’re there, the secret picture will reveal itself. Wait till you see this in action!

• 3-D Camera and Editor Feature
Take photos and easily convert them into amaz

de.description:
EINE VÖLLIG NEUE ART ZU SPIELEN

Magische 3D-Bewegungsrätsel
Völlig neuartiges Spielerlebnis
NEU: Erstelle eigene 3D-Puzzles

gb.description:
From the Award Winning Studio Crescent Moon Games and Glenn Corpes, one of the creators of the original Populous series of games, comes TOPIA WORLD BUILDER, a unique world building sim, tailored for iOS devices. 

Topia World Builder is a world creation simulation. You become god and shape the land as you choose, by the use of touch controls. Swipe your finger to create mountains, valleys, rivers, and oceans. Watch trees grow, spawn thousands of animals - and watch them live and die on the planet of your creation! 

Features: 

-Create Mountains 
-Create Valleys 
-Create Rivers 
-Create Oceans 
-Spawn various animal types 
-Build enormous herds of animals 
-Watch predators attack other animals 
-Save your worlds so you can edit them later 
-Change the color of land, water, sky 
-Play in both landscape and portrait modes

3개 매치 레벨을 플레이하며 나만의 섬 빌라를 꾸미세요. 머리를 써서 마법사 빙고의 문제를 해결하고 새로운 친구들을 만나면서 꿈꿨던 낙원의 섬을 만들어 봐요!

◆독특한 3개 매치 게임플레이로 3,000개 이상의 레벨에 도전해 보세요. 다양하고 맛있는 요리를 수집하고 귀여운 동물들도 찾으세요!
◆재미로 가득한 열대 섬을 탐험하며 수수께끼를 풀어 가세요.

◆워터 슬라이드까지 갖춘 나만의 워터파크를 만들어 보세요 - 뜨거운 여름 더위에서 벗어나기엔 최고로 좋은 방법이죠!

gb.description:
Think fast. Explain faster. But here's the catch — you only get a few letters to work with!

Meet Lettzy, the party game that turns "just describe the word" into a hilarious tongue-twisting challenge. Pick a category, get 1–3 random letters, and explain the word on your screen using ONLY words that start with those letters. Got the word "pizza" and the letter C? "Cheesy circle... cooked... crust covered..." — you get the idea. It's harder than it sounds, funnier than you'd expect, and impossible to put down.

Perfect for game nights, road trips, family dinners, parties, or any moment that needs a little chaos.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT:
– A fresh twist on word games: It's not just about knowing the word — it's about wrestling your vocabulary into shape under pressure.
– Categories for every crowd: Pick a deck that matches your group's vibe, from easy crowd-pleasers to brain-melting challenges.

세계적으로 유명한 식당을 만들고, 꾸미고, 경영해 보세요!

우유나 계란 같은 신선 식품은 직접 재배하세요!

친구들과 식재료, 요리를 교환해 보세요!

hk.description:
走到Deck前，用DJ Club 3D點燃舞池！這是一款以沉浸式3D夜店為舞台的DJ模擬與音樂混音遊戲。載入裝置上的音樂，用虛擬DJ混音台塑造聲音，控制燈光，透過以觀眾為核心的挑戰打造你的DJ生涯。

無論是嘗試轉場、練習混音，還是與好友對決，你的選擇都會影響現場氣氛。觀察舞者、關注觀眾心情，體驗音樂表演如何改變整個場地。

混合自己的音樂
將歌曲分配到Deck A和Deck B，設定播放順序並瀏覽完整音樂清單。準備下一首歌時，查看彩色波形和曲目計時器。在DJ視角、Console、Deck A、Deck B與設定之間切換，並透過縮放近距離操作控制面板。

掌控DJ CONSOLE
用交叉推桿融合兩首歌曲。調整音量、Gain、低音、中音、高音、Filter和Pitch，塑造你的轉場。使用jog wheel移動曲目播放位置，嘗試不同切入時機。探索主控、Echo和Delay，為混音增添層次。

不必停止播放，即可為每首歌曲儲存三個個人化Cue點，需要時跳回對應位置。重新載入同一首歌時，已儲存的Cue點會再次顯示。開啟1至64拍循環，再次點選使用中的循環即可解除。

用耳機準備轉場
先在耳機模式試聽下一首歌曲，再將它送入主混音。暫停試聽可保留播放位置，也能使用五秒傳送倒數，把準備好的歌曲帶入表演。練習何時以及如何加入新曲目。

加入效果與表演打擊墊
體驗Reverb、Filter Up、Filter Down、Flanger和Gate。用Filter、Noise、Crush和Space調整Sound Color FX。兩台各有16個打擊墊的取樣器可加入拍手、上升音效、衝擊音、倒放效果等聲音，還能透過專用取樣器控制進一步塑造音色。

點亮夜店
從DJ台觀察自己的演出，同時控制場地燈光、色彩效果與頻閃。探索六家擁有不同配色、休息區、樓台及發光顯示螢幕的夜店。動態舞者和背景觀眾讓每個場地充滿活力。

打造DJ生涯
六個場地各有三項挑戰。在五分鐘倒數結束前，讓跳舞觀眾的比例達到要求，並累積目標時長。完成越來越有挑戰性的目標，解鎖下一項挑戰，慶祝你的勝利。

練習或對戰
在練習室模式中探

gb.description:
Take photos. Shape the crowd. Watch a tiny world turn what it sees into what it becomes.

We Become What We Behold is a short satirical story game about news, attention, and how people copy what the screen shows them. Move the camera, double tap to capture moments, and see each photo change the mood of the crowd.

A strange, memorable game for fans of story games, social simulation, camera gameplay, and dark comedy.

de.description:
Mach Fotos. Beeinflusse die Menge. Erlebe, wie eine kleine Welt zu dem wird, was sie auf dem Bildschirm sieht.

We Become What We Behold ist ein kurzes, satirisches Story-Spiel über Nachrichten, Aufmerksamkeit und die Macht der Bilder. Bewege die Kamera, tippe zweimal, um einen Moment festzuhalten, und beobachte, wie jedes Foto die Stimmung der Menge verändert.

Ein ungewöhnliches Spiel, das im Kopf bleibt – für Fans von interaktiven Geschichten, Gesellschaftssimulationen, Kamera-Gameplay und schwarzem Humor.

gb.description:
Try and develop your music knowledge in this quiz app. The questions span over 70 years of popular music. You will be asked about songs performed by famous artists such as ABBA, Beyoncé and Madonna , number one hits, one hit wonders, music mile stones and so on.

To make the quiz extra challenging all questions are included in the app. That means you cannot use the music library in your iPad/iPhone/IPodTouch.

Another challenge is that the questions will be asked without you hearing the song. The answer is given in a multiple choice formula. A local leaderboard keeps track of your high scores for all levels.

gb.description:
A puzzle game where you draw ropes around pegs to steer falling balls into a goal. Every bounce plays a note on the beat, so each solution ends up sounding like its own little song.

DRAW, DROP, LISTEN
Press on a peg, drag a rope around others and let go to close the loop. Balls fall, bounce off your ropes and play them like instruments. Grab a rope to reshape it, or unwind it to try again.

SIX ROPES, SIX WAYS TO BOUNCE
• Bounce: a clean, simple bounce
• Slide: the ball hugs the rope and slides along it
• Catch: holds the ball for a beat, then lets go
• Launch: flings the ball back harder than it came in
• Beat: tilt it and it winds up and fires the ball off
• Aim: sends the ball off square to the rope

64 HANDMADE LEVELS
From your first loop to tricky timing puzzles with walls, spikes and moving platforms.

JAM
No goal, no rules. Draw with every rope and make your own beat.

• Designed

gb.description:
Melotap is a calm rhythm game built around beautiful melodies instead of fast reflexes.

Play through a collection of more than 80 carefully arranged classical and folk pieces, with new tracks added regularly. Every level is handcrafted so the notes feel natural under your fingers, making it feel a little like you’re actually playing the music.

The game keeps things simple. Clean visuals, hand-drawn artwork, and no unnecessary distractions. It’s something you can pick up for a few minutes to relax, or spend longer trying to perfect a piece.

Melotap isn’t about chasing high scores as much as getting into the music. It’s calm, a little meditative, and just challenging enough to keep you focused.

Features
• Over 80 handcrafted rhythm levels inspired by classical and folk music
• New tracks added regularly
• Hand-drawn artwork with a clean, minimalist look
• Smooth and satisfying gameplay

gb.description:
Piano Monsters is a fun game and excellent musical exercise for ear improving. This is an unusual game with unique mechanics where you use your voice pitch to control monsters. They hear you and respond to your singing, humming or whistling.
Monsters adore to eat candy-notes. Help these cute creatures catch the notes.

How to play:
Before you begin, plug in your headphones.
Listen up reference notes and reproduce them using the pitch of your voice or a musical instrument. You can sing or hum, play piano or guitar. You just need to make sound in tune (hit the right note). When you hit the right note monsters will jump and catch the candy.
The game starts with an easy task with two monsters and two notes. New monsters and notes will be unlocked as you will progress through the levels.
Unlock all levels, collect 12 monsters and feed these hungry creatures!

jp.trackName: Piano Monsters: 楽しい音楽ゲーム
jp.description:
Piano Monstersは楽しいゲームであり、耳の改善のための優れた音楽エクササイズです。これは、モンスターを制御するためにあなたの声を使用するユニークなメカニズムを持つ珍しいゲームです。彼らはあなたを聞き、あなたの声に反応します。
ピアノには12人のモンスターが住んでいます。彼らはキャンディーノートを食べるのが大好きです。これらのかわいい生き物がノートをキャッチするのに役立ちます。

遊び方：

参照音を聞いて、声や楽器のピッチを使用してそれらを再現します。歌ったり、ハミングしたり、ピアノやギターを弾いたりできます。正しい音を打つと、モンスターがジャンプしてキャンディーをキャッチします。
ゲームは、2つのモンスターと2つのノートで簡単なタスクから始まります。レベルを進めると、新しいモンスターとノートのロックが解除されます。
すべてのレベルのロックを解除し、12匹のモンスターを収集し、これらの空腹の生き物を養います！

すべての年齢（子供から大人まで）およびすべての能力（初心者から上級者）に適したPiano Monsters。
Piano Monstersは、音楽の耳を改善したい人に最適なツールです。

ゲームでは音を聞くためにヘッドフォンを使用する必要があることに注意してください。 AirPodsは再生に最適ですが、他のヘッドフォンでも問題ありません。

特徴：

-面白いモンスターを使った珍しい音楽ゲーム
-中毒性のゲームプレイ
-音楽の耳を開発するための優れた運動
-音声制御を備えたユニークなゲームの仕組み

-素晴らしいグラフィックとキャラクターアニメーションをお楽しみください

-音楽の耳をテストしてスキルを向上させる

The good old music quiz is back!

Music Quiz is a fast paced trivia game that tests your knowledge in your own music library. The objective is to recognize the correct song from 5 possible options without running out of time.
Every round 5 titles are shown, and a random song starts playing. You must recognize the song and tap on the correct option. The quicker you are, the more points you get. Tap on a wrong answer or run out of time - you lose a life, lose all 5 lives - game over!

FEATURES

♫ Your Music - Music Quiz uses songs from your own library, so the music is good - guaranteed!
♫ Polished Interface - Simple gameplay & beautiful graphics.
♫ High Scores - Compete against friends or challenge yourself.
♫ Sharing - Post your scores to Facebook & Twitter.
♫ Connect your device to a speaker or your car stereo to play with friends.

gb.description: Challenge your musical skill with Interval by determining which chord was played.  For each puzzle, three chords are played with the musical notation displayed for the first two.  The third chord will be one of four choices displayed - choose your answer by touching the right chord. The point value for each game will be added to your score for the correct answer, but half the points will be deducted for each wrong one.  You can play the three chords as many times as you like, and you can move on to the next puzzle without answering and without penalty.  Your musical knowledge will increase with repeated playing of the game.

用充滿生機的3D來展現獨屬我的組合。

培養成國際偶像的各種系統！
通過日程管理、聲樂、舞蹈、演技訓練，提高偶像的才能和魅力！
將其培養成演唱會、電影、電視劇等各領域得到認可的明星！

請與引進的偶像進行溝通吧！基于與偶像們的紐帶關系

爲了讓偶像住的舒適給偶像裝修宿舍！

ca.description:
Become a rock legend with Queen as you tap to the rhythm of over 20 classic songs including Bohemian Rhapsody, We Will Rock You, We Are the Champions and Radio Ga Ga.
Hit the stage and perform with the entire band—Freddie Mercury, Brian May, Roger Taylor and John Deacon—as you unleash your music talents to play thrilling guitar riffs, heart-pounding drum solos and much more. All you need to do is tap the tiles in time with the rhythm!

Embark on a musical journey to rediscover the story of Queen, the world’s most iconic rock band. Play their greatest hits at historic venues, create your own stage performances with unique animations and legendary outfits, and collect exclusive images from the official archives of Queen!

◉ GAME FEATURES > (Fully Unlocked Version Required)

• Play your favourite tracks with over 20 official Queen songs from their greatest albums, including Bohemian Rhapsod

hk.description:
隨著節奏搖擺，與Queen樂團一起成為搖滾傳奇！此遊戲收錄超過20首經典歌曲，包括「Bohemian Rhapsody」、「We Will Rock You」、「We Are the Champions」和「Radio Ga Ga」！
跟所有樂團成員一起表演，佛萊迪墨裘瑞、布萊恩梅、羅傑泰勒和約翰迪肯與你登台演出。你能狂放飆彈吉他和大秀鼓技，盡情釋放音樂潛能。只需要隨著音樂節奏點擊即可！

踏上音樂旅程，深入了解世界聞名搖滾樂團Queen的崛起故事。你能在歷史性場地演奏Queen的暢銷金曲，還可運用獨特動畫和傳奇服裝打造專屬的獨特表演，並到Queen的官方珍藏館收集獨家照片！

◉ 遊戲特色>（需解鎖完整版）

• 超過20首官方版Queen金曲等你暢玩！歌曲橫跨多張暢銷專輯，包括「Bohemian Rhapsody」、「Keep Yourself Alive」、「We Will Rock You」、「I Want to Break Free」和「We Are the Champions」等等！
• 在趣味十足、引人入勝又容易上手的遊戲中，測試自己的音樂實力。無論你最拿手的是彈奏吉他、敲鑼打鼓、狂彈貝斯，還是純粹愛唱歌，只要抓準時機點擊，就能在遊戲中創作出令人印象深刻的音樂！
• 只要舞台上的節奏不間斷，就能達到瘋狂連擊，並獲得超棒的遊戲分數來完成歌曲！
• 在不同場地中，換上解鎖的官方版服裝和自訂配飾，讓粉絲眼睛一亮！
• 在經典場地上輪番表演，包括倫敦、東京、休士頓、布宜諾斯艾利斯和里約熱內盧等地的舞台！
• 熟練吉他、樂鼓、貝斯、演唱和鋼琴的技巧，成為終極搖滾音樂傳奇。
• 精美圖像和獨特舞台動畫的靈感來源都是Queen的經典造型，讓你親眼見證精彩表演。
• 到官方Queen的珍藏館解鎖並收集有趣的音樂小知識，還有獨一無二的樂團影像。

***準備好和Queen一起寫下音樂歷史了嗎？那就快點登台表演吧！***

>>> 《Queen: Rock Tour》雖可免費下載及暢玩，但你也能選擇花費真實金錢購買完整版遊戲，體驗更豐富的遊戲內容。

fr.description:
Devenez une légende du rock avec Queen en touchant l'écran au rythme de plus de 20 chansons classiques dont Bohemian Rhapsody, We will Rock You, We Are the Champions et Radio Ga Ga.
Montez sur scène avec le groupe —Freddie Mercury, Brian May, Roger Taylor et John Deacon— et déchaînez vos talents musicaux pour jouer des riffs de guitare poignants, des solos de batterie palpitants, et bien plus. Vous n'avez qu'à toucher les notes en rythme !

Partez à la redécouverte de l'histoire de Queen, le groupe de rock le plus mythique au monde. Jouez leurs plus grands succès sur des scènes historiques, créez vos propres concerts avec des animations uniques et des tenues de légende, et récupérez des images exclusives des archives officielles de Queen !

◉ DANS CE JEU > (Version complète débloquée requise)

• Jouez vos morceaux préférés parmi plus de 20 chansons officielles de Queen tirées des meilleu

kr.description:
Bohemian Rhapsody, We Will Rock You, We Are the Champions 및 Radio Ga Ga 같은 20개가 넘는 명곡의 리듬에 맞춰 터치하여 Queen과 함께 록의 전설이 되어 보세요.
신나는 기타 리프, 심장이 쿵쾅거리는 드럼 솔로 등으로 당신의 음악적 재능을 펼치면서, 프레디 머큐리, 브라이언 메이, 로저 테일러, 존 디콘 등 밴드 전원과 무대에 올라 멋진 공연을 보여주세요. 그저 타일을 리듬에 맞게 터치하기만 하면 됩니다!

음악 여행을 떠나 세계 최고의 상징적인 록 밴드인 Queen의 이야기를 다시 발견해보세요. 역사적인 장소에서 그들의 히트곡을 플레이하고, 나만의 특별한 애니메이션과 전설적 의상을 만들며 Queen 공식 아카이브에서 독점 이미지를 수집하세요!

◉ 게임 기능 > (잠금 해제된 풀 버전 필요)

• Bohemian Rhapsody, Keep Yourself Alive, We Will Rock You, I Want to Break Free, We Are the Champions 등 Queen 최고의 앨범에서 20개가 넘는 그들의 명곡 중 가장 좋아하는 트랙을 플레이해보세요!
• 이렇게 재미있고 중독성 강한 직관적 게임을 통해 당신의 음악 스킬을 시험해보세요. 당신이 전설적인 기타, 드럼, 베이스 연주자든 노래를 하는 보컬이든, 제시되는 타일을 제때 터치하기만 하면 모바일에서 가장 기억에 남을 음악을 만들게 됩니다!
• 스테이지를 넘어 리듬을 계속 이어가 전곡을 플레이 및 완료하여 놀라운 콤보를 달성하고 최고의 게임 점수를 획득하세요! 
• 장소마다 해제 및 수집할 수 있는 공식 의상과 맞춤형 액세서리로 관중을 압도하세요.
• 런던, 도쿄, 휴스턴, 부에노스아이레스, 리우데자네이루 등 상징적인 장소를 잇달아 돌며 노래를 플레이하세

gb.description:
Guess The Song - a free music quiz game for real music lovers.

The rules are simple. The robot reads the lyrics of the song and shows you 4 answers, of which only 1 is correct. With the correct answer, you are credited with bonus coins and the site of the song is reproduced.
It's a lot of fun :-)

Total in the game 3 categories of songs:
- Hits of the current year
- Hits of the 90s
- Hits of the 2000s

And 3 types of tips:
- Repeat Lyrics
- 50/50
- Play music

If you've read - ahead to guess tunes!

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS

Subscription options

In Guess The Song Music Games Pop we offer you the following subscription option:

- Diamond membership offers a weekly subscription for $9.99 after a 3-day free trial, unlocks special features and removes all ads.

gb.description:
Guess the movies behind this famous music with the movie soundtrack blindtest!

Are cinema and music your passions? Do you want to test your general knowledge of film music? Can you guess a movie by its soundtrack? If you like music quizzes and cinema quizzes, this app is for you!

FEATURES:
- Over 1000 movies and TV shows to guess!
- 20 amazing levels (and more to come soon)!
- Special lists of films grouped by theme!
- Rediscover the music of the greatest films!
- Learn more about movies after guessing them correctly!
- Frequent app updates!

The game is very simple: you listen to a 30-second clip of the film's soundtrack. You are then shown a set of letters that can compose the title of the film. All you have to do is type the title of the movie with these letters.

More movies to guess soon!
Enjoy it for free and have fun with the best cinema-music quiz!

hk.description:
熱愛音樂并想展現你的節奏感？
那就來試試音樂愛好者的首選遊戲Piano Fire2吧！ 
在這裡你可以盡情享受你喜歡的音樂節拍，同時還能挑戰你的反應能力！

怎麼玩？
隨著節拍及時點擊彩色板塊並彈出令人驚嘆的音樂！
選擇播放喜歡的歌曲，準確掌握曲調並增加遊戲樂趣！

遊戲特色
多種音樂：超過 300 首曲目可供選擇，確保每個人都能找到適合的旋律！
獎勵寶藏：解鎖新曲目、絕美的皮膚，並以特殊成就來紀念您的挑戰！
和諧感官：體驗聲音和視覺完美融合的遊戲，提供令人著迷的遊戲體驗。
無盡挑戰：創新的關卡與不間斷的挑戰！

加入Piano Fire2的世界，將您的音樂體驗提升到一個新的LEVEL！
無論您是想在空閒時間放鬆的玩家還是有抱負的挑戰性大師，這款遊戲都可以和任何熱愛音樂的人完美匹配！

VIP 訂閱

음악을 사랑하고 리듬감을 뽐내고 싶으신가요?
그렇다면 음악 애호가들을 위한 새로운 게임, Piano Fire 2를 즐겨보세요! 여기에서 당신이 좋아하는 음악 비트를 즐기면서 동시에 반사 신경에 도전할 수 있습니다!

게임 방법? 
비트에 맞춰 다채로운 블록을 탭하고 놀라운 소리를 만들어보세요!
좋아하는 노래를 재생하여 정확하게 곡을 익히고 즐거움을 더해 보세요!

게임 기능
다양한 음악 장르: 300개 이상의 트랙 중에서 선택할 수 있어 모두에게 멜로디가 보장됩니다!
보상의 보물: 새로운 트랙과 놀라운 스킨을 잠금 해제하고 특별 업적으로 도전을 기념하세요!
감각적 조화: 사운드와 시각적 요소가 완벽하게 혼합되어 매혹적인 게임 경험을 제공하는 게임을 경험해 보세요.
끝없는 즐거움: 끊임없이 도전하는 혁신적인 레벨!

Piano Fire 2의 세계에 참여하여 음악적 경험을 한 단계 높여보세요!
여가 시간에 휴식을 원하는 플레이어이든 도전적인 마스터를 꿈꾸는 플레이어이든 이 게임은 음악을 사랑하는 누구에게나 완벽한 경기입니다!

1. 150개 이상의 VIP 노래와 향후 출시될 노래를 잠금 해제하세요.
2. 광고 없음.

Welcome to the ultimate screw pin jam puzzle! Activate your brain with this clever nuts and bolts screw puzzle brainteaser. This screw away 3d pin puzzle will test your skills. Our unscrew challenges combine classic screw bolts nuts with smart thinking.

How to Play:
First, tap your mobile screen to remove the screw pin slowly, then sort the screw bolts nuts by colors to finish each level. 
Watch the unscrewed nuts fall into matching boxes at the same time. If you get stuck, you can use fun boosters or add extra screw sort 3d boxes. These tools help you solve tricky screw jam challenges.

Main Features:
- Endless Levels: Face unlimited screw pin jam puzzle challenges with no time limit.
- Progressive Challenge: Feel your screw master skills improve as you play more screw jam levels.
- Brain Training: Solve each unscrew nuts puzzle with logic and perfect your screw out skills.
- Strategic

gb.description:
Brick Blast is an engaging bricks and balls game with simple rules, a hint of challenge, and plenty of effortless fun. Pick your angle, shoot the balls, and watch them blast through every brick in their path.

Brick Blast delivers pure enjoyment with no rush or pressure. Play at your own pace and enjoy smooth, dynamic gameplay that will help you unwind while training your logic and focus.

How to Play Brick Blast:

The goal is simple: break the bricks and keep the board clear. Swipe to aim and release to shoot—the ball shooter sends glowing balls flying across the screen, bouncing off walls and smashing through colourful blocks. Plan your shots wisely to hit the best angles, clear multiple bricks at once, and watch the balls bounce out across the board in dazzling chains of glowing hits before the blocks reach the bottom line.

Swipe to aim and release to shoot—the ball shooter sends glowing balls flying across the screen, bouncing off walls and smashing through colourful blocks. Plan your shots wisely to hit the best angles, clear multiple bricks at once, and watch the balls bounce out across the board in dazzling chains of glowing hits before the blocks reach the bottom line.

Discover power blocks that make this block breaker even more

tw.description:
《Brick Blast》是一款引人入勝的磚塊及球類遊戲，規則簡單，略具挑戰，而且樂趣無窮。選擇角度，發射小球，看它們一路爆破擊毀途中的每一塊磚塊。

《Brick Blast》帶給你純粹的樂趣，無需匆匆忙忙或承擔壓力。依照自己的步調遊玩，享受流暢、動態的遊戲，在鍛鍊你的邏輯與專注力之餘，也能幫助你放鬆身心。

《Brick Blast》遊戲玩法：

目標很簡單：打碎磚塊，讓遊戲區保持清空。滑動來瞄準，放開來射擊。發射器會讓發光的小球在螢幕上飛速穿梭，在牆壁上反彈並擊碎彩色磚塊。巧妙地計劃你的射擊以打出最佳角度，一次消除多個磚塊，並在積木到達底線之前，觀看小球在遊戲區中彈跳，形成炫目的閃光連擊。

發現能力積木，讓這款積木粉碎遊戲更加刺激：

• 雷射會穿越列或行，破壞沿途所有積木。
• 倍數會讓你的小球變成三倍數量，打出超強連擊。
• 重新導引來改變球路，以便到達難以觸及的角度。
• 額外的小球會讓你在回合結束前獲得更多力量。

巧妙運用能力積木，享受強大的球類爆炸和磚塊破碎連鎖反應。

為什麼你會喜歡《Brick Blast》：

• 一款易於上手、風格現代、畫面流暢的磚塊破壞遊戲。
• 充滿特殊磚塊、連擊、球類爆破與發光磚塊破壞效果的動態關卡。
• 一項令人放鬆的消遣，沒有壓力，沒有時間限制，只有純粹的專注和快樂。
• 既能放鬆身心，又能磨練策略技巧的有趣方式，非常適合喜歡解謎任務和打磚塊遊戲的玩家。
• 無盡的球類破壞遊戲，讓你欲罷不能。

休息片刻，遊玩《Brick Blast》，感受每一次完美擊球的喜悅！

In this game, you play as a coder who accidentally found out that their cat is extremely good at coding, but not as good at speaking human language. gb.description:
Long ago a witch lived in Hidden Town. The villagers feared for their lives, so they captured her. But on the day of her conviction, she mysteriously disappeared and was never seen again. The house where she lived remains at the top of the hill nowadays. The urban legend tells if you walk into his house, you can be trapped forever. Would you dare to investigate if it is true?

Nowhere House is the third chapter in the Hidden Town escape room games series. You will have to interact between three parallel worlds and seek help from the characters trapped in the house. Only with their help you will be able to escape the room.

You can play the Dark Dome escape room games in any order, you will always be able to find the connections between each one until you discover all the mysteries surrounding Hidden Town. This horror escape mystery game has connections to Haunted Laia and The Ghost Case

jp.description:
昔、Hidden Town には一人の魔女が住んでいました。村人たちは命の危険を感じ、彼女を捕らえました。しかし、判決の日、魔女は突然姿を消し、二度と現れませんでした。彼女が住んでいた家は今も丘の上に残っています。都市伝説では、その家に入ると永遠に閉じ込められてしまうと言われています。本当にそうなのか、あなたは確かめる勇気がありますか？
Nowhere House は Hidden Town 脱出ゲームシリーズの第3章です。3つの並行世界を行き来し、家に閉じ込められたキャラクターたちの助けを借りなければなりません。彼らの協力がなければ脱出は不可能です。
Dark Dome の脱出ゲームはどの順番でも遊べ、すべての謎がつながっていき、Hidden Town を取り巻く秘密を徐々に解き明かしていきます。このホラー脱出ミステリーは Haunted Laia と The Ghost Case とも関連しています。  - このサスペンススリラ ゲームで見つかるもの:
3つの次元に散りばめられた数多くのパズルと謎解き。
魅力的なキャラクターたちとの、魔法とサスペンスに満ちた脱出アドベンチャー。
没入感のあるサウンドと優れたグラフィックによる、忘れられない体験。
あなたの選択によって変化する2つのエンディング。
追加のチャレンジ：ゲームの至るところに隠された9羽のフクロウを探そう。
とても充実したヒント機能。行き詰まった時に助けになります。
 - プレミアム版: プレミアム版を購入すると、Hidden Town のサイドストーリーとなる秘密のシーンをプレイできます。追加のパズルと謎も含まれています。さらに広告が完全に削除され、ヒントも広告なしで利用できます。
 - 探偵ストーリーゲームの遊び方: クラシックなポイント＆クリックゲームのように、画面のオブジェクトやキャラクターをタップして調べます。隠されたアイテムを見つけ、組み合わせて新しいアイテムを作りながら進めていきます。あなたの推理力を試し、パズルを解きましょう。
恐怖の深淵へ — サスペンススリラー体験
曲がりくねった廊下を進む

gb.description:
James Vanderboom's life drastically changes when he plants a special seed in the garden of the house he has inherited. Expand your bloodline by unlocking portraits in the tree of life.

Rusty Lake: Roots is the second premium point-and-click adventure by Rusty Lake, the creators of the Cube Escape series and Rusty Lake Hotel.

Features:

- Pick-up-and-play:
Easy to start but hard to put down.
- Unique storyline:
Experience the beginning and end of characters' lives and build your own family tree. 
- More than 33 levels:
The biggest Rusty Lake game so far is filled with puzzles
- Full of suspense and atmosphere:
Switching from calm to very dark moments
- Immersive soundtrack:
Each level has its own theme song and variations
- Achievements:
The tree has more secrets to unravel

Tap on the arrows, drag or swipe to navigate around the environment. Some objects you can drag. Interact with peo

de.description:
James Vanderbooms Leben ändert sich drastisch, als er einen speziellen Samen im Garten des Hauses, das er geerbt hat, pflanzt. Erweitere deine Blutlinie, indem du Porträts im Baum des Lebens freischaltest.

Rusty Lake: Roots ist das zweite Premium-Point-and-Click-Abenteuer von Rusty Lake, den Entwicklern der Cube Escape-Serie und von Rusty Lake Hotel.

Hauptmerkmale:

- Fesselndes Spielerlebnis: Leicht, zu beginnen, aber schwer, aufzuhören.
- Einzigartige Geschichte: Erlebe den Lebensanfang und das Lebensende der Charaktere und baue deinen eigenen Stammbaum auf.
- Mehr als 33 Level: Das bisher größte Rusty Lake-Spiel ist voller Puzzle
- Voller Spannung und Atmosphäre: Wechselt von ruhigen zu sehr dunklen Momenten
- Fesselnder Soundtrack: Jedes Level hat seinen eigenen Titelsong und Variationen
- Erfolge: Der Baum hat mehr Geheimnisse zu entwirren

Schritt für Schritt werden wir die Gehei

tw.description:
當詹姆斯·范德布姆在自己所繼承房子的花園裡種下一顆特殊的種子後，他的生活發生了遽變。在人生之樹上通過揭開畫像來擴展你的血緣關係。
《銹湖：根源》是由創作了密室逃脫系列銹湖旅館的銹湖公司開發的第二款付費點擊類冒險遊戲。

關鍵特徵：
操作簡單：容易上手，但一旦玩起來就停不下來。
獨一無二的故事情節：經歷遊戲角色們的人生始末，並建立你獨屬的家譜。
超過33個等級：目前為止最大規模的鏽湖遊戲，充滿了謎題。
懸念叢生的氛圍：在冷靜與黑暗時刻間的轉換。
身臨其境般的音效：每個等級都有特別設計的主題曲和變奏曲。
成就：家譜有更多的秘密等待揭示。
點擊/輕擊箭頭，使用拖拽或滑動等方式在遊戲環境中導航。某些物品可以拖動。通過輕擊/點擊與人們以及各種物品進行互動。選擇在你的清單中找到的物品，並輕擊屏幕上的某處來使用它們。

我們會一步一步揭開鏽湖的謎題。若想了解遊戲的最新進展，請隨時查詢我們的官網 RustyLake.com 或者關注我們的微博 @RustyLake_official

La vie de James Vanderboom va changer drastiquement après avoir planté une graine spéciale dans le jardin de la maison qu’il a eu en héritage. Étendez votre lignée en débloquant des portraits dans l’arbre généalogique.

Rusty Lake: Roots est le nouveau jeu d’aventure graphique de type pointer-et-cliquer des créateurs de la série Cube Escape et de Rusty Lake Hotel.

Fonctionnalités principales :
- Très facile à prendre en main mais presque impossible d’arrêter d’y jouer !
- Une histoire unique : vivez les vies des personnages du début à la fin et créez votre propre arbre généalogique.
- Le plus grand jeu Rusty Lake en date avec plus de 33 niveaux remplis de puzzles à résoudre !
- Du suspense et une atmosphère variant du calme à l’angoissant.
- Une bande son immersive, chaque niveau à son propre thème et des variations.
- Réussites : l’arbre a encore bien des secrets à dévoiler.

Nous dévo

gb.description:
Best friends Arina and Frendt fall into a series of vibrant, dreamlike island gardens peppered with everyday objects from their childhood. Together they embark on an emotional journey that examines the significance of their friendship: the memories they’ve built, what must be let go, and what should never be left behind.

Lost in a mysterious realm where cause and effect are malleable, the friends find that time flows in all directions. Manipulate time to solve puzzles and reach the apex of each isle. Follow the duo as they unpack and explore their significant moments spent together, lighting up constellations and illuminating threads of a bittersweet narrative.


"A masterwork."
- The Guardian

“A must-have title for anyone who enjoys puzzle games.”
- Gaming Trend

“An incredibly clever and frighteningly intricate puzzle formula.”
- Nintendo Life

de.description:
Beste Freunde Arina und Frendt fallen in eine Reihe bunter, traumartiger Inselgärten voller Gegenständen aus ihrer Kindheit. Zusammen gehen sie auf ein emotionales Abenteuer, auf dem sie die Wichtigkeit ihrer Freundschaft entdecken: ihre Erinnerungen, was sie loslassen mussten und was sie nie hätten zurücklassen sollen.

Die Freunde sind verloren in einer geheimnisvollen Welt, in der Ursache und Wirkung nicht immer Sinn machen und die Zeit in alle Richtungen verfliegt. Manipuliere die Zeit, um Rätsel zu lösen und die Spitze jeder Insel zu erreichen. Erlebe mit dem Duo einige ihrer wichtigsten gemeinsamen Momente, lasse Konstellationen erstrahlen und entdecke eine bittersüße Geschichte.


“The Gardens Between steckt voller frischer Ideen, die uns jedes Mal von Neuen erstaunen lassen. Wir entdecken in den Erinnerungen uns selbst. Das macht die Magie dieses kleinen Spieles aus.  Ein Meister

jp.description:
『The Gardens Between』はノスタルジックな雰囲気と繊細なアートが詰め込まれたパズルアドベンチャーゲーム。

美しい庭園の島が連なる不思議な世界。それぞれの島に隠された秘密を見つけるため、親友のArinaとFrendtと共に時間を操りながら数々の謎を解いていきましょう。

色鮮やかで夢のような島には、ふたりが幼い頃に毎日触れていたモノであふれています。ふたりの友情の大切さを知る、穏やかで心から感情が溢れ出てくるような旅路。ふたりには捨て去らなくてはならない思い出と、絶対に手放すことのできない思い出があるのです。

ふたりが過ごしたかけがえのない瞬間を探検し、謎をひも解きながら島の頂上へと一緒に進みましょう。ほろ苦い物語を紡ぐ糸と、その糸が作りだす星座を照らすために…。

・直感的でシンプルな操作で、時間を進めたり戻したりしながら、島の頂上へと光を持ち運びましょう。

・ゲームオーバーはありません。島に仕掛けられたパズルをリラックスして進めましょう。

・ゲーム内には会話などのダイアログテキストはありません。ArinaとFrendtの物語を想像しながら秘密を解き明かしましょう。

kr.description:
친한 친구 사이인 아리나와 프렌드는 어린 시절 물건들로 가득한 다채롭고 몽환적인 정원에 떨어집니다. 이들은 함께 자신들의 우정을 되돌아보는 감동적인 여정을 떠나게 됩니다. 그리고 그 과정 속에서 함께 쌓아올린 추억, 놓아주어야 할 기억, 절대 뒤에 남겨둬선 안 되는 것을 깨닫습니다.

인과 관계가 쉽게 바뀌는 수수께끼의 세계에서 길을 잃은 두 친구는 이 세계의 시간은 다양한 방향으로 흐른다는 사실을 알아냅니다. 시간을 조작해서 퍼즐을 풀고 각 섬의 정상에 도달하세요. 자신들의 추억을 풀어놓고 중요한 순간들을 탐험하는 이들을 따라가면서 별자리를 밝혀주고 슬프고도 아름다운 이야기의 끈을 이어가세요.

gb.description:
From the creators of Love You to Bits and Bring You Home, Alike Studio presents All of You.

All of You is a cute, purely visual, accessible, family-friendly puzzle adventure with unique gameplay. Play and pause time in every part of the level to unveil the right path for the main character.

You will follow the journey of a clumsy chicken traversing all kinds of places in search of her lost chicks.

Explore strange places filled with fun characters, exciting surprises, and many treacherous dangers – all to find every one of your chicks.

INNOVATIVE
Explore a one-of-a-kind game mechanic that allows you to control the environment around you!

SURPRISING
Navigate through unique levels with new locations, characters, and music.

CUTE
Find all the collectibles that show nostalgic moments of the chicken and her chicks.

Apple has named Contre Jour HD iPad Game of the Year in more than 10 countries across Europe and Asia in App Store Rewind 2011. Thanks to Apple and all of our wonderful fans for supporting this special game.

Best Mobile Game of E3 ‹ GamePro 
Best Mobile Game of E3 Finalist ‹ IGN 
Best Mobile/Handheld Game of E3 Nominee ‹ Game Critics Awards 

Blurring the lines between games and interactive art, Contre Jour welcomes you to a hauntingly beautiful world shaped by the interplay of light and darkness. 

Use your finger to morph the landscape, propelling the mysterious creature Petit to safety. Pull, swipe, and tap gadgets such as tendrils, air geysers, and pulleys to complete clever puzzles. Set to a poignant orchestrated soundtrack from composer David Ari Leon, Contre Jour both delights and bedevils from start to finish. 

Press Quotes 
"Contre Jour…seems like the complete package. It has

Explore the universe of Plug & Play, an interactive animation drawn by Michael Frei and coded by Mario von Rickenbach. An unashamedly surreal play with plugs. Run, hit, switch, fall, love, plug, pull. And push.

• Nominated for the Nuovo Award at the Independent Games Festival 2015

Play time: between 10 – 15 minutes.

You have ventured this far, now there is no turning back. Uncover the island’s dark history by travelling through crumbling caverns and mysterious laboratories, but be warned, some may not be too welcoming of your presence…

The epic conclusion to the Meridian 157 series has arrived! Follow Dr. Zander into the heart of the facility to discover the sinister purpose behind the FLARE project, and to avert the impending disaster brought on by its conception.

With the most unique puzzles of the series, Meridian 157: Chapter 3 takes you to the source of the anomaly through a thrilling journey of mind-bending enigmas, perilous exploration and unsettling secrets of the island’s previous inhabitants. Follow Dr. Zander as he is pushed to his wits-end in this final adventure.

Features:
• The final and longest chapter in the Meridian 157 storyline!
• The most unique and challenging puzzles to date

Uncle Henry has been hunting lost treasures for as long as you can remember. His stories of adventure excited your imagination as you were a child growing up. Now with your newly acquired archeology skills, he has been reaching out from time to time for your help in tracking down some of these difficult to find treasures.

In his latest quest, he has been hunting for the treasure map known to be in the lost pirate ship "Queen Anne's Revenge". 世界最高峰のパズルデザイナーが自信を持ってお届けする『A Monster's Expedition』は、人間のことを知るのが好きなモンスターが主人公の、かわいくて癒やされるオープンワールドのパズルアドベンチャーです。

木を倒して道を作ることで、近くの島から遠くの島まで何百もの島を探険し、「ニンゲン」の歴史を学びましょう。

*お墨付きとは法的拘束力のある用語ではなく、適当な推測、噂や伝聞を含むこともあれば含まないこともあります。

- 『A Good Snowman is Hard to Build』や『Cosmic Express』を手がけた開発会社による、かわいさたっぷりのオープンワールドパズルゲーム
- 発見の可能性がたっぷり詰まったシンプルにして奥深いシステム
- 何百もの島を訪れよう。すぐ目の前にある島もあれば、真のパズル好きだけが到達できる彼方の島もあります
- 好奇心旺盛なモンスターの視点から謎に満ちた人類について学びましょう

gb.description: Carefully collect the balls from the conveyor into the boxes, sort all the balls by color into the boxes!

From club racing all the way to the FX1 title, your driving career starts here. Rising Racer combines thrilling car racing with the real life of a racing driver, all in a racing game you play with one thumb.

Create your driver, take your first chequered flag, sign your first contract with a small team and fight your way up four series, from FX4 to FX1, to the very top. 9 rivals on the grid remember every move you make. You decide who to duel with and who you beat to the podium.

ONE-THUMB CAR RACING
• Short, heart-pounding street circuit races in portrait mode, played one-handed
• Swipe, dive into the corner, defend your line and overtake your rival on the final lap
• A 10-car grid, 5 teams, photo finishes and podium celebrations
• 8 street circuits and 20 race layouts: sunset boulevards, harbour, marina, desert and old town, plus reverse, night, sunset and dawn races
• 6 races per seas

hk.description:
從俱樂部賽到 FX1 總冠軍，一段車手生涯正在等著你。Rising Racer 把刺激的賽車對決和真實的賽車手生活，裝進一款一根拇指就能玩的賽車遊戲。

打造你的車手，迎來生涯第一面方格旗，和一支小車隊簽下第一份合約，從 FX4 到 FX1 征戰四個系列賽，一路登上巔峰。發車格上的 9 位對手會記住你的每個動作：要和誰正面對決、力壓誰站上頒獎台，全由你決定。

一根拇指玩賽車
• 直式畫面單手操作，節奏緊湊、讓人屏息的街道賽
• 滑動手指切入彎心，守住走線，在最後一圈完成超車
• 10 輛賽車的發車格、5 支車隊、衝線攝影判定和頒獎台慶祝
• 8 條街道賽道、20 種賽道配置：夕陽大道、港口、碼頭、沙漠和舊城區；還有反向賽、夜賽、夕陽賽和黎明賽
• 每季 6 場比賽：拿積分、達成車隊目標，晉級更高一級的系列賽
• 三個駕駛等級：菜鳥、車手和職業。有理想走線輔助，新手也能贏，高手也能不斷挑戰自我

真正的車手生涯
• 並排比較合約報價，選擇你的車隊，季末在轉會期運籌帷幄
• 和經紀人與車隊老闆溝通，完成贊助商目標
• 規劃比賽週：媒體、訓練、贊助商活動和粉絲見面會
• 每場比賽後在媒體區接受採訪：你說的每句話都會影響你的名氣和與對手之間的恩怨
• 在社群動態追蹤賽前預告、粉絲留言和本週精彩時刻
• 退休時回顧你的傳奇；支援多個生涯存檔欄位和雲端存檔

你的車手，你的安全帽
• 臉型、髮型、鬍子、賽車服、手套、賽車鞋和帽子：數百種造型
• 用圖案、貼紙、漆面效果、面罩和你的車號打造專屬安全帽
• 贏得越多，解鎖的手錶和特別造型就越多，盡情享受巨星般的生活

在訓練中成為高手
• 快速起步、連續彎、魚雷超車、防守、突圍等訓練
• 每一次訓練，都讓你以更好的狀態迎接下一場比賽

離線暢玩
• 想找單機遊戲？Rising Racer 不連網也能玩，不需要帳號
• 每隔幾場比賽會在賽間播放一次廣告，「去除廣告」 可將其移除；獎勵影片要不要看，一律由你決定
• 支援包括繁體中文在內的 48 種語言

獻給賽車運動迷，以及所有喜歡賽車遊戲和汽車遊戲的玩家：下載 Rising Racer

#DRIVE Rally not only nails the spirit of the 90s. It reignites it for a new generation of drivers. Whether you're a veteran of dirt roads or a rookie just looking to get their tires wet, this game will let you redefine speed over and over again.

#DRIVE World
From the sunny landscapes of Dry Crumbs, through the whispering woods of Holzberg, to the chilly wilderness of Revontuli. Take a journey to a diverse world you haven’t experienced in racing games before.

gb.description:
Drive a real Bangladeshi intercity bus from Dhaka to Chattogram (Chittagong) and Sylhet, or work the busy streets of Dhaka city. Bangladeshi Bus Simulator 3D is a bus driving game made for Bangladesh that you can play offline. Free to play, with optional reward videos and optional in-app purchases.

BANGLADESH BUS ROUTES
- Dhaka – Chattogram highway (N1) and Dhaka – Sylhet highway (N2)

このゲームでは、お気に入りの車を運転しながら、すべての交通標識や規制を学びます。一時停止の標識では止まり、歩行者、自転車、車に道を譲り、交通ルールを守りながら安全に運転することが求められます。

地図

いくつかのオープンワールド マップから選択できるため、車を市内、高速道路、または長距離のクルージングで運転することができます。パリ、ラスベガス、シドニー、ワシントン、ローマ、モスクワ、ルート 66 などから選択できます。

マルチプレイヤー

新しいオンライン マルチプレイヤー モードで友達と遊んだり、友達とレースしたりできます。友達リストを作成してチャットし、もちろん全員とレースすることもできます。ドラッグ レース、チェイス モード、ストリート カー レースなど、複数のモードで友達に挑戦しましょう。

チューニング

このカー ゲームには 150 台以上の車両を運転できます。スポーツカー、SUV、オフロードカー、セダン、スーパーカー、ハイパーカー、ハッチバックからお選びいただけます。サスペンションとキャンバーの調整を変更して車両のハンドリングと外観を改善したり、すべてのレースで勝つために車両のパフォーマンスをアップグレードしたりできます。カスタマイズ可能なアンビエント照明を備えた詳細な車内が、あなたの個性的なタッチを待っています。

ゲームのリアルなグラフィックと音響効果

gb.description:
Indian Bikes Riding 3D is an open world driving simulation game where you can ride Indian bikes and drive Indian cars, buses, trucks, aircraft and many more Indian vehicles.

Explore a big open world city at your own pace. Jump on a bike, take the wheel of a car, drive a heavy truck or a bus, or take off in a plane or helicopter and see the city from the sky. Every vehicle has its own realistic driving physics, so riding a superbike feels very different from driving a truck.

INDIAN BIKE RIDING
Ride fast Indian superbikes and street bikes through busy roads, highways and open areas. Speed up, drift around corners and pull off stunts on the mega ramp.

DRIVE ANY VEHICLE
Bikes, cars, buses, trucks, planes and helicopters: switch between vehicles whenever you want and enjoy a true Indian vehicle driving experience.

Race an inch from the track at speeds up to 80 mph (125 kph). 4 Tiers of Weekly Championships. No. 1 paid racing game over 100 countries! (App Annie). 

"You’ll never find another game like it. So competitive..."
Marijn Kremers, FIA-CIK World and European Kart Champion (KZ)

“I stopped real racing 3 as soon as I found this game.”
Mika Francis. App Store Review.

"If you like f1 or nascar games such as Assoluto Racing you'll love this."

Similar karts, similar engines. Always close, fast, competitive.  This is Street Kart Racing.

The road to f1 / nascar / indycar /  all starts in a kart. 

BRING IT ON
The original real racing sim game, SK is it. 

	⁃	The No.1 go kart game on mobile

Run the streets of Port Halvar, a sprawling harbour city split by a winding strait and ringed by islands. Start with nothing, answer the ringing gang phones, and rise from small-time hustler to the boss the whole city fears.

AN OPEN-WORLD ISLAND CITY
Explore over 2 km of hand-drawn city: an old quarter of narrow lanes, glass downtown towers, container docks, rail yards, leafy hill suburbs, a university campus, a military fort and three islands linked by bridges and a highway ring.

JOBS, GANGS AND TURF
Three rival gangs split the city between them. Take their work from 15 kinds of jobs: getaways, hits, car-theft orders, bomb runs, armoured-van hijacks, street races across the bridges, escorts and full tank sieges. Earn respect, stack your multiplier and keep the money rolling in.

JOE DANGER의 위대한 모험이 찾아옵니다!
세계 최고로 대담한 스턴트맨이 되어 망토를 걸치고 믿음직한 모터바이크에 올라타 영웅이 될 때까지 거친 질주를 시작하세요! 버스를 뛰어넘고, 거대한 쥐덫을 피하고, 상어가 가득한 수조를 넘어 경주하고 달리며 죽음을 피해 재앙의 제왕 칭호를 되찾으세요! Joe를 스와이프하여 앞바퀴를 들고 달리고, 장애물을 튕겨 길에서 치우고, 탭하여 점프하고, 길게 눌러 몸을 숙여 상어와 싸우세요!

2022년 새롭게 리마스터되어 찾아옵니다

gb.description:
Pure arcade racing at full throttle!

Final Freeway is a classic arcade racer built for speed, flow and clean handling. Beat the clock to every checkpoint, weave through traffic and chase the horizon across America, Europe, Africa and now Japan.

NEW: THE JAPAN TOUR
Drive the length of Japan in seven new stages: from the beaches of Okinawa, through the Kumamoto uplands, Kobe harbour, old Kyoto, Hakone beneath Mount Fuji and Tokyo at twilight, to the plains of Hokkaido.

FEATURES:
- Three ways to race: Course Run, Road Splits and Time Attack
- Course Run: three full courses, including the new Japan Tour
- Road Splits: pick left or right at every fork, across eight routes with four different endings
- Time Attack: sprint any classic stage for the best lap time
- Reach each checkpoint to extend your time
- Three cars and three difficulty settings
- Tilt, slide or touch steering, plus game c

de.description:
Pures Arcade-Racing mit Vollgas!

Final Freeway ist ein klassischer Arcade-Racer mit Fokus auf Tempo, Flow und präzises Handling. Erreiche jeden Checkpoint vor Ablauf der Zeit, schlängle dich durch den Verkehr und jage dem Horizont hinterher – quer durch Amerika, Europa, Afrika und jetzt auch Japan.

NEU: DIE JAPAN-TOUR
Fahre in sieben neuen Etappen einmal quer durch Japan: von den Stränden Okinawas über das Hochland von Kumamoto, den Hafen von Kobe, das alte Kyoto, Hakone am Fuße des Fuji und Tokio in der Abenddämmerung bis in die Ebenen Hokkaidos.

MERKMALE:
- Drei Arten zu fahren: Streckenlauf, Abzweigungen und Zeitangriff
- Streckenlauf: drei komplette Strecken, darunter die neue Japan-Tour
- Abzweigungen: Wähle an jeder Gabelung links oder rechts – acht Routen mit vier verschiedenen Enden
- Zeitangriff: Jage auf jeder klassischen Etappe die beste Rundenzeit
- Erreiche jeden Checkpoi

genres: エンターテインメント
jp.description:
アクセル全開の、純粋なアーケードレース！

Final Freewayは、スピード感と流れるような走り、正確なハンドリングを追求したクラシックなアーケードレーサー。制限時間内にチェックポイントを目指し、車の流れをすり抜け、アメリカ、ヨーロッパ、アフリカ、そして新たに日本の地平線を追いかけよう。

新登場：日本ツアー
新たな7つのステージで日本を縦断。沖縄のビーチから、熊本の高原、神戸の港、古都・京都、富士山を望む箱根、夕暮れの東京を抜けて、北海道の平原へ。

特徴：
- 3つのレースモード：コース走行、分岐ルート、タイムアタック
- コース走行：新しい日本ツアーを含む3つのフルコース
- 分岐ルート：分かれ道ごとに左右を選択。8つのルートと4つの異なるエンディング
- タイムアタック：クラシックステージでベストラップに挑戦
- チェックポイントに到達して残り時間を延長
- 3台の車と3段階の難易度
- 傾き操作・スライド操作・タッチ操作に加え、ゲームコントローラーにも対応
- 滑らかで反応の良い操作による圧倒的なスピード感
- 3曲から選べるオリジナルサウンドトラック
- アーケード筐体の雰囲気を再現するCRT画面フィルター（オプション）
- Game Centerのリーダーボードと実績

サクッと1プレイ、または完璧なルートでハイスコア更新を狙おう。

tw.description:
純粹街機賽車，全速前進！

Final Freeway 是一款強調速度感、節奏與精準操控的經典街機賽車遊戲。在時限內衝過每個檢查點，穿梭車流，追逐地平線，馳騁美洲、歐洲、非洲，如今更可縱貫日本。

全新：日本之旅
在 7 個全新關卡中縱貫日本：從沖繩的海灘出發，途經熊本高原、神戶港、古都京都、富士山下的箱根與暮色中的東京，直抵北海道的平原。

特色：
- 三種比賽方式：賽程賽、岔路模式與計時賽
- 賽程賽：3 條完整賽程，包括全新的日本之旅
- 岔路模式：在每個岔路口選擇向左或向右，共 8 條路線與 4 種不同結局
- 計時賽：挑戰任一經典關卡的最快單圈
- 抵達檢查點即可延長時間
- 3 款賽車與 3 個難度等級
- 傾斜轉向、滑動轉向或觸控操作，並支援遊戲控制器
- 流暢且靈敏的操控帶來強烈速度感
- 原創配樂，3 首曲目任選
- 可選 CRT 畫面濾鏡，重現街機機台的畫面質感
- Game Center 排行榜與成就

隨時來一局，或挑戰完美路線刷新最高分。

fr.description:
Course d'arcade pure à pleine vitesse !

Final Freeway est un jeu de course d'arcade classique axé sur la vitesse, la fluidité et une conduite précise. Atteignez chaque point de contrôle avant la fin du chrono, faufilez-vous dans la circulation et foncez vers l'horizon à travers l'Amérique, l'Europe, l'Afrique et désormais le Japon.

NOUVEAU : LE TOUR DU JAPON
Traversez le Japon de bout en bout en sept nouvelles étapes : des plages d'Okinawa aux plaines d'Hokkaido, en passant par les hauts plateaux de Kumamoto, le port de Kobe, le vieux Kyoto, Hakone au pied du mont Fuji et Tokyo au crépuscule.

CARACTÉRISTIQUES :
- Trois façons de courir : Course, Bifurcations et Chrono
- Course : trois parcours complets, dont le nouveau Tour du Japon
- Bifurcations : à gauche ou à droite à chaque embranchement, avec huit itinéraires et quatre fins différentes
- Chrono : attaquez n'importe quelle étape

kr.description:
풀스로틀 아케이드 레이싱!

Final Freeway는 속도감, 흐름, 정밀한 핸들링에 집중한 클래식 아케이드 레이서입니다. 제한 시간 안에 체크포인트에 도달하고, 차량 사이를 누비며 미국, 유럽, 아프리카, 그리고 이제 일본의 지평선을 향해 달려보세요.

신규: 일본 투어
새로운 7개 스테이지로 일본을 종단하세요. 오키나와의 해변에서 출발해 구마모토 고원, 고베 항구, 옛 교토, 후지산 아래 하코네, 황혼의 도쿄를 지나 홋카이도의 평원까지 달립니다.

특징:
- 3가지 레이스 방식: 코스 주행, 갈림길, 타임 어택
- 코스 주행: 새로운 일본 투어를 포함한 3개의 풀코스
- 갈림길: 갈림길마다 왼쪽이나 오른쪽을 선택, 8가지 경로와 4가지 엔딩
- 타임 어택: 클래식 스테이지에서 베스트 랩에 도전
- 체크포인트에 도달해 남은 시간을 연장
- 차량 3대와 3단계 난이도
- 기울여 조향, 밀어서 조향, 터치 조작은 물론 게임 컨트롤러도 지원
- 부드럽고 반응 빠른 조작이 주는 강렬한 속도감
- 3곡 중에서 고를 수 있는 오리지널 사운드트랙
- 아케이드 기기 느낌을 살리는 CRT 화면 필터(선택)

gb.description:
* The intense PHASE THREE update is out now!
* PHASE THREE brings WEAPONS and A.I. OPPONENTS to Repulze.

Get ready for a futuristic adrenaline rush from the developers of Reckless Racing. Blast through gravity defying tracks while collecting precious energy   boosts to push your speed beyond reason!

This futuristic racer puts you in the seat of experimental Repulze hovercraft working as a test pilot for the Man. Well, the Synthetic Man is more accurate. The Synthetics run the corporations. The corporations run the world. You are way down the food chain getting pushed around to complete their “scientific” challenges. But you’ll show ‘em…

•Super-fluid racing action with stunning graphics
•Quick-to-learn touch and tilt controls but challenging to master
•Game Center leaderboards and achievements
•NEW: Phase Three is available!
•NEW: Weapons and A.I. opponents
•Languages: English, Deutsch

de.description:
* Das großartige PHASE-DREI-Update ist jetzt erhältlich!
* PHASE DREI bietet WAFFEN und K.I.-GEGNER in Repulze.

Der futuristische Adrenalin-Kick von den Entwicklern von Reckless Racing! Rase über Rennstrecken, die der Schwerkraft trotzen, während du wertvolle Energieschübe sammelst, um ein Wahnsinnstempo zu erreichen!

In diesem futuristischen Rennspiel sitzt du als Testpilot für das Establishment in einem experimentellen Repulze-Luftkissengleiter. Na ja, genauer gesagt das künstliche Establishment. Die Künstlichen leiten die Konzerne. Die Konzerne lenken die Welt. Du stehst ganz unten in der Nahrungskette und wirst gezwungen, ihre ""wissenschaftlichen"" Herausforderungen zu bestehen. Aber du wirst es ihnen zeigen...

• Superflüssige Racing-Action mit großartigen Grafiken
• Einfach zu erlernende, aber komplexe Berührungs- und Neigungssteuerung für Meisterpiloten
• Game-Center-Bestenlist

jp.description:
* 大幅アップデートとなるフェイズ3をリリース！
* Repulzeのフェイズ3には、武器とA.I.搭載の敵という要素が追加

「Reckless Racing」の開発チームが創った、アドレナリン出まくりの未来型レーシングゲーム。反重力トラックを疾走しながら貴重なエネルギーブーストを集め、スピードの限界を超えてみせろ！

この未来型レースゲームの世界で、君は人類のために試験段階のRepulzeホバークラフトのテストパイロットとして働いている。いや、正確には「シンセティック・マン」社のためだ。シンセティック・マン社は複合企業であり、世界を牛耳っている。連中の「科学的」挑戦を達成するために、食物連鎖の最下層にいる君は試練を強いられ続ける。だが見せつけてやろう、連中に…

•美しいグラフィック、流れるようなレースアクション
•すぐにマスターできるタッチ＆ティルトコントロール、しかしゲームをマスターするのは簡単ではな
•Game Centerで管理されるリーダーボードと実績
•NEW：フェイズ3が追加！
•NEW：武器とA.I.搭載の敵要素が追加

フェイズ1：リブートキャンプ（発売中！）
Repulzeエンジンの最適な使用法を見つけるために未知なる領域を突破せよ。人類の限界まで速く。そしてその限界さえ超えてみせろ。まばたきしている暇はない！
•9種類の反重力トラック
•6種類の音速Repulzeホバークラフト

フェイズ2：脱出と消失（発売中！）
宇宙の外れへと逃げることに成功した君は、避けることのできない最後のショーに向け、スキルを磨き力を蓄えなければならない。
•新ステージ「機械化のなれの果て」
•7種類の非常識なトラック
•新タイプのチャレンジ
•アップグレードのパワーリッパー登場
•磁力フィールド、バリア、ツールキット登場

フェイズ3：バックラッシュ（発売中！）
シンセティックに発見されてしまった。だが敵のマスターA.I.「ザ・ケーネル」へと続く一筋の光が目の前に。さあ武器を手に敵のパーティー会場へ乗り込む時が来た。
•新バトルステージ「終焉の地」
•安全性皆無、心
